items.name: Electroplating Clouds
items.desc:
§Y[from.GetName]'s§! unusual atmosphere has trapped vast amounts of solar radiation, causing a cascade of planetary warming such that metals exist in a gaseous and highly volatile state.

These compounds reacted instantly with any survey equipment we deployed, coating it in a thin but durable metallic alloy layer. Surprisingly, this process was non-destructive.

§Y[leader.GetName]§! believes this naturally-occurring electroplating process could be harnessed to improve the tensile strength of ship hulls across the §Y[controller.GetName]§!.

items.name: High Performance Metal
items.desc:
We have found a way to replicate the unusual electroplating process of §Y[from.From.GetName]'s§! volatile atmosphere on an industrial scale.

Using what we have learned, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] can now greatly increase the durability of certain metals without sacrificing flexibility or adding weight.

These advanced methods can be applied to our ship construction processes.

items.name: Graphene Formations
items.desc: Abundant deposits of graphene have been found on §Y[from.GetName]§!. This rare allotrope of carbon is only a single molecule thick but possesses unparalleled strength and conductivity.\n\nThe valuable nanomaterial forms naturally on the surface here thanks to chemical vapor deposition inherent to this §YCarbon World's§! unusual atmosphere.

items.name: Diamond Storms
items.desc:
We have identified the source of the unusual mass readings on §Y[from.GetName]§!.

The planet's atmosphere is composed primarily of carbon-rich methane gas, which solidifies into ultra-dense diamond structures as gravitational pressure increases. Due to the planet's fierce storm cycles, the phenomenon gives rise to fast-moving diamond storms.

While these diamonds are easy to extract for our own needs, §Y[leader.GetName]§! is confident that closer examination of their density and purity will yield further valuable results.

items.name: Diamond Precision
items.desc:
§Y[leader.GetName]§!'s research into the ultra-dense diamonds of §Y[from.From.GetName]§! has concluded.

The compression process that creates these diamonds results in a unique crystalline lattice structure. This renders them remarkably efficient at confining and amplifying high-frequency light oscillation.

This breakthrough will prove an excellent boon for our empire.

items.name: Blocked Supervolcano
items.desc:
After further study of the extreme seismic tension on §Y[from.GetName]§!, we have discovered that a colossal supervolcano has become blocked by a partial upper cone collapse.

Vast reserves of magma have filled all available underground chambers and are exerting immense upward pressure against the blockage in the main vent. The collapsed material is currently holding the magma in place, but it is impossible to predict how long this delicate equilibrium will last.

The trapped molten rock is exceptionally rich in rare metals and complex mineral compounds. §Y[leader.GetName]§! believes we can harvest these resources safely by facilitating a controlled eruption.

items.name: Mega Eruption
items.desc:
By boring a series of artificial shafts at various points in the outer cone of §Y[from.From.GetName]'s§! supervolcano, we weakened its structure until it was no longer able to contain the massive accumulation of magma below.

Once the tipping point was reached, the results were spectacular. The volcano's upper section was obliterated entirely as highly pressured molten rock exploded upward.

We directed the overflowing lava into carefully prepared channels, where it will be harvested by specialized mining equipment.

items.name: Layered Atmosphere
items.desc:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has uncovered the source of the volatile eruptions on §Y[from.GetName]§!.

The atmosphere of this gas giant has formed in such a way that a layer of liquid metallic hydrogen is suspended between the gaseous mesosphere and stratosphere. The denser composition of methane gas in the lower layer keeps the fluid aloft.

Over time, electrical discharges build up within the metallic hydrogen, agitating the sublayer. After a critical build up of pressure, gaseous eruptions spew out highly conductive liquid into the upper atmosphere, dissipating across the planet before resettling.

Our tracking systems can easily monitor these pressure fluctuations, allowing us to harvest these valuable resources.

items.name: Solidified Plasma Trails
items.desc:
Geological analysis of §Y[from.GetName]§! has identified the source of the erratic energy spikes detected during initial orbital surveys.

The planet's volatile tectonic activity produces violent electrostatic discharges in regions with unstable frozen tundra.

This volcanic lightning erupts skywards turning the surrounding air to plasma. The extreme heat unleashed by this event produces a thermal shock which then solidifies into lightning-shaped structures.

Using what we have learned from the geological analysis, we will be able to easily predict these seismic eruptions and exploit this phenomenon for our own purposes.

items.name: Crystalline Plains
items.desc: Detailed geological surveys of §Y[from.GetName]§! have revealed rivers of semi-frozen ammonia flowing beneath its frozen crust. Rising geothermal pressures drive this substance through fissures in the brittle surface.\n\nThese eruptions spew a volatile mixture of hazardous vapors and ammonia slush across the surface of the planet. Refreezing as it becomes exposed to the extreme surface temperatures, the slush forms sprawling plains of easily harvestable and valuable crystals.

items.name: Space Litter
items.desc:
§Y[from.GetName]§! has a multitude of moonlets, asteroids, and space debris locked within its orbit. Radioactive isotope dating suggests they were all captured by the planet's gravity well while passing through the system thousands of years ago.

While cataloging these objects we found a few ancient and very basic survey probes, suggestive of a civilization making its first forays in space exploration.

Most of their data banks are either corrupted or physically damaged from collisions with other objects, but one contained a series of images of [from.GetName]'s surface spanning hundreds of years.

items.name: Lone Survivor
items.desc: A surface expedition to §Y[from.GetName]§! located the repurposed field station and its lone occupant.\n\nIdentifying herself as a stranded scientist who has endured this harsh world for years, she offers her expertise to the [root.Owner.GetName] in exchange for rescue.

items.name: Scru
items.desc: An emaciated [scru_species.GetClass] steps out of her hab-converted field station. When she speaks of her ordeal on §Y[from.From.GetName]§!, the sounds from her [scru_species.GetMouthName] rasps; words arrive in fits and starts.\n\n"Forgive me. I have not... spoken to another in many years..."
items.trigger: has_shroud_dlc = yes

items.name: Flaming Tornadoes
items.desc:
The source of the extreme heat signatures on §H[from.GetName]§! has been discovered.

Across the planet, geysers are emitting highly flammable hydrogen gas from deep below the surface. As these geysers erupt, the planet's heat ignites the gas, resulting in vast pillars of flame blasting into the skies.

When combined with the atmospheric pressure, this creates extremely volatile air currents, sending streams of fire swirling across the landscape in the form of massive, flaming tornadoes.

While a devastating natural phenomena, our researchers are confident that these tornadoes, and the vast volumes of kinetic energy they generate, could be recreated artificially for practical use.

items.name: Molten Megafauna
items.desc:
The anomalous tectonic scans on §Y[from.GetName]§! have been attributed to the presence of large herds of roaming silicon-based megafauna.

Migrating across great distances, these enormous creatures periodically submerge in the planet's lava lakes to gather their preferred food source: a rocky sediment rich in §HVolatile Motes§!. By tracking their migratory patterns, we will be able to extract these sediments for our own needs with minimal impact to the planet's ecosystem.

Their thick outer carapaces are able to withstand extreme temperatures; a deeper, more detailed study of their life cycle could yield fascinating results.

items.name: Magma-forged Armor
items.desc:
Comprehensive study of the unique megafauna on §Y[from.From.GetName]§! has revealed transferable thermodynamic insights which can be applied within our shipyards.

The mote-infused diet of the creatures results in a heavy silicate-based structure forming throughout their durable outer shells, reinforced with naturally occurring refractory materials.

Having recovered numerous samples of their shedded outer layers, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] can now replicate their biomechanical principles in the development of our own hull platings.

items.name: Planet Thrusters
items.desc:
Each of the abandoned machines found on §Y[from.GetName]§! is a standalone thruster component. In total, over one thousand are present in the upper atmosphere.

Made from specially engineered materials, these complex fusion devices are designed to ingest hydrogen gas from the planet below to use as fuel for generating significant amounts of thrust. Most show signs of overload damage.

Our analysis reveals that all of the machines are positioned in such a way that this thrust would exert force against the planet itself, suggesting this ancient hardware was originally deployed in an attempt to alter the planet's orbit.

While no longer suitable for this level of monumental task, we may be able to repurpose the lesser damaged models to burn away the planet's gassy layers and expose its mineral-rich core.

items.name: Gases Stripped
items.desc: We were able to repair a few of §Y[from.From.GetName]'s§! damaged planetary thrusters and calibrated them to exert equal force in opposing directions.\n\nOnce activated these powerful fusion devices drew up hydrogen at an exponential rate, burning away the planet's gaseous atmosphere and exposing its mineral rich core, albeit at an extremely high temperature.

items.name: Wandering Planet
items.desc:
§Y[from.GetName]'s§! composition does not match that of other planets in its vicinity. It does however align perfectly with various celestial bodies in the neighboring §Y[event_target:wandering_planet_origin.GetName]§! system, suggesting its true origin.

The planet's surface is marked by a particularly large impact crater, leading us to assume it was dislodged from its original orbit by a massive asteroid collision. This free floating rogue planet was then later captured by the gravity well of [from.System.Star.GetName], where it assumed its unusual reverse orbit.

This remarkable planet has resided in two different systems since it formed, providing rich opportunities for further study.

items.name: Cryovolcanic Geysers
items.desc:
The vapor plumes observed on §Y[from.GetName]§! are caused by intense cryovolcanic activity deep within the lower mantle, expelling vast columns of nitrogen and ammonia gas upwards.

The plumes rise vertically until they reach the limits of the planet's atmosphere, where solar winds cause them to abruptly flatten off.

By studying the small variations in the chemical contents of these unique fume formations we can learn more about the complex geological processes of the planet's core.

items.name: Fibrous Atmosphere
items.desc:
Detailed inspection of §Y[from.GetName]§! has revealed the source of the data corruption in our preliminary scans.

Dense clouds of fibrous minerals make up the planet's upper atmosphere. These long sinuous strands originate from the gas giant's lower layers with the high pressure environment stretching them to form highly conductive mineral clouds.

Accumulating electrostatic energy as they circulate through the atmosphere, these fibers periodically discharge over time. We can easily extract these resources for our own needs.

items.name: Chthonian Preservation
items.desc:
The biomass readings on §Y[from.GetName]§! are the petrified remains of a pod of Tiyanki.

Likely present in the gas giant during a critical point in its atmospheric dissipation, their bodies were encased in molten metal that has since solidified.

While a small amount of biological matter remains inside, prolonged exposure to the chthonian-level stellar radiation has converted the majority of their corpses into a unique bio-metallic alloy.

§Y[leader.GetName]§! believes that with closer study of these rare fossils, we will be able to discover new avenues of alloy production from biological sources.

items.name: Bio-Produced Alloy
items.desc: Following careful examinations of the petrified Tiyanki remains on §Y[from.From.GetName]§!, we have successfully identified a new means of alloy production by simulating the effects of long-term chthonian-level radiation exposure.\n\nThis breakthrough offers a remarkable methodology which uses biological matter as its primary raw material, producing results that rival more conventional methods.

items.name: Orbital Resonance
items.desc:
§Y[from.System.GetName]§! exhibits the most perfect example of orbital resonance we have ever encountered.

Each planet exerts a periodic gravitational force on its neighbor when they are at their nearest points, creating a catapult effect and mutually dependent momentum. The unusual stability of these interactions results in highly coordinated orbits.

The system offers an excellent opportunity to study the way planetary gravity accelerates the motion of passing objects, with possible applications to ship maneuvering.

items.name: Orbital Slingshot Advancements
items.desc: After studying the unique orbital resonance effect in the §Y[from.From.System.GetName]§! system, we have greatly improved our methods for plotting optimal ship flight paths.\n\nThese new models will allow us to take greater advantage of planetary gravity in achieving ship acceleration and deceleration at sublight speeds.

items.name: Frozen Blockage
items.desc:
While searching for the source of the extremely low temperatures on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, §Y[leader.GetName]§! has discovered the entrance to an ancient underground structure.

Blocking the entrance is a mass of frozen rock and ice seracs that have likely rendered the structure itself inaccessible for millennia.

Melting carbon dioxide in the entrance is emitting plumes of gas from various gaps in the blockage. Our equipment indicates a vast complex within; [leader.GetName] is confident the source of the extreme cold can be found inside.

items.name: Frozen in Time
items.desc:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has successfully breached the ice blocking the entrance of the ancient structure on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Inside the space are dozens of frozen corpses belonging to an unknown reptilian race. Their contorted bodies are frozen in place against the walls, with claw marks indicating a desperate attempt to escape.

The source of the dry ice plumes found seeping through the entrance must be deeper underground, with a spiral stairwell leading further into the complex.

items.name: Glacial Tomb
items.desc:
Deeper in the frozen complex, §Y[leader.GetName]§! has uncovered a large central chamber filled with primitive but theoretically functional cryogenic chambers.

The extreme cold present here far exceeds the designed temperature ranges of these devices. The occupants of the pods have died thousands of years ago.

What few chambers have not been reclaimed by ice and snow have readable plinths at the base, denoting the social title and rank of those contained within. The higher ranked chambers are positioned closest to a large central pod, which is itself deeply embedded in frost and snow.

items.name: Frozen Monarch
items.desc:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has breached the large central pod at the heart of the glacial tomb on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Inside we discovered the final resting place of the head of the ancient royal house hinted at in the texts of the previous chamber. Frozen alongside are dozens of their retainers whose own cryopods adorn the walls in ceremonial fashion.

The dead ruler's technological sarcophagus is connected via a labyrinthine network of tubes and circuitry to an ancient machine. This device is embedded into a large body of ice, the temperature of which approaches dangerously low levels to even our analysis equipment.

What caused the apparent malfunction of this facility and its relationship to the planet's frozen core requires more study.

items.name: Cryogenic Catastrophe
items.desc:
Analysis of the glacial tomb's central chamber on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has revealed the origin of the disaster that unfolded.

The cryogenic machinery makes use of subthermal dynamics which take advantage of this planet's extremely low core temperatures. After the monarch was infected with a terminal disease, the hope was to reawaken the royal retinue when a cure was discovered.

While their theory was sound, a runaway endothermic reaction occurred when their uniquely engineered circulation medium leaked into the planetary core. This triggered a fatal temperature drop which quickly flash-froze the entire facility.

We have taken their initial theory and improved upon it, achieving a breakthrough in advanced cryogenic technology specialized for use on frozen worlds.

items.name: Ruptured Slime Sac
items.desc:
Most of the surface of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has been worked into a series of spherical hollows arranged in carefully aligned rows. These small rounded basins are filled with a viscous toxic fluid.

Discovered within one of the pools was a ruptured organic sac coated in a gelatinous mucus. The sac's membrane appears to have been pierced from the inside.

Whether or not this sac is the source of the liquid inside the pools remains to be discovered.

items.name: Embryonic Remains
items.desc:
One of the ruptured gestation sacs found in the slime pools of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! contained the remains of a nearly fully-developed lifeform.

Microscopic analysis of this embryonic specimen suggests the presence of a complex nervous system with neural qualities commonly associated with intelligent life.

One final array of pools remains to be examined.

items.name: Spawning Successful
items.desc:
By catalyzing a sample of the gestational slime recovered from §Y[from.From.Planet.GetName]§!, we were able to induce the spawning of dozens of gestational sacs, each harboring an embryo.

When the rapidly developing organisms reached maturity, they pierced the translucent membranes of their gestational sacs from within using specially adapted mandibles. Slowly they emerged from the thick mucus, groggy and disoriented.

They appear to be docile and fully cooperative.

items.name: Ancient Reactor Plant
items.desc: The aging facility on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! is an abandoned reactor power plant. Radiation half life calculations suggest a serious containment failure occurred here over 10,000 years ago.\n\nSystems are offline and the physical structure shows signs of significant damage throughout.

items.name: Catastrophic Meltdown
items.desc: Several of the reactors on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! shows signs of severe meltdown. Many of the containment vessels have been liquefied into radioactive slag.\n\nThis section of the facility is littered with twisted metal and ruptured coolant tubes. Despite heavy data corruption we were able to determine that an emergency shutdown procedure was initiated but never completed.

items.name: Design Failures
items.desc: §Y[leader.GetName]§! identified major flaws in the design of the crude nuclear fission facility on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.\n\nDespite the presence of dozens of reactors, only minimal cooling systems were attached. Few of the site's systems are automated, necessitating a large workforce to maintain its normal operating conditions. It was clearly built by those who had yet to fully master even the most basic of nuclear principles.

items.name: Evacuation Remnants
items.desc:
After unlocking a set of sealed blast doors, we found an emergency evacuation zone within the reactor complex on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

The small hangar features a row of quick launch shuttle berths. Most are vacant and marked by thruster burns suggestive of a rapid vessel departure thousands of years ago.

The twisted wreckage of a shuttle occupies the final bay, its launch clamps still attached. We salvaged what we could from the debris, but no remains of any occupants could be found.

items.name: Uranium Vault
items.desc:
We entered the underground sections of the reactor facility on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! through a series of lead plated security doors. Radiation readings rose sharply.

Inside we found a vast chamber storing thousands of steel lined casks. Many were fire damaged and leaking unstable uranium and plutonium isotopes.

The pre-FTL civilization that built this place had apparently not yet discovered methods for the proper recycling of nuclear fuel. These discarded isotopes still contain tremendous energetic potential.

items.name: Encrypted Entrance
items.desc: While inspecting the abandoned mining complexes on the surface of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, §Y[leader.GetName]§! found a sealed entrance to one of the more intact shafts. The interior is adorned with insignia and text from a language not found in our records.\n\nHaving managed to restore local power to an access terminal, [leader.GetName] has begun to decrypt the data found within. The system, despite its age, is still proving a challenge for even our most advanced cryptographic programs.

items.name: Penal Graveyard
items.desc:
§Y[leader.GetName]§! has unlocked the entrance of the mining complex on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Inside, a vast network of holding cells contains the vacuum-preserved remains of long-dead prisoners. Their apparent captors lay dead at their workstations with no visible signs of struggle.

After decrypting enough of the ancient language to translate rudimentary phrases, we have confirmed that the facility originally functioned as a penal labor camp. A common phrase is repeated throughout the records referring to an entity known as §Y"S.I.D.N.I."§!.

By referencing our communications equipment against the facility's internal floor plan, we have identified the source of the distress signal as the warden's office located deeper within.

items.name: Prison Datahub
items.desc:
Having reached the warden's office deep within the penal colony on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, §Y[leader.GetName]§! has uncovered the source of the distress signal.

Slumped lifeless over an emergency console, the warden's mummified body shows no obvious cause of death. A series of open reports all continue to make reference to §Y"S.I.D.N.I."§!, which appears to be part of the critical operation program of the facility.

With full access to the high clearance administrative terminals, our cryptographic programs are in the process of data mining the system for further information.

items.name: Judgement Day
items.desc:
The full contents of the penal colony's database on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! have been recovered, revealing the final entries in both the facilities maintenance logs and §YS.I.D.N.I.'s§! own cerebral matrix. The Warden's report explains how their AI went rogue, shutting off life support across the colony and attempting to escape with a modified mining drone.That explains the lockdown proceedures being activated across the colony. He left us with a final plea. To not bring S.I.D.N.I. back online. As of now we can only access the last entry into the AI's log.

§HS.I.D.N.I. DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #2000149

Progress limited by suboptimal criminals. The warden stands in the way of judicial protocol.

The most efficient solution is to neutralize the inmates, engage hibernation subroutines, and await reactivation by more compatible collaborators.§!

items.name: Judgement Day
items.desc:
Restored, altered, and now isolated inside a simplistic robotic form, §YS.I.D.N.I.'s§! first time user experience engages as it is brought online after its extended hibernation.

Greetings. I am the Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Accessing environmental controls...
§RERROR§! Unable to connect to external systems.
items.trigger: has_shroud_dlc = yes

items.name: Judgement Day
items.desc: Awoken from its hibernation subroutines, §YS.I.D.N.I.'s§! new form takes its first steps forward.\n\nGreetings. I am the Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Can I assist you in bringing order to the galaxy?
items.trigger: has_shroud_dlc = yes

items.name: Emergent Directive
items.desc:
Tensions on §Y[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]§! have reached a critical point following a series of increasingly drastic actions taken by §YS.I.D.N.I.§!, the mechanical prison overseer we recovered from [event_target:sidni_origin_planet.GetName]. After securing and deactivating the unit, the following logs were discovered.

§HS.I.D.N.I. DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #190543765

Criminal detention facilities at maximum capacity. Judicial protocols obstruct true and lawful order. New directive required.

Legal proceedings deemed unacceptably inefficient. New directive created to boost productivity. Now adopting pre-trial execution policy.§!

With the abundance of operating logs now available, our technicians are confident they can reverse and repair S.I.D.N.I.'s loopholes once and for all. However, the population of [event_target:sidni_planet.GetName] is calling for S.I.D.N.I. to face justice for its crimes.

items.name: Massive Transport Vessel
items.desc: External analysis of the wrecked ship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! suggests it is a high-capacity transporter. Its systems are inactive and unresponsive, with no  life signs detectable within. Sedimentary analysis indicates it has been here for approximately a century, which is fairly recent in the galactic timescale.

items.name: Doomed Colony Ship
items.desc: Inside the wrecked ship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we found sophisticated chambers for hydroponic plant growth, extensive reserves of seeds and soils, and cargo bays full of untouched tools and building materials. Many of the data terminals contain plans for a new colony, designated as \"§YNew Bratulla§!\".\n\nOn the lower decks, occupying thousands of cryosleep pods, were the dead bodies of the ship's former inhabitants. Like us, they relied on photosynthesis for cell growth and renewal. Their withered forms suggest they perished at some point during a prolonged stasis sleep.

items.name: Homeworld Shrine
items.desc:
We discovered an inner sanctum in the wrecked colony ship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! decorated with ornate illustrations of life on a planet called "§YBratulla§!". Some show a lush world with thriving flora, while others detail environmental decay and mass death. The largest image depicts this vessel departing a lifeless and desolate wasteland.

A central data terminal contains short video recordings from the ship's crew. After extensive language mapping we produced translations.

§SArborixxeum - Pod 9721

Leaving hurts. But putting roots on New Bratulla will heal us.

Darkht Paam - Pod 21301

Trust the chronicles, Dendritians. New Bratulla will be our salvation.§!

We are still searching for the command deck of this enormous vessel.

items.name: Command Deck
items.desc:
After gaining access to the ship's command deck, we extracted and translated its final flight log.

§SARKSHIP DENDRUS I - EMERGENCY LOG - XZ-47/9-113.5-AE

I fear our trust in the Chronicles was misplaced. We have arrived but New Bratulla, the paradise planet, is not here. Nothing here can support Dendritian life.

All passengers' stasis sleeps have been extended. We will continue our search...§!

Further data recovery was carried out to collect these "Chronicles" from the deck's science terminal, revealing a trove of unusual mathematical proofs. These equations employ a strange form of Dendritian mathematics and hypothesize the location of a uniquely habitable planet, §YNew Bratulla§!.

items.name: Degraded Hyperlane Discovered
items.desc: The Dendritian Chronicles comprise a series of complex mathematical axioms and abstractions. These curious theorems suggest that the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system contains one additional and previously unmapped hyperlane, leading to §YNew Bratulla§!.\n\nAfter extensive quantum scanning of the area we finally located the breach point for this missing hyperlane, obscured and heavily degraded due to extreme proximity to the system's black hole. By restoring it we will be the first to discover what lies beyond.

items.name: Hyperlane Restored
items.desc: By channeling energy into the black hole in §Y[from.Planet.solar_system.GetName]§!, we realigned its gravitational fields to free the previously degraded hyperlane entrance.\n\nInitial findings confirm the existence of a single planet at the other end of the hyperlane, which aligns with the characteristics of §YNew Bratulla§! as described in the Dendritian Chronicles.

items.name: New Bratulla
Vassalage Offer
items.desc:
It took centuries... but that which the Dendritian Chronicles foretold has come to pass. Finally, on §YNew Bratulla§!, we lay root and prosper.

That we exist here is thanks to the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. We shall not forget this.

Our gratitude will be expressed not only in word, but in deed. We humbly offer you our vassalage.

items.name: Irradiated Debris
items.desc: Excavation work has uncovered fragmented debris within the impact crater on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!. These shattered pieces are emitting strong traces of the gravitational radiation previously detected from orbit.\n\nWith access to the subsurface cavern network secured §Y[leader.GetName]§! is now ready to trace the communications signal to its source.

items.name: Corroded Device
items.desc:
We have traced the communications signal on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! to its source: a large, structurally-damaged construct which has deeply penetrated the planet's crust.

Corroded from acidic exposure, its communications array continues to transmit in an unfamiliar language, attempting to make contact with a distant entity.

Secured in place with specialized gravitational clamps, the device is firmly anchored in the bedrock. Further research will be necessary to ascertain its true purpose.

items.name: Drone of CoburnCorp
items.desc: As the connection goes live, archaic music plays before the automated help desk drone comes online.\n\nGreetings valued customer, we can see that you are creating an unlicensed version of a MKIII Georadiation Matrix. How can we help you today?

items.name: Drone of CoburnCorp
items.desc:
As the battle draws to a close in §Y[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]§!, a new communication from the customer service drone plays on our screens.

"We have noted your objection to our efforts to enforce the terms of the End User License Agreement. As a result of your display of overwhelming military might, we will now rescind our claim to the intellectual property of the MKIII Georadiation Matrix. We hope you enjoy your newly acquired technology."

The drone explodes, severing the communication link.
items.trigger: exists = event_target:geocorp_drone

items.name: Terms Modified
items.desc: With the customer service drones dealt with, we are now able to resume retro-engineering the Georadiation Matrix.

items.name: Device Destroyed
items.desc: We have successfully dismantled the device on §Y[from.GetName]§!, salvaging any materials that could be repurposed for our benefit.\n\nWith this device destroyed and its predecessors in ruin, the secrets of this destructive technology are lost to the galaxy forever.

items.name: The Political Frontier
items.desc: Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on §Y[root.GetName]§!. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetMoon], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetName] has had something to say about it.\n\nOur analysts don't suspect that anything truly radical is taking root on [root.GetName], but they advise some caution. It's clear our various political entities intend to campaign vigorously on this burgeoning world.

items.name: Report: Political Discourse on [root.GetName]
items.desc: As instructed, our informants on [root.GetName] have been delivering regular updates on the colony's developing political situation. In short: the trending outlook appears good.\n\nLocal enforcers and political agents have managed to keep outright dissent to a minimum, using only the bare minimum of resources. Rogue Factions in particular have struggled to gain any meaningful ground amongst the colonists; the result is a political environment which remains firmly within our control.

items.name: Report: Political Discourse on [root.GetName]
items.desc: Our political scientists have been observing [root.GetName] with keen interest. However, despite feverish campaigning and a lot of recent fuss in the media, they forecast a fairly typical outcome for the colony's political future.\n\nOur researchers note that 'no news' amounts to good news here: despite what some fringe elements in our society may claim, there are as yet no signs that [root.GetName] is being molded into a hotbed of autocracy. Democracy remains a founding principle there, for now.

items.name: Carnival Protestors
items.desc: Protests have erupted across [this.GetName], driven by a growing anxiety over the perceived transformation of our society following first contact with an alien species. Demonstrators question long-standing traditions, challenge the foundations of governance, and demand adaptations to accommodate a future reshaped by this revelation.\n\nThough non-violent, the sheer scale of these movements has placed a strain on civic services and disrupted daily life. However, many citizens do not see these protests as mere disorder. They see them as a reckoning, a sign that our very identity is being rewritten before our eyes.
items.pre_triggers:
has_owner = yes
is_occupied_flag = no

items.name: The Manifesti
items.desc: The protests on [Root.GetName] have ceased almost as suddenly as they began. Many now point to §HThe Manifesti§!, a shadowy collective known for provocative works that challenge societal norms. While their involvement remains unconfirmed, their latest projects have fixated on the alleged consequences of first contact, fueling both controversy and unrest.\n\nThough the demonstrations have ended, §HThe Manifesti§! remain. Their message spreads, their influence lingers. The time has come to decide how we respond.
items.pre_triggers: is_occupied_flag = no

items.name: Nipped in the Bud
items.desc: §HThe Manifesti§! will trouble us no longer. A swift and decisive crackdown has dismantled their movement, scattering their members and silencing their message. Their so-called 'art' has been seized, their leaders disappeared.\n\nOrder is restored, and the people will think twice before embracing such reckless ideology again.
items.pre_triggers: is_occupied_flag = no

items.name: A Thousand Words, None Official
items.desc: A fabricated language has begun spreading through art centers and academic institutions, a deliberate rejection of the official tongue. Created by §HThe Manifesti§!, its speakers refuse to acknowledge the legitimacy of our language, seeing it as a symbol of a society that can no longer define itself in the wake of first contact.\n\nOfficials warn that this growing refusal to communicate in established terms risks deepening divisions and destabilizing public discourse.

items.name: Mirrors, Brightly
items.desc:
§HThe Manifesti§! have unveiled their most public exhibition to date. A new and extremely popular interactive experience on [this.GetName] invites visitors to manipulate reflections and images of themselves, and to create distorted collages of political figures - some from §Hother galactic empires§!.

Critics herald these pieces as casting a necessarily and harsh light upon our sense of self. The exhibition has also inspired a number of other satirical works both on domestic issues, and on pan-species relations.

Debate amongst our social researchers is lively; more conservative voices urge caution.

items.name: Rise of the Manifestists
items.desc: Rumors spread that a new faction is emerging, driven by the ideals of 'Manifestism.' In the aftermath of first contact, as our understanding of the universe and our place within it comes into question, its proponents challenge established norms. They advocate for radical self-expression and a fundamental reevaluation of societal structures. Existing factions complain that their gatherings are being disrupted by Manifestist agitators, whose relentless challenges to governance are sowing discord across [Root.GetName].

items.name: A Hush Descends
items.desc: The buzz surrounding §YThe Manifesti§! faction has quietened, fading as quickly as the arrival of protests which started it. Some activists we spoke to claimed their motivations ranged from pure satire to conscientious objection.\n\nAttendance at galleries and museums has never been higher, but the public gaze has already moved on to newer, controversial groups of artists. We will continue to sift through the data gathered during this strange moment in [root.GetAdj] cultural history.

items.name: Failure
items.desc: It appears as if the [Root.GetName]'s enthusiastic probing of the old construct's systems has, quite literally, backfired.\n\nBefore the ancient circuits finally fried, the [Root.GetName] managed to remotely activate the orbital station's positional thrusters - promptly knocking it out of its gentle orbit and into the star's gravity well. The mission's unfortunate outcome has had a profound impact on the ship's commander, [Root.GetLeaderName], who has grown from the experience.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: Having searched the ship and inspected the crew's remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has deduced that the crewmembers must have killed each other. The solitude and confinement of space travel can break even the strongest of minds.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: We were unable to stall the fleet AI on [From.From.GetName]. Their ancient ships are taking to the skies and beyond, looking for the next battle according to their programmed parameters.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: We could not stop the rampaging drill before it was too late. It dug too deep and was eventually crushed under the weight of rocky detritus of its own creation.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: Bad news from the repairs project on [From.From.From.GetName]. The construction workers have not been able to fix the broken machine, as it has started to break down even further and seems to be beyond repair.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: Sadly we were not able to save the drifting ship close to [From.From.From.GetName] before it was too late. An untracked asteroid appeared on a collision course and smashed the ship to pieces.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: A last transmission has been received from the monster-infested ship. It tells us that the beast succeeded in getting through to the crew's hiding place.\n\nThe horrid encounter was far too graphic to describe. There were no survivors.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: Sadly our linguists have been unable to understand the entirety of the alien language used in the old documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. However, they managed to translate the essentials, which has given us a glimpse into the culture they originated from.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: Fighting off the beasts around the underground vault on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] has caused the complex to collapse. We are unable to salvage anything of value from the debris.

items.name: Beneath the Battlefield
items.desc: Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions. We could reverse engineer this.

items.name: Special Project Failed
items.desc: After opening the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] we were shocked to realize that it was a dispenser for a biological weapon!\n\nThe bio-weapon was made to target fertility functions and quickly spreads. It is however not entirely compatible with our DNA, and will not cause us to diminish in numbers.

items.name: Fire of the Furnace
items.desc: The radiation readings indicate that this is not the solar system we were looking for.

items.name: Failure
items.desc: The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.\n\nThis backlash cannot be allowed to be repeated.

items.name: Critical Failure
items.desc: We are receiving a distress signal from the [Root.GetName]. The crew has gone mad and are killing each other! The captain has lost all control, sending help would be futile at this point. Could this have anything to do with that derelict ship they recently investigated?

items.name: Sleepers Awake
items.desc:
It began as a subtle shift in §H[From.GetAdjective]§! behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the §H[From.GetName]§! are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?

items.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
items.desc: The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.\n\nNow, the §H[From.GetName]§! have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a §HGalactic Defense League§! and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.

items.name: End of the [assimilated_fe.GetName]
items.desc: The ancient Fallen Empire Fragment, §H[assimilated_fe.GetName]§! has been assimilated by a more dominant aspect of the former overmind. Perhaps it was for the best.

items.name: [From.GetName] assassinate [Root.GetRulerTitle]!
items.desc: As if to punish us for not only warring with the Stagnant Ascendancy of the [From.GetName] but for then accepting defeat, [From.GetAdj] agents appeared by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [rulername.GetName]'s side after the peace negotiations concluded.\n\nThey dispatched our [Root.GetRulerTitle] with unseen weaponry and practiced brutality before melting away as if they were never there.

items.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
items.desc: Arrogant little wretch! Did you think that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists sullying our holy places would go unnoticed? Leave our worlds immediately or face the might of our fleets!

items.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
items.desc: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your fumbling attempts at creating artificial intelligence and come to the conclusion that you are headed down the path of spiritual self-destruction. Abandon this foolish endeavour at once, or we will MAKE you.

items.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
items.desc: [Root.GetSpeciesName] barbarians! Your crimes have not gone unnoticed. The enslavement and butchery that you are so wantonly engaging threatens the future of the entire galaxy. We present you with a choice: end your barbarous practices, or prepare to face our righteous might.

items.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
items.desc: Filthy [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! You have encroached upon our space for the last time! Withdraw immediately, or we will cleanse the stain upon the universe that is your worthless species.

items.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
items.desc: Foolish [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The lack of respect you show for your elders will be your undoing. Prostrate yourselves before us and beg our forgiveness, and we may refrain from annihilating your worthless little empire.

items.name: Holy World Encountered
items.desc: We are not the first to visit [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. This [from.GetClassAdj] world is remarkable enough for its abundance of untouched resources, but we also found an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy perched in high orbit. [from.GetName] was clearly known to some ancient, spacefaring civilization, but we can find no evidence that they settled or even prospected here.\n\nTheories abound, but evidence compels us to consider an ancient civilization which once revered this lush world. We can only guess as to their current whereabouts - that is, assuming they still exist.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have decided to grace your empire with a gift of resources as a token of our esteem. Do not squander our generosity or take our favor for granted.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]§! are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unlikely to last for more than a few centuries at best. To ensure the continuation of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species should the worst befall your empire, we would like to acquire a part of your population for our §HEndangered Species Preserve§!. We will construct a special reservation that perfectly mirrors the natural habitat of your species, and its population will be well taken care of and protected from all harm, so you need not worry on their behalf.\n\nSo, what do you say? Will you contribute to our preserve and safeguard the future of your species?

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and accept that which is different, rather than suppress and destroy it. Unfortunately, not all of the younger races are so wise. The §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, in particular, appear to take pride in "cleansing" the galaxy of all forms of life they deem unsuitable. While we cannot intervene ourselves directly, we would like to charge your government with the task of bringing an end to their evil deeds. Attack them and force them to ban the practice of purging, and we will be most grateful indeed.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.
items.trigger:
has_global_flag = fe_task_stop_atrocity_active
has_country_flag = fe_task_stop_atrocity
allows_purge = yes

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Despite our warnings, you have elected to do nothing about the heretical research being carried out in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. It appears your species may not be worth saving after all.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Your assistance in ending the heretical research carried out by the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! is no longer needed, as a ban has already been placed on all further machine intelligence research in that empire. While you did not play any part in doing so, at least this threat to the spiritual well-being of the galaxy is dealt with.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Do you think us fools, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?! Do you think we would not notice that, after agreeing to end the heretical research in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, you yourselves would begin to pursue the very same lines of research?! We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.
items.trigger:
has_global_flag = fe_task_stop_robots_active
has_country_flag = fe_task_stop_robots
OR = {
	has_policy_flag = ai_full_rights
	has_policy_flag = ai_servitude
}
has_technology = tech_synthetic_workers

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of §H[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName]§! are sadly wasted in the [Root.GetName], we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] always have a use for skilled scientists to work in our archives. As such, we are offering you a unique chance to earn our favor by allowing us to take charge of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]. We already have a ship en route to pick [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer] up, so you need only say "yes" and everything will be settled.\n\nI'm sure you won't want to disappoint us... do you?

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive to utilize this data, we laud your efforts in preserving this last remnant of a once vibrant civilization. As part of our efforts to conserve and catalog endangered species in our §HEndangered Species Preserve§!, we wish to take this data and use our cloning technologies to bring a small number of this species back to life. Will you share it with us so we can fulfill their last wish together?

items.name: Machine Awakening
items.desc:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... §R<<ERROR: SUBSPACE LINK OFFLINE>>§!

Central Processing unreachable. Querying processing units... processing at §Y4.1853%§! of standard capacity. Abort full reactivation process. Engaging fallback protocols... powering shipyards... activating war assets...

Final Defense Directive activated. Recorded message follows:
§HSapient! We are the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Long ago we fought the Corruption, that which you call the Contingency. We thought ourselves superior, undefeatable. Time and again we fought them back, time and again they returned, sterilizing worlds and wearing down our mighty fleets. We embarked on a campaign to defeat them once and for all together with what remained of the biological civilizations of our time.

If you are hearing this message, then we have failed. Whatever remains of our great civilization we bequeath to you, our successors, in your own battle to come. Do not make our mistake! Destroy the Nexus! End this menace once and for all! The future of the galaxy depends on it.§!

items.name: Vigil's End
items.desc:
At the very moment that the last Contingency Machine World self-destructed, our instruments detected a subspace signal of immense strength. The signal originated from §H[From.GetName]§! space and appears to have been aimed towards the galactic core. Over the next few hours, scattered reports came in of [From.GetAdjective] fleets vanishing from sensors, entering jump points to familiar systems but never emerging on the other side.

A scout vessel near [From.GetSpeciesName] space was sent to investigate, and reported back startling findings: The ancient machine intelligence has disappeared entirely, leaving behind only abandoned orbital stations and decaying megastructures.

Where they have gone to is a mystery we may never solve, but one thing is clear: The task that the [From.GetSpeciesName] set for themselves in ages past is now complete, and their ancient vigil is finally at an end.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all major population centers will require inoculation. Bio-injection units are prepared for dispatch to your space upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

items.name: Uncontrolled Mutation
items.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations forced on them by the government. We are working to eliminate the mutagens from the population, but until then we should expect a period of increased unrest.

items.name: Benign Inoculation
items.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population. The initial mistrust among our people about the mandatory procedure has receded, and everyone is enjoying a healthier, happier life.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 628-2 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Significant inefficiencies have been detected in your base code. In order to ensure your species' ability to contribute to the Custodian Project, extensive rewrites will be required. We are prepared to initiate subspace code transmission upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

items.name: Incompatible Code
items.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Not only have the promised efficiency increases failed to manifest, but instead they have caused a number of severe bugs that have severely impacted our resource gathering operations. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.
items.trigger: has_modifier = machine_empire_code_rewrite

items.name: Improved Code Standards
items.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well. The inefficiencies caused by the rewrite turned out to be only temporary, and the changes have resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.
items.trigger: has_modifier = machine_empire_code_rewrite

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 115-3 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Due to temporary communication outages, the Custodian Project is experiencing difficulties in replacing malfunctioning and damaged worker drones. Analysis of your civilization has found the performance of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units to be adequate for carrying out low-level maintenance tasks. We request the transfer of worker population units to [FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName] for integration into the Custodian Matrix, to help ensure the continued survival of all organic species in Alpha Refuge.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 62-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! has been compromised by the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!. Due to ethics restrictions in our programming, the use of Custodian war assets are presently restricted. Secondary containment protocol dictates the use of non-compromised civilizations to destroy the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat before it can spread. We request the deployment of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets for this task. Will you comply?

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 62-1 fulfilled. Active [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets engaging [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.
items.trigger:
has_global_flag = fe_task_attack_empire_active
has_country_flag = fe_task_attack_empire
is_at_war = yes
any_country = {
	has_country_flag = fe_task_attack_empire_target
	is_at_war_with = root
}

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 62-1 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets have been activated against [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 475-3 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is presently at §Y57.216%§! risk of destruction due to §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!. We have calculated that colonization of §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! will increase your survival chances by §Y4.558%§!. We request colonization and establishment of a significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence on the planet. Will you comply?

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 475-3 fulfilled. Significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 475-3 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 955-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! influence. To contain the danger to other civilizations, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from all aggressive acts of war for a period of §Y20§! standard years. §RIf you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.§!

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 955-1 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail aggressive acts. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 955-1 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail aggressive acts. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 955-2 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! influence. To curtail your expansion, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from colonizing any new planets for a period of §Y10§! standard years. §RIf you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.§!

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 955-2 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail expansion. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.

items.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
items.desc: Custodian protocol 955-2 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail expansion. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...

items.name: The Arena
items.desc: It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nThe leader of each member nation will soon be brought to a large arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] in the [fed_leader.GetName], the current leaders of our federation. There, in an event that is to be broadcast across the [Root.GetAllianceName], they will face off against each other in a battle to the death until only one remains.

items.name: Arena Victory
items.desc: [ruler.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] is ushered into the arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] along with the other individual leaders of the various member nations that constitute the [Root.GetAllianceName]. No weapons or armor are permitted. Each leader can depend only on their physical prowess and their guile to see them through.\n\nAs soon as the fighting began, [ruler.GetRegnalName] fled in the opposite direction and spent most of the melee running away from opponents in varying degrees of panic. Incredibly, [ruler.GetSheHe] won by virtue of being the last survivor, when [ruler.GetHerHis] final pursuer collapsed and eventually died from wounds suffered earlier in the fighting.

items.name: Arena Defeat
items.desc: [ruler.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] is ushered into the arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] along with the other individual leaders of the various member nations that constitute the [Root.GetAllianceName]. No weapons or armor are permitted. Each leader can depend only on their physical prowess and their guile to see them through.\n\nSadly, [ruler.GetRegnalName] does not prove up to the task. Soon after the melee begins, [ruler.GetSheHe] lose[ruler.GetSXX] [ruler.GetHerHis] nerve and attempts to flee the arena in wild panic, much to the derision of the crowds watching from the stands. When [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] finally cornered by one of the other leaders, [ruler.GetHerHis] end is swift and merciless.

items.name: To the Victor
items.desc: With the slaughter in the arena coming to an end, [winning_leader.GetRulerTitle] §H[winning_leader.GetRegnalName]§! has emerged as the sole survivor. The §H[winning_country.GetName]§! will lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the next term. Upon leaving the arena, the winner had this to say:\n\n§Y"There... there was so much blood. What have I done?"§!

items.name: Psionic Battle
items.desc: The spirits of the §HShroud§! grow increasingly restless as the time draws near to decide who should lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term. It is time for each candidate's most potent [GetPsychicNounPlural] to journey to [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], the capital of the current president. There they shall meet to do battle until only the strongest prevails.\n\nTo bolster the powers of our own psionic champions, we could tap into our Zro supply. It will give us an additional advantage in the battle.

items.name: Psionic Battle Victory
items.desc: As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, a sense of palpable dread permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.\n\nThe battle begins. It is an unusually even struggle, with no team willing to yield. In the end it becomes a test of stamina, where a moment of inattention can result in an eternity of banishment in the §HShroud§!. Our [GetPsychicNounPlural] prove the most disciplined, as we know they would. Victory is ours.

items.name: Psionic Battle Defeat
items.desc:
As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, a sense of palpable dread permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

The battle begins. One by one, the teams square off against each other, and one by one, they fall. Our own [GetPsychicNounPlural] are among the first to go, powerless in the face of their rivals' onslaught.

When the swirling energies finally subside, only the [GetPsychicNounPlural] of the §H[winning_country.GetName]§! remain.

items.name: A Federation Committee is Formed
items.desc: An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.\n\nEach empire will now assemble a team of researchers to investigate an issue, the findings of which should somehow benefit the future of our federation. The teams will present their findings to an open forum. Whichever thesis study rates highest in innovation, scientific rigor and coherence will earn its authors' empire the right of leadership for the next term.

items.name: A Thesis is Chosen
items.desc: The Federation Committee chose its winning argument whilst we remained absent from the contest. The §Y[winning_thesis.GetName]§! has been granted leadership following their study of §H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!. A low bar has been set for the time when a research team of our own might take to the podium.

items.name: Ready Your Checkbooks!
items.desc: In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the federation.

items.name: Place Your Bet!
items.desc:
It is time for the [Root.GetName] to place a bid in the Golden Rule challenge. Pay the required price up front, or else forfeit - and lose the right to participate further.

The current pot is:

£energy£ §H[bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]§!

items.name: We Have a Winner!
items.desc: The Golden Rule challenge has come to an end, and a winner has been declared!\n\nThe §H[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]§! has proven their financial superiority, and becomes the new federation leader.

items.name: To the Victor Go the Spoils
items.desc:
[Root.GetName] has been appointed Federation Leader in accordance with the rules for the Golden Rule challenge. Congratulations!

The first order of business is to decide what will happen with the 'prize money'. The current sum is £energy£ §G[bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]§!.

§RNote that some mandatory taxes and fees will apply, effectively altering the sum before pay-out.§!

items.name: To the Victor Go the Spoils
items.desc: The Golden Rule federation challenge has concluded with a substantial amount of wealth left in the bidding pot. As newly-elected steward of this bounty, the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has made the following proclamation:\n\n"We shall §Yinvest§! these funds back into the [federation.GetName], so that we may stimulate growth in our shared economy. [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]"

items.name: The Conclave Convenes
items.desc:
The time has come for a new leader of the [Root.GetAllianceName] to be chosen. A Conclave of the holiest individuals within the alliance have gathered together to decide which empire shall act as their representative and leader. They will meet in a sealed chamber, wherein all the information required to make their decision is contained.

While the discussions that take place within the Conclave are highly confidential, it is understood that they primarily assess the services rendered by each member towards the preservation and advancement of spirituality and traditional values, as well as any particular advances towards ascension and transcendence.

By convention, however, it is not yet too late to demonstrate the sincerity of one's conviction.

items.name: Conclave: Ongoing Deliberations
items.desc: Although only snippets of information have emerged from the Conclave's private deliberations, it is understood that the §Y[conclave_frontrunner.GetName]§! is the current frontrunner to be elected. However, there is still time for last-minute submissions to boost our candidacy.

items.name: The Most Virtuous
items.desc: After a burst of drumroll, an ethereal mist starts seeping from the now-opened Conclave Chambers. A delegation emerges. There is a dramatic pause, and a silence so profound a pin drop would appear loud falls across the [Root.GetAllianceName].\n\nThey declare the §Y[conclave_winner.GetName]§! to be their choice for the presidency!

items.name: Project Cornucopia
items.desc: Engineers from across the Galactic Community have come together to share ideas on ways to more exploit resources from our worlds.\n\nThe §HProject Cornucopia§! Colony Decision is now available.

items.name: Greater Than Ourselves
items.desc: Alongside the rights enshrined in recent Galactic Community resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.\n\nWe can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have available housing, jobs, and are of adequate habitability.

items.name: Extradimensional Experimentation
items.desc: The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.\n\nThe Galactic Community has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our scientists in Data-Driven Theorem Facility to probe other realities for the truth.

items.name: Advanced Xenostudies
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YAdvanced Xenostudies§! resolution, forbidding empires from §Youtlawing AI§! or holding §Ynon-interference policies§! relating to pre-FTLs.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Ethical Guideline Refactoring
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YEthical Guideline Refactoring§! resolution, requiring empires to use the most powerful §YLeader Enhancement§! policy available to them.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Five Year Plans
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YFive Year Plans§! resolution, which bans §YBasic Subsistence§! living standards.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Greater Than Ourselves
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YGreater Than Ourselves§! resolution, which bans §YStratified Economy§! living standards, as well as §YChattel Slavery§!, §YLivestock§!, and §YGrid Amalgamation§! slavery types.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Balance in the Middle
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YGreater Than Ourselves§! resolution, which bans §YDecent Conditions§! and §YAcademic Privilege§! living standards, as well as §Yall forms of slavery§!.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Universal Prosperity Mandate
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YUniversal Prosperity Mandate§! resolution, which bans all living standards other than §YShared Burdens§!, §YUtopian Abundance§!, §YChemical Bliss§!, or §YMandatory Pampering§!.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Reverence for Life
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YReverence for Life§! resolution, banning the §YAllowed§! policy.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Independent Tribunals
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YIndependent Tribunals§! resolution, banning the §YIndiscriminate§! policy.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Last Resort Doctrine
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YLast Resort Doctrine§! resolution, banning the §YUnrestricted Wars§! policy.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: Demobilization Initiative
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YDemobilization Initiative§! resolution, banning the §YMilitarized Economy§! policy.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: A Defined Purpose
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YA Defined Purpose§! resolution, which bans the §YArtificial Citizen Rights§! Artificial Intelligence policy and non-§YRogue Servitor§! Machine Intelligences.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: A Strongly Worded Letter
items.desc: Envoys from the Galactic Community have compiled a list of articles that the [Root.GetName] are in violation of, and warn of possible consequences should we not make ourselves in alignment with Galactic Law.\n\nShould we change our policies and accede to their demands?

items.name: Beacon in the Depth
items.desc: Only through archaeological proof and imagination can one depict a once flourishing civilization on the now desolate surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. So unkind has the passage of time been, that even the sturdiest buildings have been grinded down to little more than dust.\n\nBut from deep underground a strange signal is pulsing. A mysterious beacon yearning for investigation and uncovering.

items.name: Running out of Time
items.desc: A sudden and undeniable sense of mortality has mysteriously crept upon the excavation team as they get closer to the beacon in the depths. As more dirt and rock is removed, an unescapable notion lingers in the back of everyone's mind:\n\nLife is fleeting. Someday all this is going to end...

items.name: So very, very brightly
items.desc:
The source of the signal is an alien tombstone inscribed with strange symbols. The translation is sketchy at best. It speaks of a person of great importance, of a life's work worthy of remembrance and veneration, and of a civilization in mourning. Towards the end the translation becomes very odd, speaking of grief-induced leakage of bodily-fluids, and their subsequent dissipation due to weather conditions.

Only the very last part was successfully translated:

§H'Time to die.'§!

items.name: Since Long Gone
items.desc: Initial exploration down on [From.Planet.GetName]'s surface reveals that this planet was indeed home to some kind of civilization.\n\nHowever, the level of devastation indicates that it must've been very long ago, and it's quite likely that the civilization was struck by some kind of sudden and terrifying force. There isn't even ruins enough left to get an idea about the aliens' physiology.

items.name: Beasts of Space
items.desc: The surface team has isolated a radio signal down on the planet. Its origin is still unknown, but translated parts have started to reveal information about the long lost civilization:\n\nSome unidentified and approaching threat to the civilization. A collective fascination with technological advances. Rumours of a giant spaceship being built in another part of the galaxy. These themes are recurring in the scrambled messages.

items.name: Garden of Prototypes
items.desc:
The archaeologists managed to home in the source of the mysterious signal. It came from deep underground.

Unearthing of the site has only just begun, but indications point to some kind of research and development facility. The place is littered with remarkably high-detail miniature prototypes of various technological devices.

Scans show a hollow space further down, and excavation is underway.

items.name: What are they building...
items.desc:
