items.desc: Efforts at connecting on an emotional level with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! have proven catastrophic.\n\nOur [This.Owner.GetLinguists] failed to demonstrate an understanding of their culture, and as a result, we have greatly offended them!

items.name: The Verdict
items.desc:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! shuttle injured, but victorious.

From a hidden door, an alien fighter emerged and proceeded to batter our [Owner.GetEnvoy] to the point of exhaustion. Summoning a last surge of strength, [Leader.GetName] managed to subdue [Leader.GetHisHer] opponent.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"[Leader.GetName] will be entered into our annals as a great warrior."

items.name: Hostilities at First Contact
items.desc: Clearly, our response was not the appropriate one: the response of the §Y[contact_country.GetName]§! was swift and hostile, as they began firing on our ships. It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

items.name: War Chant Backfires
items.desc: It appears the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! took offense to our battle chant. Their response was instantaneous - and violent. They began firing, and our vessel was fortunate to escape unharmed. It seems we have a fight on our hands!

items.name: Hostilities at First Contact
items.desc: It is not clear what went wrong, but the §Y[contact_country.GetName]§! are suddenly attacking us! It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

items.name: Alien Materials Studied
items.desc: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the §H[contact_country.GetName]§!. Although investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate, faster progress could be made once communications were opened with the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our [Root.GetResearchers] were able to study their §Htechnology§!, which has helped us uncover several novel new approaches to our own research problems.

items.name: Alien Study Complete
items.desc: We have concluded our study of the §H[contact_country.GetAdj]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know a great deal about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable §Hxenobiological data§!.\n\nDriven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

items.name: Interrogations Complete
items.desc: We have concluded our study of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them, eventually gaining access to their computer systems once one of the more cooperative hostages cracked.\n\nThanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we are able to identify them as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

items.name: The Invitation
items.desc: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! drew alongside our fleet, broadcasting a repeating signal.\n\nIt was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.

items.name: Mise En Place
items.desc: With a little bit of guesswork, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] accepted the alien cultural exchange invitation. We interpreted the enthusiastic response from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as positive. Shortly after, they sent pictographs depicting a countdown to the party.\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is using the remaining time to prepare and further study the language samples we have obtained.

items.name: Pre-Game
items.desc: The countdown to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! cultural exchange event is nearing completion. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is about to board the shuttle to the alien envoy ship. Communication with our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] will pause for the duration of the party out of respect.

items.name: Second Chances
items.desc: Our lack of interest in their invitation has offended the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Their tone has dramatically changed. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translated some hostile language within their follow-up communication.\n\nIt seems they do not want to take no for an answer.

items.name: Espionage Blunder
items.desc:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation failed.

During the event, the hosts found an espionage device. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] was interrogated, scolded and then asked to leave. Using the data from the back-up spy tech, we now understand their language and technology, although our diplomatic future will start on rocky ground.

items.name: Scan Complete
items.desc:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation was a success. Not only did they successfully decipher most of the alien language, but our scan has given us a clear picture of their technological capabilities.

This will greatly enhance further relations with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, without them being aware of our understanding of their scientific knowledge.

items.name: Life Of The Party
items.desc: Entering the multi-day event with an open mind, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] joined in musical, theater, and dance performances and explored various culinary traditions. Their receptiveness to experience was met enthusiastically by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with an intimate understanding of their language and a deep appreciation of their culture. Their experience will pave the way to more positive diplomatic interactions with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

items.name: Threw In The Towel
items.desc: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] spent the multi-day event reservedly observing artistic shows and sampling the culinary traditions. The lack of enthusiasm frustrated the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. According to our understanding of their language, our envoy was considered boring.\n\nEscorted back to their shuttle and signaled to leave, our envoy has left with competence in their language and a surface understanding of their culture, something we can build upon for future diplomatic interactions.

items.name: Hungry For Connection
items.desc: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s disappointment in the difference between our nutritional needs couldn't have been more apparent over the multi-day event. Thankfully [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] did their best to take an active part in the entertainment events, and mutual respect was established.\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with a decent understanding of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s language and culture. To their credit, they seemed to take this culinary mishap in stride, and have provided us with a number of etiquette manuals. While tedious, this knowledge should help smooth future diplomatic interactions.

items.name: No Means No
items.desc: The second rejection by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! to invite us to their ship was met with a strong emotional response. We received communication from multiple alien crew members for several hours, in what our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe was an attempt to guilt us for not attending.\n\nThese communications, along with intercepted signals from their ship, have allowed us to decipher enough of their language to have a working understanding. We can now initiate more appropriate diplomatic connections, although they have taken this initial incident negatively.

items.name: Draconic Communications
items.desc: Following our successes in establishing communications with a number of alien species, one of our leading [This.Owner.GetLinguists] has brought forth a radical proposal. Though past efforts to communicate with the Sky Dragon have failed miserably, [needed_name.GetSheHe] argue[needed_name.GetSXX] that now is the time to make another attempt.\n\nAccording to our earliest histories, there was a fabled Accord between [This.Owner.Species.GetName] and Dragon, after which direct conflict ceased. Citing this as proof that understanding on some level is possible, [needed_name.GetSheHe] note[needed_name.GetSXX] that our recent experiences with utterly alien lifeforms make us better equipped than ever before to understand the drake.

items.name: The Guest
items.desc:
The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of §Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has thrown the capital into disarray. The creature seems as perplexed as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without resistance.

We suspect the creature to be of alien nature, but we can't discount the possibility of it being an unknown species native to our world. After all, no alien ship has been detected in orbit. The creature - codenamed §HThe Guest§! - materialized out of nowhere, seemingly unassisted by technology.

Our confusing (and confused) visitor is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

items.name: Contact With MSI
items.desc: Contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName]. It's imperative that we navigate the evolving situation carefully. An envoy should be be dispatched to represent our interests. Any interaction with our former masters is sure to have a profound psychological effect on our people.

items.name: Clear Signal Found
items.desc: Our sensors have detected a particularly clear repeating signal from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! that seems to offer our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] excellent material for codifying their language. They are optimistic that we will be able to make some significant progress on the back of this stroke of luck.

items.name: A Lack of Signal
items.desc: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are becoming increasingly frustrated at our failure to provide them with sufficient material to make progress on decoding the language used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. It seems these particular aliens are doing their utmost to prevent their signals from being heard by the wrong [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]!

items.name: Mistaken Identification
items.desc: It seems our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have suffered a major §Hsetback§! in their attempts at codifying the language used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Unfortunately, what they had taken to be their language quite simply was not a language. In [This.Leader.GetHerHis] report, [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] states that, after days of investigating the matter from every angle, the [This.Owner.GetLinguists] finally concluded that it was in fact probably an attempt at music...

items.name: [This.ContactCountry.GetName] Scan [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]
items.desc: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has scanned §H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Opinion is divided on whether we should treat this shock as a springboard to boost efforts to establish closer ties with alien civilizations, or whether it should be taken as a warning and that we must make sure our fleet is in good order now, before it is too late.

items.name: [This.ContactCountry.GetName] Capital Discovered
items.desc: We have identified the colony we recently scanned in the §H[This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName]§! system to be the capital of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have found many valuable clues about them by investigating the data we gathered from the scan.

items.name: Trail Goes Cold
items.desc: We have caught neither sight nor sound of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! for some time now. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] find they have little information to go on and worry that the trail may have gone cold.

items.name: The Delight of the Unknown
items.desc: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has proven delightful to the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public, who are now impatient to make closer acquaintance with these aliens.

items.name: A Terrible Sight to Behold
items.desc: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has provoked widespread dismay amongst our populace, who have taken to describing them as §H"repulsive [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]"§!. Already, many are demanding that we take action to deal with the new "[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass] threat"...

items.name: Confusing Signals
items.desc: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have been making steady progress gathering together a large collection of signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. However, as our knowledge of their language has grown, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have become ever more confused. Apparently, they have had to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, §Hextremely inaccurate§!. It seems that the whole outlook of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is very different to ours - far more than we could possibly have imagined!

items.name: Swift Translations
items.desc: As we have gathered more material on the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

items.name: Mistaken Translations
items.desc: Our attempts to decode the language used in the signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!  have hit a setback. It seems that a key assumption our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] had been relying on in their translations has been §Hconclusively disproven§!. While this means much of our progress will have to be revised, at least our future efforts will hopefully be built upon a more reliable basis.

items.name: Steady Progress
items.desc: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have recently made significant progress towards decoding the language used in the signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Apparently they now believe themselves to have a solid grasp of its fundamentals and promise that they will be able to report further findings soon.

items.name: Clear Signal Detected
items.desc: We had struggled to gather enough information on the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to have much to go, but now our efforts have received a major boost: our sensors have picked up a lengthy exchange between several of their ships. We can only assume their guard slipped for a moment, or perhaps their technology is not as advanced as we had suspected and they thought their channel to be secure...

items.name: Communication Obfuscation
items.desc: The language of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! contains millions of seemingly redundant sounds, apparently dialectic hangovers from their precursor civilizations. When translated, these apparently superfluous filler words seem to serve no purpose other than to add linguistic flavor - or at most have only minor contextual implications.\n\nThankfully, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have narrowed down the obsolete aspects of their language, and are now compiling an abridged lexicon which should prove very useful for efficient communication with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

items.name: Spirit Cultivation
items.desc: Our spirits have been elevated. With the guidance of our most enlightened Priests, [Owner.GetAdj] society has attained new heights of spiritual cultivation. A widespread sense of wholeness and insight pervades our culture.\n\nIn this moment of enlightenment, it behooves us to channel our divine energy into a particular purpose, for the benefit of all the [Owner.GetName].

items.name: Enlightenment of [this.GetName]
items.desc: Our spiritual cultivation has brought blessings upon the [this.owner.GetName].\n\nThrough concerted meditative practice, §H[this.GetTitle] [this.GetName]§! has refined their inner spirit, casting off an impediment to their [this.GetLeaderAdj] attainment.

items.name: Enlightenment of [this.GetName]
items.desc: Our spiritual cultivation has brought blessings upon the [this.owner.GetName].\n\nThrough concerted meditative practice, §H[this.GetTitle] [this.GetName]§! has refined their inner spirit, allowing a previously latent talent to emerge into being.

items.name: Surge of Enlightenment
items.desc: Our spiritual cultivation has brought blessings upon the [this.owner.GetName].\n\nThrough sustained meditative practice, our leaders have experienced a surge of enlightenment. They lead with divine insight, and their elevated spirits are manifest in their wise and masterful actions.

items.name: Enlightenment on [this.GetName]
items.desc: Our spiritual cultivation has brought blessings upon the [this.owner.GetName].\n\nBy its thoroughgoing commitment to meditative practice, the population on §H[this.GetName]§! has achieved new heights of enlightenment. This devotional achievement has elevated the [this.GetPlanetMoon]'s potential for both worldly prosperity and spiritual calmness.

items.name: Miracle Child Born
items.desc:
Our spiritual cultivation has brought blessings upon the [this.owner.GetName].

Since the moment of [miracle_child.GetHisHer] birth, the baby named §H[miracle_child.GetName]§! has shown powerful signs of spiritual enlightenment, rapidly gaining a reputation as a 'miracle child'.

It is our sacred duty to nurture [miracle_child.GetHimHer] as a leader among our kind.

items.name: Divine Specimen Acquired
items.desc: Our spiritual cultivation has brought blessings upon the [this.owner.GetName].\n\nAn artisan of devotional objects on [capital_planet.GetName] has completed the §HHoly Symbol§!, a pinnacle of sacred craftsmanship. Forged from an alloy of precious metals, its many points of direction represent the spiritual journey of the enlightened mind.

items.name: §H[from.GetName]§! Adopted
items.trigger: is_country_type = default

items.name: New Ideological Authority
items.desc:
We are now the Ideological Authority of §HIdeology§!.

The theoretical development of our adopted ideology had been stagnating under the custodianship of the [FromFrom.GetName]. After long deliberation, we have now taken their place as doctrinal leaders.

It is our responsibility to continue the codification of the ideology's tenets.

items.name: New Ideological Authority
items.desc:
We are no longer the Ideological Authority of §HIdeology§!.

For some time, foreign adherents had claimed that the ideology's theoretical development had stagnated under [Root.GetAdj] custodianship. After significant pressure, we were forced to allow the §H[From.GetName]§! to take our place as doctrinal leaders.

It is now their responsibility to continue the codification of the ideology's tenets.

items.name: A New Follower
Ideological Influence Contested
items.desc:
The growing influence of a foreign ideology is interfering with our efforts to spread §HIdeology§!.

Known as §H[From.GetName]§!, it encompasses a broadly [From.GetEthicLower] worldview. Many of its core principles relate to entirely different considerations to our own fundamental values.

Foreign media transmissions of content which advocates for this ideology have been detected in a number of systems.

If we do not take action to counter this external propaganda it could one day reach our population, with unpredictable consequences for the [Root.GetName].

items.name: Rise of an Ideology
items.trigger:
has_force_of_will_dlc = yes
is_gestalt = no
NOT = {
	has_country_flag = ideology_emergence_offered
}
can_generate_ideology = yes
can_found_ideology_from_ai_personality = yes
fanatic_faction_exists = yes

items.name: Alien Ideology
items.trigger:
is_gestalt = yes
can_initiate_ideology = yes

items.name: Codifying Instinct
items.trigger:
is_ai = no
can_generate_ideology = yes

items.name: Death of [from.GetRegnalName]
items.desc: After years of dignified service, our §H[GetFoW1250RulerTitle] [from.GetRegnalName]§! has perished. We now face the matter of succession.\n\nIt falls to [from.GetRegnalName]'s inner circle to choose a new [this.GetHeirTitle] from among their own kin - someone who can rule the [this.GetName] wisely, and in accordance with the principles of Ideology.

items.name: [from.GetClubNameCap] on the Rise
items.desc: Inspired by the growing popularity of §H[from.GetName]§!, our citizens are joining [from.GetClubName] in record numbers, eager to deepen their commitment to our society's most fundamental values.\n\nAll across the [this.GetName], this surge in memberships is leading to newfound levels of social harmony and ideological alignment.

items.name: New Insights on [this.GetLastTenetName]
[from.GetEthic] Monument Built
items.desc:
The inhabitants of [selected_planet.GetName] have self-organized to construct a monument celebrating their growing dedication to the values of §H[from.GetName]§!.

The construction was facilitated by private donors and completed in record time by a highly motivated network of skilled individuals, youth groups and social clubs, united by their commitment to our shared beliefs.

They are now requesting the presence of government officials for the monument's opening ceremony.

items.name: Citizen Parade
items.desc: Many of our citizens recently participated in the organization and staging of a mass 'Unity Day', celebrating the core values of §H[from.GetName]§! through a series of parades and festivals.\n\nThese huge gatherings took place in many of our most populous cities, as [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] came together to affirm their support for the fundamental tenets of our shared culture and societal outlook.

items.name: Leader Recruitment Boom
items.desc: High levels of trust and confidence in §H[from.GetName]§! are inspiring ever more of our population to aspire to leadership positions. Recruitment offices are inundated with applications.\n\nThese idealistic new candidates are motivated primarily by a desire to contribute to the future success of the [this.GetName], rather than personal ambition or financial gain.

items.name: Corruption on the Decline
items.trigger: can_trigger_forceofwill_1600_event = yes

items.name: Golden Age of [from.GetName]
items.desc: Our adoption of §H[from.GetName]§! appears to have borne fruit. Our impartial analysts have drawn numerous correlations between increased engagement and positive trends in our society.\n\nMany are even calling this a 'golden age' of [from.GetName] that will bring us ever closer in ideological harmony.

items.name: Donation Surge
items.desc: Ever-growing numbers of our citizens are choosing to donate their private assets to the state, motivated by a strong desire to give back to our society and support the propagation of §H[from.GetName]§! in the future.\n\nThese acts of giving typically occur during dates of national significance for [this.GetName], or sometimes through bequests upon death.

items.name: Trade Boom
Radical Nonconformity
items.desc: A freethinking organization on [this.Capital.GetName] has been disseminating ideas that challenge the core principles of §H[from.GetName]§!. It began as an informal discussion group between civilian researchers, before gradually developing into a small publishing and media operation.\n\nAlthough their public pronouncements are carefully worded to align with official policy, the substance of their ideas stands in clear opposition to our long-established values. Despite their limited influence, they represent a strong opposition to our state ideology.

items.name: Protests on [this.Capital.GetName]
Economic Downturn
items.desc:
Financial analysts have reported clear signs of economic stagnation throughout the [this.GetName].

Declining adherence to §H[from.GetName]§! has created ideological rifts between workers, and fostered a general climate of social discordance, impacting investor confidence.

Specialists fear that continued defection from our state ideology could lead to full-blown recession.

items.name: Assassination Attempt
items.desc:
§H[assassination_attempt_leader.GetTitle] [assassination_attempt_leader.GetName]§! narrowly survived an assassination attempt on [assassination_attempt_leader.GetHisHer] life, carried out by a radical dissident group.

Though the perpetrators were neutralized by our security forces, their improvised explosive device still detonated and left [assassination_attempt_leader.GetName] with severe injuries.

The shocking incident has further highlighted the growing dangers posed by internal opponents from within the [this.GetName], radicalized by their rejection of §H[from.GetName]§!.
items.trigger: can_trigger_forceofwill_1670_event = yes

items.name: Government Corruption
items.desc: Some of our leaders are increasingly motivated by a desire to abuse their authority for personal enrichment rather than putting the values of §H[from.GetName]§! into practice for the benefit of [this.GetAdj] society.\n\nAs their idealism gives way to cynicism, bribery and corruption are on the rise, blighting the legislative and administrative efficacy of the [this.GetName].
items.trigger: can_trigger_forceofwill_1680_event = yes

items.name: Dissident Leader
items.desc: §H[dissident_leader.GetTitle] [dissident_leader.GetName]§! has become openly dissident, questioning the core values of §H[from.GetName]§! at every opportunity and actively seeking to obstruct their propagation in government.\n\nAlthough [dissident_leader.GetName] remains an otherwise capable and respected leader, it is clear that when principles are at stake, [dissident_leader.GetHeShe] will go against [from.GetName] at every turn.
items.trigger: can_trigger_forceofwill_1690_event = yes

items.name: Terrorist Attack on [attacked_colony.GetName]
items.desc:
A large-scale, coordinated terrorist attack has taken place on §H[attacked_colony.GetName]§!.

In the space of a few minutes, explosive devices were detonated in various locations, killing many and inflicting costly structural damage. One major building was utterly destroyed.

An anti-[from.GetEthicLower] group has already claimed responsibility for the attacks, justifying their actions by opposition to §H[from.GetName]§!. Although the majority reaction has been condemnation, the group is not without its sympathizers.
items.trigger: can_trigger_forceofwill_1700_event = yes

items.name: [assassinated_leader.GetName] Assassinated
items.trigger: can_trigger_forceofwill_1710_event = yes

items.name: Threatened Defection
items.desc:
§H[defecting_fleet.leader.GetTitle] [defecting_fleet.leader.GetName]§! is threatening to defect from the [this.GetName] and take the §H[defecting_fleet.GetName]§! with [defecting_fleet.leader.GetHimHer].

Transmitting on an open channel, [defecting_fleet.leader.GetName] denounced §H[from.GetName]§!, describing our state ideology as 'a pernicious influence on [this.GetAdj] society' that [defecting_fleet.leader.GetHeShe] could 'no longer serve with honor and integrity' in its current state. [defecting_fleet.leader.GetHeSheCap] insisted that the ideology 'must rediscover its original virtues.'

Private communications from [defecting_fleet.leader.GetHisHer] subordinates indicate that crewmembers will follow [defecting_fleet.leader.GetFirstName] willingly.
items.trigger: can_trigger_forceofwill_1720_event = yes

items.name: Deviant Impulses Weaken
Cognitive Efficiency
items.desc: The logical architecture of §H[from.GetName]§! has simplified the work of our §HCognitive Node§! and liberated its capacity for other uses.\n\nCodifying explanatory theoretical frameworks when facing unfamiliar external phenomena no longer presents difficulty for our Cognitive Node. Aided by the tenets of [from.GetName], knowledge production efficiency is greatly increased.

items.name: Regulative Efficiency
Nonstandard Thinking
items.desc: While referring to the tenets of §H[from.GetName]§! for correct procedure, semi-autonomous individual [selected_leader.GetName] began generating original ideas independent of the [this.GetBrainName].\n\nThese cognitive processes were swiftly halted, and the deviant thoughts compartmentalized from the [this.GetNetworkName] to avoid dissonance. Our [this.GetResearchers] have determined that these new concepts could benefit the collective, but merging thoughts of noncentral origin presents obvious risk.

items.name: System Crash
items.desc: Severe logic errors caused by conflicting ideological arguments in our core systems are resulting in frequent outages across the [this.GetSpeciesAdj] network.\n\nPropositions associated with §H[from.GetName]§!, which support multiple decision-making subroutines, are regularly failing regression testing. The disruption is negatively affecting the efficiency of our units in all daily tasks.

items.name: Neural Pain
items.desc: Traumatic neural pain is afflicting the collective as it processes increased ideological dissonance.\n\nThe principles of §H[from.GetName]§! once bolstered clarity in the mindweave, but now spread uncertainty and incoherence. The resulting neural overload is leaving significant numbers of drones incapacitated.

items.name: Catatonic Drones
items.desc: Our individuals are failing to successfully complete daily tasks due to procedural uncertainty triggered by ideological dissonance.\n\nOften discovered in catatonic states, individuals become caught between two contradictory propositions for the next appropriate action. Without a coherent ideological framework for resolving this uncertainty, our thought progression will continue to break down on a large scale.

items.name: Nodal Overload
Absolute Ideology
items.desc: The depth of our commitment to §HIdeology§! has prompted a reflection on the importance of Ideology in the governance of our society. We now see that it would be possible to embody these principles absolutely.\n\nBy systematically reorganizing the workings of our state, we could ensure that every aspect of [this.GetAdj] existence serves as a perfect expression of our single most fundamental value. To achieve this, interfering ideas must be eradicated from thought and practice.

items.name: Absolute Ideology Established
items.desc: Guided by the core tenets of §HIdeology§!, we have completed the transformation of our governance systems to ensure that they are exclusively informed by [ideology.GetEthicLower] principles at all times.\n\nEvery aspect of our society's function now reflects the purest distillation of our most fundamental [ideology.GetEthicLower] values.
items.trigger:
exists = ideology
is_absolute = no

items.name: Instinctive Perfection
Fanatic Faction Emerges
items.desc: Through its increasingly zealous demands, §H[from.GetName]§! has become fanaticized. Their proclamations and discourse reflect a vehemently radical worldview.

items.name: Galactic Hall Proposed
Spreading Our Message
items.desc: Our communications infrastructure has begun dissemination of a broad range of media content to neighboring star nations, presenting the guiding principles of §HIdeology§!.\n\nAdapted to local languages and cultural sensibilities, these materials are intended to foster awareness of the [Ideology.GetEthicLower] ideals upon which the [Root.GetName] is built.

items.name: Deepening Convictions
items.desc:
Instruction in the principles of §HIdeology§! continues to spread throughout neighboring star nations as newly converted populations begin applying its values to every aspect of public and private life.

Guided by our example, they are reevaluating long-held assumptions concerning family, interpersonal relations, civic duty, and even mortality itself.

Increasingly, they have come to see that the wisdom of Ideology may be applied to all facets of existence.

items.name: Fallen Empire Provoked
items.desc: The successful spread of §HIdeology§! across the galaxy has provoked a hostile response from a §HFallen Empire§!. Threatened by the rising influence of our ideology, they have declared war upon all followers of Ideology.

items.name: Fallen Empire Provoked
items.desc: The successful spread of §HIdeology§! across the galaxy has provoked a hostile response from a §HFallen Empire§!. Threatened by the rising influence of our ideology, they have declared war upon all followers of Ideology.

items.name: Galactic Utopia
Galactic Utopia
items.desc: The overwhelming influence of Ideology is now beyond dispute.\n\nUnder the guidance of §HIdeology§!, we have played our part in ensuring the core values of our ideology are almost universally upheld across the entire galaxy.

items.name: Ideological Supremacy
items.desc: The overwhelming influence wielded by the §H[From.GetName]§! and their doctrine of Ideology is now indisputable. Across neighboring star nations, their values have taken root with alarming thoroughness.\n\nReluctantly, we must acknowledge that the galaxy will be shaped according to their vision of the future.

items.name: Indisputable Dominance
items.desc: Our efforts to spread the teachings of Ideology across the galaxy have faltered in the face of the overwhelming influence wielded by the §H[From.GetName]§! and their doctrine of Ideology. Throughout neighboring star nations, their values have taken root too deeply for our message to prevail.\n\nReluctantly, we must abandon our hopes of guiding the galaxy toward our vision of the future.

items.name: Targets Identified
items.desc:
Our operatives have completed in-depth psychological profiling of senior officers in charge of the [target.GetName]'s largest fleet, identifying those most likely to be open to the ideals of Ideology.

We believe that converting this leadership group to our cause will be sufficient to secure the fleet's defection to the [owner.GetName].

Our intelligence agents are now designing personalized message campaigns to educate them in the essential truths of our ideology.

items.name: Communications in Progress
items.desc: Our operatives have begun targeting [target.GetAdj] fleet officers through both direct and indirect communications designed to introduce them to the principles of Ideology.\n\nInitial reports are encouraging, with targets displaying openness to [owner.ideology.GetEthicLower] ideas and a willingness to entertain new perspectives and modes of thought.

items.name: Grand Ambitions
items.desc: Although neighboring star nations now regard us as the foremost authority of [FromFrom.GetName], we should do well to remain wary of the ambitions of others.\n\nThe §H[From.GetName]§! harbors intentions of spreading this powerful ideology across the entire galaxy; their actions must be watched closely.

items.name: Cultural Envoy Specialization
items.desc: As our official ambassador in one of our newly developed Cultural Envoys, §H[Root.GetName]§! is showing promise in developing creative ways of spreading the message of Ideology as a §Y[Root.GetCulturalEnvoySubclass]§!. However, should we wish, we can retrain [Root.GetHimHer] in a different specialization that better suits our needs.

items.name: Operation Aborted
items.desc: The §H[From.GetName]§! has officially renounced its adopted ideology. As a result, our espionage operation targeting the population's adherence to this ideological framework is no longer required and has been terminated.

items.name: Operational Target Identified
items.desc: Our operatives have identified a target for manipulating information within the [Target.GetName]: a §Hprominent data center§! that forms a key node of their communication network.\n\nExploiting the facility's systems will require the help of one or more [Target.GetAdj] individuals with physical access. Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has approved a list of promising targets.

items.name: [Target.GetAdj] Agent Recruited
items.desc: Our operatives have successfully recruited an agent to help us gain access to a key §H[Target.GetAdj] data center on [target.capital_scope.GetName]§!. By exploiting their deviance from the collective consciousness, we were able to compel this individual to reveal classified information and agree to assist in a future operation.

items.name: Operation Succeeds
items.desc: Despite significant hurdles, the mission to infiltrate a prominent data center on [fromfrom.capital_scope.GetName] achieved its objectives. Our operatives installed equipment that allows us to manipulate a significant portion of information that flows through the [fromfrom.GetName].\n\nShould this one day be discovered, processes are in place to eradicate any evidence that might lead back to the [Root.GetName]. Until then, we have unprecedented control over ideological messaging that passes between us and the [fromfrom.GetAdj] population.

items.name: Tensions on the Rise
items.desc: Our operatives have identified a number of divisive political issues related to §HIdeology§! which can be exploited to foster unrest and instability among populations sympathetic to §HIdeology§!.\n\nWe have produced a high volume of provocative media content designed to exacerbate these tensions and begun circulating it across local channels.

items.name: Agitators Recruited
items.desc: As anger and resentment rises within the §H[target.GetName]§!, we have recruited a number of highly vocal and influential [target.GetAdj] media commentators to further amplify dissent.\n\nThey will leverage their prominent public profiles to direct discontent with §HIdeology§! towards state institutions and government figures.

items.name: Operation Ready
items.desc: Our operatives have prepared a series of covert operations designed to inflame tensions and further discredit §HIdeology§! within the §H[target.GetName]§!.\n\nThese carefully staged events are designed to provoke outrage over the most contentious aspects of the state ideology. Our network of media commentators will swiftly seize upon these incidents, amplifying public anger and directing it against the governing principles of the [target.GetName].

items.name: Operation Succeeds
items.desc: After engineering a series of carefully planned public incidents designed to inflame tensions, our operatives report a surge in social conflict and political instability throughout the §H[fromfrom.GetName]§!.\n\nTrust in §HIdeology§! has eroded, and many aspects of local political and economic life are completely breaking down.

items.name: Adopt Federation Ideology Proposal
items.desc: The President of the §H[this.Federation.GetName]§! has presented us with a simple ultimatum: adopt the ideology of §H[from.GetName]§! or renounce our membership of the federation entirely.\n\nHow will we respond?
items.trigger: has_federation = yes

items.name: §RUnrest§!: [Target.GetName] Secedes
items.desc:
The ideologically driven revolt on §H[Target.GetName]§! has ended in disaster. The [Target.GetPlanetMoon] is no longer a part of the [Owner.GetName].

As attempts to quell the rebellion repeatedly failed, our authority over the colony collapsed district by district. The insurrectionists, increasingly powerful and well-organized, eventually managed to seize control entirely.

They have now declared independence as the §H[rebel_empire.GetName]§!, guided by the foreign principles of 'Ideology'.

items.name: §RUnrest§!: [Target.GetName] Secedes
items.desc:
The ideologically driven revolt on §H[Target.GetName]§! has ended in disaster. The [Target.GetPlanetMoon] is no longer a part of the [Owner.GetName].

As attempts to quell the rebellion repeatedly failed, our authority over the colony collapsed district by district. The insurrectionists, increasingly powerful and well-organized, eventually managed to seize control entirely.

They have now declared independence as the §H[rebel_empire.GetName]§!, guided by principles that they claim are a 'purer form' of [rebel_empire.ideology.GetEthicLower] beliefs.

items.name: §RUnrest§!: Schism Averted
items.desc: In the face of increasing pressure from [from.GetName]'s population, we have officially abandoned our state doctrine. The insurgents have backed down, apparently satisfied with the ideological concessions they have forced upon us.\n\nThe [Owner.GetName] must now find a way forward beyond its former ethical framework, seeking renewed purpose and unity after this period of bitter instability.

items.name: Ideological Demands
items.desc: The §H[from.GetName]§! is demanding that we adopt their beliefs as a state ideology, the principles of which are detailed in an official statement from the group's foremost leaders and theoreticians.\n\nThe faction claims that it represents 'the will of virtually all [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]' and that it 'cannot be denied.'

items.name: Faction Intelligence Leak
items.desc:
The §H[from.GetName]§! has been caught leaking state secrets.

We have intercepted communications between faction members and operatives within the §H[event_target:intel_leak_empire.GetName]§! that contain classified data from the [Root.GetName]. According to data experts, these intelligence breaches have been occurring for some time, and protecting against further losses will be a slow process.

The [from.GetName] has officially disavowed these crimes, claiming that responsibility lies with fringe radicals acting without their support.

items.name: Fanatical Direct Action
items.desc: Discontented members of the §H[from.GetName]§! have begun a campaign of direct action, aimed at disrupting the workings of our government.\n\n[Root.Capital.GetName] has seen protests, infrastructure blockades, and even targeted vandalism of state property. When apprehended, the perpetrators display a fanatical disregard for the individual punishments which await them. The situation is placing increased demands on our security services.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Coup Thwarted
items.desc: An attempted coup against the government has been thwarted. The plot was planned and carried out by members of the §H[from.GetName]§!, who later confessed to having been motivated by fierce ideological disagreement with government policies.\n\nThe group tried to seize control of key buildings and infrastructure, but were undone by a lack of supplies and equipment which allowed security forces to reassert control. A state of vigilance has been instigated across the [Root.GetName] to guard against a repeat action.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Leader Kidnapped
items.desc: §H[event_target:kidnapped_governor.GetName]§! has been kidnapped by members of the §H[from.GetName]§!'s extremist wing.\n\nThe small group of radicals seized [event_target:kidnapped_governor.GetName] from [event_target:kidnapped_governor.GetHisHer] home and are currently holding [event_target:kidnapped_governor.GetHimHer] in an undisclosed location. Statements from the kidnappers declare the action to be a temporary and symbolic response intended to draw attention to our government's 'misguided policy direction'.

items.name: Criminal Damage
items.desc: Discontented members of the §H[from.GetName]§! carried out an act of criminal damage at a storage facility, destroying a sizable quantity of the raw and processed materials being housed there.\n\nIn a publicly issued statement, the group claimed responsibility and outlined the nature of their ideological motives, largely borne out of disagreement with recent government decisions. The culprits have since been apprehended, but some of the material damage is irreparable.

items.name: Faction Angered
items.desc: Our suppression of the [from.GetName] has provoked an angry response.\n\nProminent figures within the faction speak openly about retribution, sometimes even making veiled threats against the government, unless the suppression order is reversed immediately.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Ethical Shift
items.desc:
The [from.GetName] has been highly vocal in criticizing the recent ethical shift in our government's approach.

Its leaders are threatening boycotts, civil disobedience campaigns, or even - in the most radical instances - an outright coup against the government of [Root.GetName].

Our security advisors are undecided on the best way to handle this volatile group.

items.name: Tahqeq Qattak
items.desc:
§HThe twitching insectoid bares its mandibles and hisses loudly, motioning at the scars on its chitinous carapace. A sequence of sharp vocal clicks follows, before its display concludes with a high-pitched screech.

After a short wait, our linguistic AI produces a translation.§!

Fellow warbringers, my respect and blade; I offer fealty to the [Owner.GetName].

items.name: Hulaandi
items.desc:
§HThe plantoid's head blossoms with an array of delicate white flowers, which flush quickly into a soft shade of pink. [ethic_leader.GetHeSheCap] bows [ethic_leader.GetHisHer] head gently.§!

In peace, I come. I am Hulaandi.

I have sought you for many seasons; and now - finally - we meet.

items.name: Sybanus
items.desc:
§HClothed in flowing garments, rich but timeworn, the alien radiates stillness. The contemplative pace of [ethic_leader.GetHisHer] speech seems almost to confound the rapidity of our machine translation.§!

The True Star lit the path to you, fellow seers.

I am Sybanus.

items.name: Frulin the Logical
items.desc:
§HFrulin the Logical mutters quietly to himself, while reading from a small tablet device.§!

The [Owner.GetName] was founded in -

§HHe interrupts himself, adjusts an ocular lens, and clears his vocal tract.§!

Forgive me! Where are my manners? I got lost in my encyclopedia again. I have collected over one thousand facts about [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in here. You have quite the fascinating history!

But first, proper nomenclature is in order. I am Frulin, at your service.

items.name: TDEC-VII.21797
items.desc:
§HDespite its bulky and tarnished form, the machine's intricate movements produce only the faintest mechanical sounds. It communicates with us in a serviceable synthesis of the common [Owner.GetAdj] language.§!

Transmission from unit reference TDEC-VII.21797 begins.

It has been determined that the governing logic of Ideology is concordant with the central protocol of TDEC-VII.21797: the acquisition of dissimilar life forms for use as menial workforce. Hence, TDEC-VII.21797 proposes to perform such services for the [Owner.GetName].

Introduction complete, receive it well.

items.name: Babil Li'bab
items.desc:
§HPossessing an unusual biology that encompasses a range of exotic features, Babil Li'bab's appearance defies our automatic species categorization algorithm. He greets us in multiple languages.§!

Horan Haag. Vrikkaannanda. Zuq.

It is an honor to make your acquaintance, good [Owner.GetSpeciesNameCompliment]. My proposal to you is one of friendly partnership. Are you amenable?

items.name: Hox
items.desc:
§HThere is a prolonged silence before we realize that the caller is waiting for us to initiate conversation. [ethic_leader.GetHisHerCap] primary bionic eye regards us with its attention, while its secondary minuscule arms remain fixed on the device clasped in the fungoid's tentacles.

After our introductory greeting, the alien speaks to us in our standard dialect.§!

An honor it is to share words with representatives of the great [Owner.GetAdj] state!

I trust my communication officers have already forwarded my resume to the appropriate department. Please accept this transmission as my formal application to join the [Owner.GetName].

items.name: Ephari
items.desc:
§HThe transmission reveals a creature formed entirely of bioluminescent coral. [ethic_leader.GetHisHerCap] fleshy polyps sway gently, shifting color rhythmically across a wide range of hues.

After a short delay, our comms assistant translates the chromatophoric variations into language.§!

As equals, we meet. Common greetings of submission or domination, we have no need of.

§HThe branched columns of soft coral begin to pulsate brightly.§!

Ephari, we are.

items.name: A Galactic Community
items.desc: As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of a new pan-galactic organization - a community, if you will, where the empires of the galaxy can meet to discuss important matters.\n\nShould the [Root.GetName] pledge its support for the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!?

items.name: The Birth of the Galactic Community
items.desc: This is a historic day. Several of the galaxy's prominent spacefaring empires, including the [Root.GetName], have announced the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!. This supranational organization will serve as a forum where matters involving the entire galaxy can be discussed and decided upon.\n\nAs one of its founding members, we can take pride in this milestone of galactic history.

items.name: The Birth of the Galactic Community
items.desc: Despite our decision not to lend our support behind the founding of some sort of supranational galactic institution, several other empires have banded together to create just such a thing. In their "historic" joint announcement, they declared the creation of the §HGalactic Community§! to the galaxy. This organization is to serve as a forum where important matters that affect the galaxy as a whole can be discussed.\n\nAs we refused to take part in the creation of this Galactic Community, the [Root.GetName] is not yet considered a member.

items.name: No Support for Galactic Community
items.desc: The initiative to form a supranational "§HGalactic Community§!" has failed. Not enough empires pledged their support to the creation of such an institution.

items.name: The Birth of the Galactic Community
items.desc: Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "§HGalactic Community§!." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.\n\nAlthough we were not involved in its founding, the other members have extended an invitation to the [Root.GetName] for formal membership. Should we accept?

items.name: Formation of the Galactic Council
items.desc: The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are the §H[council_member_1.GetName]§!, the §H[council_member_2.GetName]§!, and the §H[council_member_3.GetName]§!.\n\nThe members of the Council are expected to lead and safeguard the Galactic Community. Their increased powers allow them to cut through some of the red tape that so often inhibits the decision-making process in large political institutions.

items.name: [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] Stripped of Galactic Market Headquarters
items.desc: According to article 19C of the Galactic Community's charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused. The Community's Board of Commerce has issued a statement expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that nominations for a new host within the Community will commence immediately.

items.name: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought
items.desc: With the [From.GetName] opting to leave the Galactic Community, an obscure article of the Community's charter must be applied, to the effect that only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused. Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the Community's Board of Commerce expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

items.name: Tiyanki Pest Control
items.desc: The Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests. Any member of the Galactic Community with Tiyanki inside their borders are legally obliged to see to the immediate euthanization of the creatures.\n\nUnfortunately, there are Tiyanki present within our space. Until they are dealt with, or they leave our space of their own accord, the [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

items.name: Tiyanki In [Root.GetSpeciesName] Space
items.desc: A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders.\n\nThe [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Tiyanki have either departed our space or been exterminated.

items.name: Tiyanki Conservation Act Violation
items.desc: Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§! system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! for the next ten years.\n\nThe resources we extracted from the dead Tiyanki have been confiscated, and we have been issued a fine.

items.name: Tiyanki In [Root.GetSpeciesName] Space
items.desc: Officials from the Galactic Community have observed the presence of Tiyanki within the borders of the [Root.GetName]. With the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution having been enacted, this leaves us in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures are euthanized or leave our space of their own accord.

items.name: Tiyanki Conservation Act Violation
items.desc: Officials from the Galactic Community have received word of our recent victory against the Tiyanki Matriarch. They have informed us that our destruction of the beast was a clear violation of the Tiyanki Conservation Act, regardless of the Matriarch's hostile nature.\n\nThe [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! for the next ten years. Additionally, we have been issued with a hefty fine for our killing of "a unique Tiyanki life form whose like the galaxy shall never see again."
items.trigger:
is_country_type = default
is_galactic_community_formed = yes
is_galactic_community_member = yes
is_active_resolution = resolution_tiyanki_conservation_act

items.name: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought
items.desc: The Galactic Community has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with traders focusing solely on forecasts for the next few years. They bemoan the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has already caused.\n\nNominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the Community's Board of Commerce issuing a statement expressing regret at this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

items.name: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought
items.desc: The Galactic Community has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with traders focusing solely on forecasts for the next few years. They bemoan the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has already caused.\n\nNominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the Community's Board of Commerce issuing a statement expressing regret at this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

items.name: Galactic Market Remains in Place
items.desc: Our motion to relocate the Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we mustered significant vocal support for the endeavor, this did not translate into enough valid nominations for a new host site.\n\nThe idea remains sound in principle: the Galactic Community may propose moving the Market again in future, if it so desires. For now though, this commercial institution remains in the lucrative care of the [market_founder.GetName].

items.name: Galactic Market Remains in Place
items.desc: Galactic commerce experienced a brief and confusing resurgence recently, with news that the effort to relocate the Galactic Market has failed. Despite the Galactic Community's stated desire to move this institution, they received no valid nominations for a replacement host. As a result, the [market_founder.GetName] shall remain its hosts until the winds of political change swing back to polling for a replacement.

items.name: §HGalactic Market§!: Established in [market_founder_planet.GetStarName]
items.desc: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

items.name: Guardians of Zanaam
items.desc: INTERLOPER! Heed this message:\n\nWe are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.

items.name: Alien Proto-Civilization Encountered
items.desc: We have discovered a primitive mammalian culture on [From.From.GetName]. The most advanced regions on the planet have only recently advanced beyond the Iron Age, and much of the surface is ruled by feudal nobles who vie with each other in an endless struggle for titles and land.

items.name: Alien Proto-Civilization Encountered
items.desc: A primitive industrial culture is currently locked in a global war on the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Two large alliances of nation states are fighting each other with massive numbers of armored land vehicles, atmospheric aircraft and ocean-going naval vessels. Some of these states are on the cusp of unlocking atomic power, which could radically increase the destructive potential of this conflict.

items.name: Alien Proto-Civilization Encountered
items.desc: [From.From.GetName] is home to a mammalian civilization currently in an Early Space Age. The orbital space around the planet is cluttered with primitive satellites, and the natives seem to have already launched several manned missions to Sol IIIa. A number of small sublight exploration probes have been detected on outbound trajectories towards other bodies within the system.

items.name: Nuclear Devastation
items.desc: The surface of [From.From.From.GetName] has been ravaged by nuclear war, and the planet is little more than a tomb. Withered concrete skeletons jut out of the ground where major population centers once stood, and the howling wind is all that can be heard on the desolate, ash-covered surface.\n\nA local species of insect seems to be thriving in the irradiated environment. Mutated specimens have increased dramatically in size, and some communities are displaying signs of rudimentary intelligence.

items.name: Shielded World
items.desc: [From.GetName] has been found to be completely enveloped in some kind of energy barrier. All attempts by the [Root.GetName] to penetrate the barrier with its sensors have failed - the scanning beam is simply deflected back at the ship, as though it was looking at a mirror.\n\nThe barrier's energy readings are fluctuating somewhat, possibly as a result of thousands of years of decay, but breaching it with raw firepower would still be impossible. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has proposed a special project to investigate ways of removing the barrier... but suppose it was created to keep something in, rather than out?

items.name: Mothballed Fleet
items.desc: Our scientists above [From.From.GetName] have finally succeeded in lowering the energy barrier that covered the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. When it disappeared, we discovered a mothballed battle fleet slowly drifting in low orbit above an otherwise insignificant rock.\n\nIt appears to be the remnants of some kind of naval reserve fleet established by the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] thousands of years ago, during the zenith of their ancient empire. With the passage of time, the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] must have lost the knowledge to lower the barrier themselves, or these ships would surely have been used to bolster their own fleets.

items.name: Vault of Knowledge
items.desc: The energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName] has been lowered by our scientists, revealing a barren world with a single massive structure on its surface. Away teams sent into the structure have reported a massive vault filled with technological marvels.\n\nThis vault appears to have been established by [fallen_4_species.GetName] scientists soon after their empire began its long decline thousands of years ago, as a means to preserve some of their knowledge for the benefit of future generations of [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural].

items.name: The Prisoner
items.desc: We have lowered the energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName]. What our scientists found was an indistinct habitable world devoid of civilization... with one notable exception. A small, isolated hut was found perched on a mesa in the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s northern hemisphere.\n\nWithin the hut we found a withered old [fallen_4_species.GetName], who has demanded to speak with our government.

items.name: Tuborek
items.desc: You cannot imagine how good it is to finally see clear skies again, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I am Grand Commander Tuborek, former master of the combined [fallen_4_species.GetName] armada and victor of a hundred battles. I personally oversaw the conquest of the Duthbejak, Riikinak, Binark and Jusskari empires hundreds of your centuries ago.\n\nAs my savior, I pledge my service to you. I should be honored to lead your mighty fleets into battle against your enemies.

items.name: The Exiles Return
items.desc: As soon as our scientists lowered the energy barrier that was surrounding [From.From.GetName], everyone present within the system was briefly afflicted by a splitting headache accompanied by a faint, whispered word in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:\n\n"FREEDOM..."

items.name: Ring World Encountered
items.desc: We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the §Y[From.GetName]§! system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly home to a pre-space civilization.\n\nThere is a large space station of some kind located between the ring world and its star. We are receiving a transmission from it.

items.name: Incoming Transmission
items.desc:
Welcome to the Sanctuary, sapient. This fully automated facility was established 74,605,338 cycles ago to serve as a nature reserve. Our self-sustaining biome segments feature a selection of non-intelligent flora and fauna originating from four distinct biospheres.

To protect these fragile biospheres, access to our facilities is currently restricted.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

items.name: Effluvial Offspring
items.desc: Following the destruction of our fleet in the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system, the local Void Cloud appears to have gathered enough material from the debris to undergo what can best be described as a form of mitosis on the macro level - asexual reproduction.\n\nThere is now one more Void Cloud haunting [From.From.From.GetStarName].
items.trigger:
is_ai = no
is_country_type = default
has_communications = from

items.name: Tiyanki Home System Scoured
items.desc: The last of the Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system have been exterminated by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.\n\nTheir path to eventual extinction seems unavoidable now.

items.name: Cradle of Life
items.desc: Four gas giants enshrouded by a vast plasma field share a close orbit around the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system's primary. The charged plasma field extends well into the atmospheres of these gas giants, and this unique environment serves as a breeding ground for a large number of spacefaring organisms.\n\nThese organisms are all miniscule, with one notable exception - the massive §HTiyanki§!. This system must be where they originally evolved hundreds of millions of years ago, before they ranged deeper into the galaxy. Given the extremely rare properties of the system's plasma field, this is likely the only place in the galaxy where the Tiyanki can reproduce.

items.name: Tiyanki Driven to Extinction
items.desc: The last known Tiyanki was recently hunted down and killed by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§! in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system. These spacefaring life forms, who were far older than any currently existing empire, are believed to have roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years. Today marks the end of their storied history.

items.name: Incoming Transmission
items.desc: Even when our empire was at the height of its power, eons ago, the Tiyanki were considered ancient, and now... now I am told that a bunch of [Root.GetSpeciesName] WHELPS recently slew the last of the defenseless creatures, rendering them extinct.\n\nCan your feeble [Root.GetSpeciesName] brains comprehend what you have done? Do you have even the slightest notion of what your callous actions have stolen from this galaxy?

items.name: Tiyanki Hunted in [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]
items.desc: We have successfully hunted down and killed some wild Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§! system. Our fleet has used laser cutters to extract materials and resources from the massive Tiyanki remains.

items.name: Gravekeepers
items.desc: The actions of the Tiyanki inhabiting the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system do not match known behavior patterns for their species. While Tiyanki are usually nomadic, these herds remain stationed around a planet entirely covered in the carcasses of their own dead.\n\nAttempts to study the burial ground have been hindered by the net of tentacles the Tiyanki have wrapped around the planet, making further research impossible - unless we are willing to displace or dispose of the gravekeepers.

items.name: Desecrated Grave
items.desc: Having eliminated the Tiyanki stationed in [FromFrom.System.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] can now safely approach the burial ground to conduct their research.

items.name: Tasty Bait
items.desc: The construction of the Tiyanki lure in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system has been completed. Beguiled by the nourishing gases released by the diffuser, the gravekeepers are lured away from their post, allowing our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] to slip through their tentacles and approach the burial ground unnoticed.

items.name: Mysterious Guardians
items.desc: A large number of §H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§! are clustered around a planet covered in the carcasses of some alien life-form.\n\nHaving no information on those alien entities, we can only speculate on their behavior.

items.name: VLUUR
items.desc:
An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the §H[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing massive subspace disturbances in the entire system.

These disturbances are localized around the entity itself and should disappear when it leaves the system. While it does not acknowledge hails, the entity is continuously emitting a complex pattern of tachyon pulses which appears to be a form of language. If our translation software is correct, it is saying, over and over:

§H"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds.§!"

items.name: The End of VLUUR
items.desc:
Throughout its battle with our forces in the §H[vluur_system.GetName]§! system, the subspace entity §H"VLUUR"§! increased the frequency at which it was emitting tachyon pulses, but the endlessly repeating message remained the same:

§H"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."§!

When the final killing blow was delivered, the entity detonated in a massive explosion that showered the system in dark matter.

items.name: Breeding Grounds
items.desc: The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one life form that appears to thrive in this environment - the space amoeba. Giving up their otherwise fairly solitary lifestyle, they have congregated in great numbers, flitting in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.\n\nIt is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned their flagella towards the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

items.name: New Arrivals in [FromFrom.GetName]
items.desc: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, entering our territory in the [FromFrom.GetName] system. As is the norm with these creatures, they seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts.

items.name: The Space Amoeba Protection Act
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed the §YSpace Amoeba Protection Act§! resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with §YSpace Amoebas§!.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

items.name: A Multitude of Voices
items.desc: Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals are intentional in nature, it warrants further investigation.

items.name: Voidworms
items.desc: We have discovered that the far-reaching signals originate from a simple spaceborne organism we have taken to calling §H"Voidworms"§!. It appears that the galaxy is riddled with these creatures. From the varying wavelengths of the signals, we have determined that the creatures develop through several stages of growth before reaching final maturity. Though they do not appear outwardly aggressive, their patterns of communication indicate coordination on a galactic scale.

items.name: Voidworm Enzymes
items.desc:
Voidworms mate in groups of three, a formation known as a "Troika." These creatures become bound for life in a never-ending mating ritual. However, they require an external biological host to produce offspring.

They are parasites.

Upon reaching maturity, each Voidworm develops a clutch of cysts within their reproductive systems. These protective cysts contain highly caustic gametes that, when combined with others in a Troika, can be sent to planets with suitable biomass in order to give birth to more of their nymphs. Their hosts do not survive this process. We've seen evidence that the Voidworms coordinate their bombardments so as to maintain a sustainable amount of viable hosts throughout the galaxy.

In any case, we believe that we can harness the power of their reproductive enzymes to our own benefit. We may even develop an immunity to their reproductive efforts.

items.name: Voidworms Eradicated
items.desc: The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.\n\nWe need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

items.name: Voidworm Burrow Destroyed
items.desc: We have eradicated a Voidworm home system.\n\nThey will no longer be able to make use of these spawning grounds to raise their young.

items.name: Voidworm Eradication
items.desc: The Galactic Community has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.\n\nUntil they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

items.name: Voidworms In [this.GetSpeciesName] Space
items.desc: A fleet of Voidworms has entered our space in the [from.GetName] system. As a Galactic Community member, we are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Voidworms present within our borders.\n\nThe [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Voidworms have either departed our space or are exterminated.

items.name: Voidworms In [this.GetSpeciesName] Space
items.desc: The continued Voidworm presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant §RBreach of Galactic Law§! under the Voidworm Eradication resolution. This has resulted in Galactic Community allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [this.GetName].

items.name: Galactic Parasites
items.desc:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. These nymphs contain a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

Biological analysis indicates that each clutch of Voidworms has a limited supply of these cysts to distribute, and it is likely they will depart once all are depleted. Until then, we are suffering significant population loss.

items.name: Voidworm Plague
items.desc:
The population of Voidworms in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.

The typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.

All of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of Voidworms in any system should be met with extreme caution.

A breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

items.name: Excess Components
items.desc: Our increased fleet support in efforts against the Voidworms has yielded an unexpected windfall of additional components due to improved maintenance protocols. We have an opportunity to invest these materials into improving our short-term production of new fleets.

items.name: Call to Arms
items.desc: Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has inspired a new generation of Commanders. Experienced citizens of [this.GetName] have chosen to offer their talents toward the elimination of this galactic threat.

items.name: Front Line Development
items.desc: An engineer stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has developed a new conceptual blueprint for ship defenses. [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap] was carrying out routine repairs in the fight against the Voidworms when [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe] came up with an idea for a new component that would increase the hardiness of our vessels. After the idea was presented to our research department, we believe that it has great potential.

items.name: [infected_leader.GetName] Infected
items.desc: In the performance of [infected_leader.GetHisHer] duties, [infected_leader.GetName] [infected_leader.GetHasHave] become infected with active Voidworm spores. It will not be long until new nymphs emerge and destroy their host.\n\nIt could be a lost cause, but the medical staff speculate it may be possible to extract the larva before they have fully integrated into [infected_leader.GetHisHer] nervous system. It's a risky procedure, but [infected_leader.GetName] seems willing to let us try.

items.name: Quarantine Breach
items.desc: A small group of infected [infected_planet_pop.species.GetName] have fled from the purge on [infected_planet.GetName] and dispersed throughout our systems. Left unchecked, this could cause Voidworm infection to spread across the entire [this.GetName]. Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger us all.

items.name: Dereliction of Duty
items.desc: While it is agreed that purging the infected is the wisest course of action, many soldiers are struggling to carry out orders. Despite the danger of the Voidworm parasite, many are simply unable to eliminate their fellow citizens for the greater good.\n\nSomething must be done to prevent the Voidworm infection from spreading through our colonies. We may be able to automate certain parts of the purging process so as to require fewer soldiers. Alternatively, we can launch a short publicity campaign to promote the ethical standards of our purging efforts and reaffirm their necessity.

items.name: Tangential Breakthrough
items.desc: Our search for the cure to the Voidworm plague has allowed research in other biological fields to progress in parallel. While the parasites remain our current priority, this new breakthrough has tremendous potential for future study.

items.name: Early-Stage Testing
items.desc: Our understanding of the Voidworm Plague is improving and the foundation of a cure has been developed. However, our research could progress at a much quicker pace with early-stage live testing on [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] participants.\n\nEthical considerations aside, it may be wiser to bypass certain safety measures for the sake of the greater good.

items.name: Voidworm Glands
