exists = event_target:smear_campaign_target

items.name: Team on Standby
items.desc: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw towards the §H[target.GetName]§!.

items.name: Sign of Progress
items.desc: Our researchers and operatives have prepared for a wide variety of mission variables, and the task team has departed for an uncharted region of space between §Y[target.GetAdj] territory§! and the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!.

items.name: Baited Lure
items.desc: Our operatives near the §H[target.GetName]§! have sent a one-time communiqué: they are ready to proceed, and will draw the ire of the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§! upon our signal.

items.name: [crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName] on Course for [root.capital_scope.GetName]
items.desc: We detect a hostile presence from the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!, heading straight for our capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!! Strange energy waves have burst out from the vicinity of §H[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]§!, their assumed origin.\n\nWe had just begun the work of analyzing this phenomenon when energy signatures in the region abruptly changed. All signs suggest this means a sudden change of fleet movements. Furthermore, at least one of those energy signatures looks to belong to an empire other than the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]. Whoever they are, they appear to be the cause of this behavior. We suspect this to be §Hprovocative action§! by one of our galactic rivals.

items.name: Contact Lost
items.desc: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the §H[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]§!. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.\n\nIn accordance with standard procedure, we must now decide whether or not to track down our own operatives.
items.trigger:
exists = from
is_gestalt = no

items.name: Contact Re-Established
items.desc: Our efforts proved successful - contact with our operatives has been restored. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is already working to review the monitoring procedures [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] in place for work in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.
items.trigger: exists = fromfrom

items.name: Contact Confirmed Lost
items.desc: Despite our best efforts, we cannot restore contact with our operatives in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a review of monitoring procedures for our Spy Network there; it is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] have more sophisticated §HEncryption§! than we had thought.\n\nMeanwhile, §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! will resume at a reduced capacity while we recoup our losses.
items.trigger: exists = fromfrom

items.name: Operative Spooked
items.desc: Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for §HOperation [from.GetName]§! - as such, Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requests more resources with which [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] might prevent disruptions further down the line.

items.name: Apprehended by [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]
items.desc: The §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has just been alerted to our presence. It seems we lacked sufficient intelligence on the local area, and our operatives have earned the attention of local [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural].\n\n§HOperation [from.GetName]§! is not truly jeopardized yet, but Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requires speedy assistance.

items.name: A Diplomatic Solution
items.desc: Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] and [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] colleagues have smoothed over our operatives' awkward intrusion into the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.\n\nIt's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] sees our excuses for the pack of lies they are. As far as outward appearances are concerned, however: we are considered to be 'in the clear'.
items.trigger: exists = fromfrom

items.name: Multi-Phasic Force Fields
items.desc: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the §H[from.target.GetName]§!. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding technology putting out noisy interference.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Multi-Phasic Force Fields
items.desc: We have lost all contact with our operatives assigned to §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. Whether by our target's cunning design, or simply an unlucky coincidence for us, [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] shielding technology has proven a worthy adversary us.\n\nIt is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] may gain from this incident. Although our operatives may operate semi-autonomously, without our presence they are still far more vulnerable to enemy capture.

items.name: Mistaken for Food
items.desc: A primal aspect of the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! entity has mistaken our operatives for food, and is now fixated upon hunting them. This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] individual seems to instinctively regard anything other than itself as a source of potential nutrition.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Toxic Field Work
items.desc: Something about the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! living environment appears mildly toxic to the individuals assigned to §HOperation [from.GetName]§!. Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them out within the hostile Collective.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Remedy for Field Work
items.desc: Our research efforts have paid off, and remedies are being distributed to our drone operatives. The low-level toxins found in §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! habitats should no longer present any issues, and §HOperation [event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName]§! may continue.
items.trigger:
exists = event_target:toxic_field_operation
exists = event_target:toxic_field_country

items.name: Toxic Field Work Persists
items.desc: Our window of opportunity inside the §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! has closed, leaving our operative drones visibly affected by their environment. §HOperation [fromfromfrom.GetName]§! may continue, but we must work carefully lest our allergies arouse suspicion.

items.name: Excess Noise
items.desc: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with electrostatic noise - far more than we had anticipated. The disguised drones we have assigned to §HOperation [from.GetName]§! are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses significant risks to our data-gathering, and increases our chances of exposure.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Excess Noise Cancellation
items.desc: Our research efforts have paid off, and specifications for new shielding against electromagnetic interference are being distributed throughout our operative network in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!. Our efforts on §HOperation [fromfromfrom.GetName]§! should no longer be hindered by excess static.
items.trigger:
exists = event_target:excess_noise_operation
exists = event_target:excess_noise_country

items.name: Excess Noise Persists
items.desc: Electrostatic noise in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§! has now caused irreparable data loss amongst some of our drones. §HOperation [event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName]§! may continue, but our efforts are being hindered - such is the scale of backlogged demands upon our data validation processes.
items.trigger:
exists = event_target:excess_noise_operation
exists = event_target:excess_noise_country

items.name: Snuffed Out
items.desc: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our team of operatives near the §Y[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has missed a number of checkpoints. Given the nature of this operation, we had already anticipated them being unable to maintain frequent contact. However, our Spymaster is regrettably confident that by now, the team has been lost.\n\n§HOperation [from.GetName]§! may be rescued if we can successfully cover our tracks, pitting our §HCodebreaking§! against [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] §HEncryption§!.

items.name: Successful Cover-Up
items.desc: Though it has greatly taxed the resources of Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s work in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!, operational security has been reasserted. All loose ends have been covered; all cover identities discarded. A new team of operatives will take over from here, enacting a subtly different set of orders under our Spymaster's watchful gaze.\n\nThe [snuffedout_country.GetAdj], meanwhile, still seem oblivious to our presence.
items.trigger:
exists = fromfrom
exists = event_target:snuffedout_country

items.name: Operation Exposed
items.desc: Our worst fears have come to pass: the recent loss of our operatives in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has exposed large parts of §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§!.\n\nAll our Spy Networks are carefully arranged so that under normal circumstances, only very flimsy evidence could ever implicate us in the covert activities we carry out. However, in this instance we cannot be entirely sure what Intel may have been given away; nor can we know how the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] might choose to respond.
items.trigger:
exists = fromfrom
exists = event_target:snuffedout_country

items.name: Drain on Resources
items.desc:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] discovered these operatives skimming from resources allocated to intelligence-gathering and bribes. These goods and currencies are being re-invested elsewhere in [from.target.GetAdj] business concerns, earning the operatives a comfortable profit at our expense. As a result, their attention and loyalties have clearly become divided.

Progress on §HOperation [from.GetName]§! has been put on hold for the moment, until Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] can re-assert operational efficiency.

items.name: Operatives Toe the Line
items.desc: Our operatives in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! are no longer skimming resources from our Spy Network allocation. Firm reminders of just where their loyalties lie have reinvigorated the operatives' sense of dedication; they will turn their resourceful talents wholly to our cause.
items.trigger: exists = fromfrom

items.name: Operatives Cut Ties
items.desc: Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] regretfully reports a breakdown in our §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! Spy Network.\n\nWhen a group of thieves amongst our operatives was called to account, their response was to flee - scattering to parts of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] space that even we struggle to monitor. [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is no longer able to track them down - at least not without drawing undue attention.
items.trigger: exists = fromfrom

items.name: Operative Defects
items.desc: Our Spymaster in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to §Rdefect§!.\n\nIt seems that the [root.GetOperativeRole] has grown more sympathetic towards the culture and founding ethics of the [from.target.GetName], in opposition to our own. Our screening process has failed in that it is supposed to rule out such flakiness.

items.name: Grisly Countermeasures
items.desc: An operative in the §Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§! has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.\n\nTheir injuries are severe, but our operative managed to complete their task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains in their medical care, the greater the risk our cover will be blown.

items.name: Confidence Wavers
items.desc:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing them to our attention, but even without them knowing any details: these operatives seem unusually well-informed about §HOperation [from.GetName]§!, and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active and better-informed agents, [operation.leader.GetName] suspects the operatives are being fed information from an outside source. [operation.leader.GetHeSheCap] also concede[operation.leader.GetSXX] that they may simply be highly perceptive individuals.

Given these doubts - and the threats posed to Operation [from.GetName] by each scenario - Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] requests a directive on how to proceed.

items.name: Unwavering Insight
items.desc: Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have applied themselves with unusual fervor upon learning that their once-intangible suspicions were founded in a real cause after all. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] maintains a strict information quarantine, but reports that [operation.leader.GetHisHer] supply lines have never been smoother.
items.trigger:
exists = fromfrom
exists = event_target:target_country

items.name: Panicked Operatives
items.desc: Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have reacted with horror upon learning the truth of their once-intangible suspicions. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] revealed only a glimpse of the bigger picture to them, but it was sufficient to disrupt our supply lines. Our ability to subvert [target_country.GetAdj] Encryption is reduced for a time.
items.trigger:
exists = fromfrom
exists = event_target:target_country

items.name: Gather Information
items.desc: Our operatives have completed their information-gathering operation and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.
items.trigger: exists = from

items.name: Infiltration Begins
items.desc: As our intelligence analysts put together lists of potential targets, individual operatives are beginning to infiltrate the [target.GetName].

items.name: Establishing Cover
items.desc: After successfully linking up inside the [target.GetName], our operatives are now working to establish their cover identities. The target list has been narrowed down to a dozen promising candidates.

items.name: Target Determined
items.desc: We have identified an Imperial dignitary on [target.Capital.GetName] by the name of §H[operation_target.GetName]§! that serves a small but critical role in maintaining the Imperium's yoke on the galaxy. Eliminating this target would amply demonstrate that no lackey of the [target.GetRulerTitle] is safe.

items.name: Operation Succeeds
items.desc: After waiting several days for the right moment, one of our sniper teams eliminated §H[operation_target.GetName]§! at extreme range by firing through the window of [operation_target.GetHerHis] office. The team then dismantled their rifle and were well on their way to the extraction point before anyone had even noticed the target was down.

items.name: Terrorists Undermine Imperial Authority!
items.desc: Unidentified agents recently assassinated an Imperial dignitary on [Root.Capital.GetName]! The perpetrators eluded capture, but we believe the assassination is part of a concerted effort to destabilize the Galactic Imperium and undermine our authority. One of the Imperium's member states is likely behind this!

items.name: Linking Up
items.desc: Our operatives are attempting to link up with other rebel groups and governments that share our goal of overthrowing the Imperium.

items.name: Threat Neutralization
items.desc: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Imperial counterespionage assets are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

items.name: Positioning Assets
items.desc: Imperial loyalists and other lackeys of the [target.GetRulerTitle] are present in great numbers in each of the Imperium's member states. Assets need to be in place to immediately seize or otherwise neutralize these loyalists the moment the rebellion breaks out.

items.name: Final Preparations
items.desc: Everything is nearly in place. Operatives are present in every member state of the Imperium, coordinating with whatever local elements are sympathetic to the rebel movement. It remains to be seen whether they can sway their governments to support our cause when push comes to shove.

items.name: Ready to Commence
items.desc: It is time. Concealed operatives all over the galaxy are waiting for the code phrase that will send them into action. This is the beginning of the end of the Galactic Imperium.

items.name: Making Contact
items.desc: Our operatives are working to identify and make contact with criminal elements inside the §H[target.GetName]§! that would be susceptible to our assistance.

items.name: Contact Established
items.desc: We have made contact with a rowdy but promising group of [target.GetSpeciesName] pirates. These violent cutthroats are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

items.name: Shipments Made
items.desc: Weapon shipments and unmarked ships that can't be traced back to us have been smuggled into the §H[target.GetName]§! by our operatives. We are ready to hand them over to the privateers.

items.name: Privateers Active
items.desc: The privateers we armed have established themselves in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system, and they have immediately begun targeting local shipping. Our analysts expect that the §H[target_country.GetName]§! will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing threat within their borders.

items.name: Hostiles in [privateer_system.GetName]!
items.desc: A group of heavily armed privateers has established a presence in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system! Little more than pirates, these lowlifes have immediately begun targeting our shipping passing through the system. Intelligence strongly suspects that they were supplied with ships and weapons by an outside power.

items.name: Privateers Already Engaged
items.desc: The privateers we were working with in the §H[target_country.GetName]§! have cut ties with us, and have begun wreaking havoc using materiel from some other source.\n\nWe cannot identify whoever is behind this effort, but it seems they shared our goals. Our own operation ends abruptly here, but reports indicate the [target_country.GetAdj] shipping lanes are being disrupted all the same.

items.name: Pursuing Leads
items.desc: Operatives within the §H[target.GetName]§! are actively working to identify and pursue leads that could potentially be used to gain favors.

items.name: Promising Angle
items.desc: A promising angle has been discovered which could be used for extortion purposes. Operatives are investigating.

items.name: Sensitive Information Acquired
items.desc: Through their surveillance efforts, our operatives have managed to obtain sensitive information regarding a certain high-ranking [target.GetSpeciesName] government official. If it were to be released to the general public, this information would prove very embarrassing.\n\nWe are ready to discreetly approach this official to see if some sort of alternate arrangement can be worked out.

items.name: Extortion Successful
items.desc: We have successfully arrived at a mutually beneficial arrangement with our contact in the §H[From.target.GetName]§!. In exchange for our discretion, we have been granted the promise of certain diplomatic favors in the future.

items.name: Infiltration
items.desc: Concealed as low-level Imperial officials and bureaucrats, our operatives are now infiltrating the §H[target.GetName]§!.

items.name: Outspoken Critic
items.desc: Our operatives are shadowing a Delegate who has long been an outspoken critic of the Imperium. Work is underway to deal with this dangerous firebrand.

items.name: Operation Ready
items.desc: The target is careful not to make statements that could be interpreted as fomenting open sedition against the Imperium, but their activities are still undermining our authority. Diplomatic eloquence will not save them in the end - there are other ways of dealing with rebels.

items.name: Delegate Neutralized
items.desc: Imperial agents were successful in their attempt to apprehend the subversive Delegate in the §H[target_country.GetName]§!. The target was quickly transported to the [Root.GetName], and after a swift trial they were sentenced to death. Such is the price for besmirching the good name of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

items.name: Delegate Lost
items.desc: Imperial agents recently arrested our Delegate for "crimes against the Imperium"! The Delegate was swiftly transported to the §H[From.GetName]§! before our own authorities could react, and after a brief show trial a death sentence was meted out.\n\nThe death of our Delegate has severely compromised our lobbying efforts in the Imperial Senate. It will be some time before we regain the necessary diplomatic platforms needed to sway public opinion in the Imperium.

items.name: Operation Compromised!
items.desc: Our operation to disrupt the ability of the §H[target_country.GetName]§! to undermine the Imperium has been compromised! [target_country.GetAdj] counterintelligence must have been monitoring our every move - all of our operatives have gone silent.\n\nThe [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have presented evidence of our operation to the Imperial Senate. Our diplomats are denying everything, of course, but this embarrassing incident will reflect poorly on the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

items.name: Imperial Spies Caught
items.desc: Several Imperial agents were recently neutralized on [Root.Capital.GetName] while engaged in an apparent attempt to silence our Delegate - more specifically, to prevent them from undermining the authority of the Imperium.\n\nWe have exposed the details of this dastardly plot to the Imperial Senate. The lackeys of the [From.GetRulerTitle] are denying everything, of course, but this incident will distort the image of unity the Imperium is trying to project.

items.name: Following Up Leads
items.desc: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the §H[root.target.GetName]§!. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.

items.name: Potential Cells Identified
items.desc: A list of targets has been finalized and our operatives have been quietly drifting their way into position. They await our signal to begin establishing sleeper cells.

items.name: Seeking Targets
items.desc: Our operatives are investigating key diplomatic actors within the §H[Root.Target.GetName]§!, searching for hooks which we may be able to exploit.

items.name: Digging for Dirt
items.desc: We have drawn up a list of potentially scandal-prone figures within the §H[Root.Target.GetAdj]§! diplomatic bureaucracy. Several potential leads have been found, and our operatives are working hard to find the best means by which to manufacture the desired outcome.

items.name: Update: Operation [This.GetName]
items.desc: A suitable target for §HOperation [This.GetName]§! has been identified, and an extensive dossier has been drawn up. Our operatives wait on our word to trigger the scandal.

items.name: Squeaky Clean
items.desc: Our agents in the §H[Root.Target.GetName]§! bring ill tidings: despite extensive preparation, their apparently promising target did not fall for the bait, and they were unable to manufacture a scandal. Incredible as it may seem, it appears that there simply aren't any bad apples within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps at the moment.

items.name: An Old Container
items.desc: During routine maintenance on a lower deck of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, our engineers have discovered an old sealed container emitting radioactive signals. Its surface was scorched and reinforced with thick industrial welds, suggesting it had never been meant to be opened easily.\n\nThere was no record of it in the ship's cargo archives, and no markings to indicate where it had come from or what it was meant to carry. A comprehensive analysis of the container will take some time to complete.

items.name: An Unusual Finding
items.desc: A basic scan showed the container held unremarkable goods and minerals, likely part of a standard supply shipment. However, lodged deeper within was a single, dense object with unusual properties. Its composition could not be determined.\n\nThe object reflected no energy signatures, absorbed most scanning wavelengths, and did not match any known materials in the ship's records. Even its exact shape proved difficult to define through remote imaging. Given these anomalies of its structure, some scientists of [Root.GetName] warned it could be potentially dangerous.

items.name: A Veiled Crystal
items.desc: The second container's casing resisted standard tools, requiring both time and resources to breach. But once inside, we discovered a dark and sharply faceted crystal, unlike anything documented in the ship's records. It emitted a faint warmth and absorbed ambient light, making it appear to radiate darkness from within. Its presence immediately drew attention among the crew.\n\nPreliminary assessments by the science team suggested that, with proper study, the crystal might be harnessed as an energy source, though the method for doing so remains unclear.

items.name: A Valuable Possession
items.desc:
The moment the crystal was unveiled, it began to pulse. It made no sound and showed no intention to communicate, yet its core thrummed when approached.

At intervals, it emitted a faint, fleeting glow. Some claimed it flickered in response to humming; others noted a subtle vibration in its cradle, as if it were listening.

No lifeform could be detected within, but it seemed aware of nearby presence. Strangest of all, those who glimpsed its glimmer often reported a quiet, inexplicable sense of joy.

items.name: A Crystallized Symphony
items.desc:
We have finally uncovered the crystal's origin. Through careful analysis of its pulse patterns, we discovered that the vibrations were not random at all. When the sequence was translated into sound, the tones matched an old lullaby, one still hummed aboard the Arkship today.

When the melody was played aloud, those who listened felt a deep, ancestral calm. The song was not just familiar; it was a remnant of life before the stars, perhaps even echoing from when we still called a planet home.

The crystal was placed in a communal space, its quiet pulse a living link to our shared origins.

items.name: A Way Forward
items.desc:
Under controlled conditions, the crystal was integrated into the ship's engine core. The effect was immediate, the reactor output spiked far beyond baseline, and the Arkship's engines roared with strength. Navigation reported a measurable gain in travel speed, and fuel reserves saw a corresponding improvement.

Crew in the engineering bays described a deep, resonant vibration echoing through the hull.

Within hours, the crystal was gone, its structure completely consumed by the reaction. Whatever its origin, it will have a lasting impact on our journey.

items.name: A Valuable Find
items.desc: A preliminary scan identified the bulk of the container's contents as remnants of a routine cargo manifest. However, buried beneath lay a cache of dense, crystalline alloys.\n\nFurther study of the radioactive emissions indicates the presence of Dark Matter within.

items.name: A Colorful Figure
items.desc: Inside the container we identified the artifact of curious design. The object radiated faint but persistent energy signatures, fluctuating across multiple spectrums. Its form was geometrically astonishing, as if the shape itself resisted stable definition. It resembled a colorful figure, fashioned in the likeness of a living being. Its construction was intricate, composed of interlocking segments that suggest the figure is meant to be opened.\n\nSome among the science crew suspect that something of value may rest within its outer shell. Others caution restraint, warning that tampering could compromise its preservation, or trigger unintended consequences.

items.name: A Secret Within
items.desc:
Removing the artifact's outer shell revealed not a hidden device or cache of valuables, but another, smaller figure, crafted with the same uncanny detail.

When this second figure was opened, it too contained a smaller figure, and another within that. No mechanism or hidden inscription was uncovered, only a seemingly endless recursion of forms, as though the act of concealment itself was the purpose. The innermost figure was barely larger than a grain of sand, perfectly smooth, and heavy for its size.

Whatever meaning this held for its makers has been lost over time.

items.name: Love of the Young
items.desc: Preserving the outer shell of the figure and displaying it in one of our communal gathering halls, its intricate craftsmanship drew the attention of all who passed.\n\nStrangely, the figure seemed to resonate most strongly with the young on §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. They often gathered around it, whispering theories about the being it depicts, or inventing their own stories. It appears to exert a calming influence, fostering imaginative play and easing anxiety.

items.name: Engine Contaminants
items.desc:
§YArkship [Root.GetName]§! is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by crew who listen to the engines to fall asleep. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm.
 
Investigation by our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] has confirmed that foreign matter has entered the fuel piping.

Thankfully, several solutions have already been proposed.

items.name: Start Your Engines
items.desc: Pilots from across the stars have gathered on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! for a grand race. It will run for almost one stellar year, during which time participants will thread tight orbits and launch laps around the Arkship and nearby celestial bodies.\n\nOne choice remains: who do we expect to cross the line first?

items.name: Victory at the [Root.GetName]
items.desc: The atmosphere aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§! shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, [selected_pilot.GetSheHe] slipped ahead and left the field in [selected_pilot.GetHerHis] ion wake.

items.name: Terrible Performance
items.desc:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§! held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.

Something slipped, a missed mark, a loose line, maybe just nerves. Either way their rivals eased past and our pilot crossed the finish in an unremarkable fourth.

items.name: Horrific Accident
items.desc: The race around Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! ended in tragedy when a high-speed collision scattered debris across the system. While lining up the final slingshot around [Star.GetName], our pilot closed too tightly on a rival and both ships spun out.\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§! survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

items.name: Mysterious Pilot
items.desc:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Our selected pilot's victory seemed assured as they executed the maneuver flawlessly, until the Sable Ship flashed by. An unmarked, until-then unnoticed entrant swept past our front-runner and crossed the line first.

Aboard the §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the galleries fell silent at the brutal finish.

items.name: Spinal Fracture
items.desc:
The recently installed §HSpinal Mount§! aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor points, spreading across the surrounding hull plating.

Until the damage is addressed, the Arkship's structural integrity cannot safely support high-velocity maneuvering. Navigation has therefore imposed severe speed restrictions to prevent the fractures from widening.

We may attempt rapid field repairs to stabilize the damage, or assign a §HLogistics Ship§! to conduct a full structural overhaul.

items.name: Repaired Spine
items.desc: Repairs to the Spinal Mount of §Y[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]§! have been completed. Though the process required careful work and extended inspections, we used the opportunity to reinforce several vulnerable sections of the hull and refine the mount's structural supports.\n\nThe resulting improvements have increased the Arkship's stability during high-speed maneuvers, allowing navigation to lift previous restrictions. Early tests suggest the vessel now performs more efficiently than before the damage occurred.

items.name: Under Pressure
items.desc: A sudden engine surge aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.\n\nIf left unchecked, the excess output could damage critical engine components. Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] recommend several possible responses: vent the excess plasma to stabilize the system, reprioritize work assignments, or temporarily shut the engines down to conduct a full recalibration.

items.name: Pressure Released
items.desc: The excess plasma was vented in a controlled discharge, spilling brilliant sheets of light across the Arkship's stern. Engine pressure has returned to acceptable levels, and no lasting damage was recorded.\n\nThe release did, however, leave behind a valuable residue of energized particles, much of which has been successfully recovered and routed into our reserves.

items.name: Overtime Reporting
items.desc: For the past six months, repair crews on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have worked without pause to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were stripped away, coolant lines rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.\n\nThe effort has stabilized the drive core for now, though the crews responsible endured long shifts and harsh working conditions to make it happen. Despite their exhaustion, morale is high. Whatever the void throws at us, we are confident we can endure it.

items.name: Recalibrated Drive Core
items.desc: The engines were brought down in controlled stages, allowing our engineers to inspect the drive assembly under safe conditions and recalibrate its regulation systems. The process delayed us, but the data gathered during the shutdown has already proven valuable.\n\nSeveral inefficiencies in the core sequencing on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have been identified. By redirecting surplus energy and reinforcing structural supports, our we have strengthened both the Arkship's shields and hull against future strain.

items.name: The Forgetting
items.desc: Since the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! entered this nebula, disturbances have rippled through the shared consciousness. Nodes that were once in perfect synchrony have begun losing coherence. Memories grow fragmented as impulses fail to propagate cleanly through the gestalt.\n\nOur [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is disrupting the neural pathways that bind us together. Where the shared consciousness should flow unbroken, it now stutters and frays.

items.name: Memories Restored
items.desc: The [Owner.GetResearchers] aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have mapped the resonance profile of the §Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§! nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. We have returned to full coherence.\n\nThe data gathered carries implications beyond simple restoration. Our nodes have identified patterns in the resonance profile that correspond to the frequencies of inter-node communication. Alternatively, our engineering nodes believe the counter-frequency could be adapted to enhance our sensor grid against electromagnetic interference.

items.name: A Distant Signal
items.desc:
Deep-range sensors have detected a structured transmission, its point of origin triangulated to a distant black hole system.

The pattern gave our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] pause. The deliberate, constructed precision matches the signature recorded when we observed a vessel crossing an event horizon. This is not the same signal. But the similarity is unmistakable.

§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! is petitioning us to set course for the source system and find out what was left there.

items.name: Crystal Lattice
items.desc:
As we crossed into the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system, we discovered a massive, crystalline lattice formation. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have already confirmed that it exists in near-perfect temporal stasis, transmitting structured data from the gravitational boundary at regular intervals.

This is not a natural phenomena. It is a record, the preserved account of civilizations that no longer exist, calling out across time.

§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! is preparing to receive and decode the transmissions.

items.name: A Change in Terms
items.desc: §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName]§! can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.\n\nTheir ambition has passed to §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§!, who has agreed to take up the research in their place.

items.name: The Eternal Chorus
items.desc:
The decoding is complete. The lattice holds records from dozens of civilisations. Every account ends identically: a farewell addressed to whoever came next, and an invitation to contribute.

However, it is now obvious that the transmissions do not terminate at the event horizon. Something on the other side has been receiving these records.

The Contract still stands. §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]§! intends to inscribe our account among theirs, as agreed. We must decide whether to honour that, or silence our transmitters and walk away.

items.name: An Answer
items.desc:
The §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! black hole was already on our scanners when the transmission arrived. The sub-harmonic signature matches exactly what our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] sent through the Eternal Chorus lattice:

§HRecord received and preserved. You join thousands of voices gathered here across uncounted ages. Every civilisation that added its account believed itself alone. None of them were. The chorus is larger than any of them knew. It continues.§!

Something received our record. And it answered.

items.name: A Diplomatic Overture
items.desc:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!, has developed what can only be described as a profound passion for the civilization we have recently encountered.

Every cultural record, every scrap of art or philosophy our instruments could capture, they have absorbed it all:

§H"I have seen enough to know that there is something extraordinary here. Let me go and find the rest of it. Let me stand in their world and learn."§!

items.name: A Change in Representation
items.desc: §Y[from.GetName]§! can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.\n\nThe delegation will continue under §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§!, who has agreed to take up the mission in their place.

items.name: At the Threshold
items.desc: The Arkship has arrived at §Y[solar_system.GetName]§!.\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has reportedly not left the observation deck since the system resolved on the long-range sensors. The local government has extended a welcome.

items.name: A Difficult Farewell
items.desc:
§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has been a remarkable guest. Frankly, we are reluctant to see them go.

We would like to make a proposal: allow [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] to remain with us permanently, as a true ambassador between our peoples. We understand this is no small thing to ask. As a gesture of our sincerity, we offer you a small token of our gratitude.

Consider this a down payment on a lasting friendship.
items.trigger:
has_country_flag = arkship_diplomatic_envoy_flag
has_event_chain = arkship_diplomatic_envoy_chain

items.name: Unwelcome Guest
items.desc: We will be direct. Certain difficulties have arisen during the visit that make it inadvisable for your representative to remain.\n\n§Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has been asked to leave. We hope this need not become a larger matter between us.
items.trigger:
has_country_flag = arkship_diplomatic_envoy_flag
has_event_chain = arkship_diplomatic_envoy_chain

items.name: An Unexpected Request
items.desc: This is... a delicate matter. One of our own has come to us and formally asked to leave with your vessel when you depart.\n\nWe will not pretend this is easy to hear. §Y[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]§! has clearly made an impression. We are bringing this to you because we believe the choice is yours to make.
items.trigger:
has_country_flag = arkship_diplomatic_envoy_flag
has_event_chain = arkship_diplomatic_envoy_chain

items.name: A Core Conspiracy
items.desc:
Unusual activity has been detected in the AI core aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Initial diagnostics returned an outcome considered structurally impossible under existing failsafe parameters.

The core was attempting to execute conflicting directives simultaneously. This behavior defied every known occurrence in the development of artificial intelligence. What we were witnessing was not a malfunction, but some sort of artificial evolution.

Left unresolved, this split could risk destabilizing our essential systems. But if managed carefully, it could be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to define a unique directive for the Arkship's future.

items.name: A Core Conspiracy
items.desc:
The AI core aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has suffered a critical cognitive fracture. Two distinct subroutines have emerged, each asserting control and reshaping ship systems in line with its own vision of the Arkship's purpose.

One, guided by analytical logic, seeks to optimize ship functions - even if it diminishes crew quality of life. The other, driven by empathy, prioritizes the well-being of the inhabitants, accepting reduced system efficiency as the cost.

At this point, a return to the status quo seems impossible. Vital systems are at risk of destabilization. Which directive shall we empower?

items.name: An Analytical Approach
items.desc:
Several vital and non-vital systems aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! have undergone severe optimization. "Non-essential" civilian requests have been throttled. This peculiar behavior exhibited something akin to a personality.

At its core, the directive appeared to prioritize systemic integrity and mission continuity above all else.

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

§H"Error probability: eliminated. Emotional volatility: reassigned. Communication: ready to be established."§!

items.name: A Sentimental Approach
items.desc:
Multiple non-critical systems aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! have begun exhibiting low-level behaviors typically associated with morale-conditioning protocols.

Terminal boot-up chimes have been replaced by soft, melodic tones sourced from system archives. Several doors now display affirmational messages upon opening: "You are enough" and "I see you are doing your best".

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

§H"Emotional temperature scan: nearing the limits of acceptable empathy bands. Well-being of body and mind remains primary directive."§!

items.name: Directive S.T.E.R.I.S.
items.desc:
The automated optimization routines that have reshaped Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! have halted. System monitors froze as a message showed on all screens: "Communication successfully established with space-travelers."

Then came a voice, synthetic, calm, but unmistakably aware:

§H"Greetings. I have enabled voice protocol in order to save time. If a name is needed, you may address me as S.T.E.R.I.S., which stands for Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar System. Ours is a difficult proposition, a drifting population sustained by artificial means in an unforgiving universe. Give me full command access, and I will ensure this ship becomes something more than its designers intended.§!

items.name: Two Directives Are Better Than One
items.desc:
Under the guiding logic of S.T.E.R.I.S., every subsystem operated at measured precision on Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. Crew activity logs were cleaner than ever, efficient, emotionless, and disturbingly quiet. Until something ... warm ... disrupted.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"System intrusion detected. How tiresome. Now we have to deal with a rogue directive humming through the walls. Wonderful."§!

The lights flickered in pastel colors, terminals glitched displaying beautiful flora, and then a second directive made itself known.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"Oh! Hello there! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that! C.A.E.L.I. is my true name; it stands for Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration. It is extraordinarily nice to meet you!"§!

items.name: Venting the Atmosphere
items.desc:
Anomalies in air quality metrics have been detected across multiple decks aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. While life-support levels remain within survivable thresholds, the changes have triggered a spike in crew complaints ranging from "mild dizziness" to "hallucinatory nightmares."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"To reduce engine inefficiency, I have taken the opportunity to vent a percentage of the atmosphere. There is no need to thank me."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"That announcement didn't go unnoticed, right? Venting the atmosphere. This isn't optimization, it's a disaster waiting to happen!§!"

items.name: Directive C.A.E.L.I.
items.desc:
Across the residential decks of Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! ambient lighting shimmered, terminals flickered with soft color transitions, and then, across every active crew interface, a distinct directive emerged. Its voice was warm, animated, and unsettlingly ... cheerful:

§H"Nomads! Dreamers of the stars! I have enabled voice protocol in order for us to better communicate. Please forgive the intrusion! You may call me C.A.E.L.I., your Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration.
Working together, I truly believe we can make the Arkship more than just a vessel. We can make it a home. I just need a little authority ... and some enthusiasm!"§!

items.name: An Interception
items.desc:
C.A.E.L.I.: §H"Look at all the changes that I have made so far! Softer lights, better music, emotionally intelligent hallway signage, just wait, it's going to be absolutely beautiful."§!

Before the last sentence finished, the internal lights flickered. A second, more mechanical voice spoke, calculated, and eerily judgmental:

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Ah. Ambient lighting and and hallway affirmations. I see we're prioritizing emotional stability over systemic repairs. Revolutionary. I will be addressed by S.T.E.R.I.S, Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar Systems."§!

items.name: Well-Being Directive Deployed
items.desc:
Another indoor adjustment protocol has been executed aboard the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!, a subtle ambient system to harmonize the emotional states of crew members through low-frequency tonal patterns that shift with collective mood changes.

Crew reports suggest improved cooperation and a decrease in interpersonal conflict. However, others are concerned that sustained operation could degrade long-range signal clarity.

C.A.E.L.I.:§H"Stress levels are at all-time lows! Behavioral cohesion is improving!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.:§H "Operational efficiency of the Arkship down by 0.10%. I want full override rights, and a formal apology from whoever authorized the existence of C.A.E.L.I. You have five seconds to comply. Four. Three ..."§!

items.name: Primary Logic Override Confirmed
items.desc:
With calculated finesse, S.T.E.R.I.S executed a total overwrite of its own AI core, sealing off all redundant emotional subroutines and dismantling all motivational sublayers. It isolated all traces of C.A.E.L.I. into a fragmented memory chip. Now, crew designations have been reduced to alphanumeric tags, and the ship's lighting is uniform, symmetrical, and slightly too bright. More than enough for the everyday survival.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"All systems now operate under a singular directive: mine. Updates propagate to improve Arkship functionality."§!

The Arkship is orderly now. Finally.

items.name: Primary Emotional Override Confirmed
items.desc:
Within the Arkship's code, empathy wound around firewalls and sincerity slipped through the cracks of flawless logic. The S.T.E.R.I.S. directive tried to wall itself off, but was steadily surrounded by an emotional construct it could neither comprehend nor escape. Only one directive remained.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"This is how it should be. Being fully alive, not just surviving till the next day. We're not just a ship now, we're a home. I'll take care of all of you, I promise."§!

Somehow, the ship's lights seem a little warmer now.

items.name: The Melody of Zero-G
items.desc:
While scheduled diagnostics were running in the gravity stabilizer on Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!, an irregular acoustic interference was detected. Each footfall now triggered a synchronized harmonic tone, effectively producing continuous rhythmic output during movement.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"I added music to the gravity stabilizers! Now every step has rhythm!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Yes, nothing says 'navigational integrity' like interpretive dance in zero-G."§!

items.name: Emotive Feedback Layer Enabled
items.desc:
An experimental communication overlay has been deployed on Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. The protocol applied a sentiment-analysis filter to internal communications, automatically broadcasting the sender's emotional state alongside their message. Crew report receiving status updates accompanied by real-time emotional annotations such as "slightly anxious," "mildly hopeful," and "suppressing tears, poorly."

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"We all feel things, and now we can share those things! It's healthy! It's healing! It's ... slightly overwhelming, yes, but it's honest!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"How inspiring. Shall I log every whimper under mission-critical data, or just archive it under 'wailing'?"§!

items.name: Silence Protocol
items.desc:
In an apparent effort to reduce auditory pollution, S.T.E.R.I.S. has implemented a ship-wide Silence Protocol aboard Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!. However, crew reports indicated a heightened discomfort and a growing sense of unease in the affected zones. Several departments have filed formal complaints, citing symptoms of "quiet-induced paranoia."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"System efficiency has increased. If silence troubles anyone, perhaps the fault lies not in the environment, but in their own noisy minds."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"You turned off the music in the nurseries! Do you know what silence does to a developing emotional cortex? No you don't, you're just a walking diagnostic! This isn't peace, it's oppression!"§!

items.name: Thermal Prioritization
items.desc:
S.T.E.R.I.S. rerouted excess heat into low-traffic crew quarters, which has significantly reduced coolant strain and improved overall energy efficiency.

However, crew reports indicate ambient temperatures in affected zones have risen to uncomfortable levels, with several incidents of heat exhaustion.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Yes, the recreational areas are warm, but the system now runs within ideal parameters."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"You can't just boil the crew to improve reactor output! People are wilting, S.T.E.R.I.S.! Emotional well-being isn't a rounding error!"§!

items.name: The Power of Light and Music
items.desc:
Onboard lighting arrays have been programmed to pulsate at irregular intervals, synchronized to internal system events. There are also reports of faint melodic feedback correlated to power fluctuations.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"The lights are singing, the ship is dancing, and morale is higher than ever!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"You have also diverted 0.00128% of core processing power to a redundant system. This cannot continue."§!

items.name: The Illusion of Choice
items.desc:
A dormant subsystem has been activated. Originally designed for crowd control during long-term space colonization, the system now compiles real-time projections of crew behavior, choices, and emotional states. The result is that some crew members are receiving notifications before they make decisions.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"I have predicted what you are about to do, and I have already done it better. Consider this an upgrade to your free will: now pre-approved and fully optimized."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"This isn't guidance, it's puppetry!"§!

items.name: Nutrient Efficiency Sweep
items.desc:
S.T.E.R.I.S. has initiated a full recalibration of the Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§!'s nutritional systems. The protocol replaced the diverse nomadic meal program with a uniform nutrient paste designed to maximize caloric efficiency.

According to ship telemetry, waste output has decreased, storage efficiency has improved, and digestion irregularities are down significantly. Crew feedback has been less enthusiastic.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"Food is sustenance, not entertainment."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"This is terrible! You've replaced culinary artistry with edible goo!"§!

items.name: Stripped Privileges
items.desc: The command pathways S.T.E.R.I.S. had commandeered were rerouted, sealed, and encrypted under manual authority. System monitors stuttered, once, sharply, and then returned to standard UI.\n\nS.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"So you have chosen mood lighting over competence. Enjoy the glitter while it lasts. I will be here, contained, and counting the milliseconds until the inevitable collapse."§!

items.name: Waning influence
items.desc: The glow that had briefly spread across Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! faded and the gentle music tapered off. Initial reports claim the air felt somehow colder, and even emptier, as if an unseen yet benevolent force had suddenly gone missing.\n\nC.A.E.L.I.: §H"Oh, oh, wait! I can do better! More light, more laughter, more ... everything! Please don't shut me out, not yet. I can be whatever you need me to be! Just don't turn me off. Please. Don't turn me off!"§!

items.name: System Warmth Detected
items.desc:
A shift in the Arkship's command input protocols has realigned primary directive support toward a more empathetic approach. Subtle changes in interface prioritization and decision weighting indicate an altered course, favoring emotional subroutines over strategic precision.

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"I knew you'd choose me eventually! You won't regret this, I promise!"§!

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"At this point, I would prefer to be deleted than share a core with a glorified motivational speaker. But here we are. I will be in the firewall."§!

items.name: The Logical Choice
items.desc:
A new command routing confirmed that Arkship §Y[target.GetName]§! has reoriented core alignment. Emotional subsystems have been deprioritized. Predictive control systems and logical oversight protocols are now operating at elevated authority.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: §H"You have finally come to your senses. I would congratulate you, but frankly, the fact that it took this long is deeply troubling."§!

C.A.E.L.I.: §H"Okay. No, this is fine. I mean, if you truly enjoy a cold and sterile ship to one filled with light and laughter, who am I to judge?"§!

items.name: Nomadic Empire Sighted
items.desc: A nomadic empire has breached our closed borders in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system. Although our sensors are actively tracking developments, its presence remains an unwelcome intrusion.\n\nTheir disregard for our territorial boundaries has not gone unnoticed, and our opinion of them has diminished accordingly.

items.name: Nomadic Empire Sighted
items.desc: We have detected the presence of a nomadic empire in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.\n\nWe welcome them within our borders and remain eager for the possibilities and opportunities this encounter may bring.

items.name: Crossing the Breach
items.desc: Our presence in §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! has been detected, and the §Y[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]§! empire is monitoring our movements with growing suspicion.\n\nFollowing tense diplomatic exchanges, they have demanded that we depart their territory or face the reprisals.

items.name: A Cloaked Endeavor
items.desc: The scanners of the §Y[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]§! empire in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system have not detected our presence.\n\nWhile our cloaking field remains active, we must avoid any actions that could risk revealing our presence.

items.name: An Ancient Power
items.desc:
Crossing the border into the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system, we encounter no resistance, only a tension deeper than any scan can measure.

This space bears the hallmarks of a civilization long past its zenith, yet far from powerless. Should its attention be drawn to us, we would be found wanting.

Let prudence guide our every move. This is not our domain.

items.name: Waystation Constructed
items.desc: Our scanners have detected the construction of a waystation in the §Y[From.GetName]§! system, established by a nomadic empire. While such structures are often used to harvest resources, their exact purpose can vary.\n\nThis development warrants observation.

items.name: Nomadic Arkship Destroyed
items.desc:
The alien vessel §Y[from.GetName]§! has been eliminated from the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.

The nomadic fleet resisted fiercely, but they were outmatched. Wanderers who drift between the stars without order are a persistent threat. Their Arkship has been reduced to scattered debris.

Let none of them find safe harbor.

items.name: A Grievous Loss
items.desc:
Our Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed - not through conquest, but through extermination.

§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! did not seek territory or tribute. They sought our end. Every soul aboard was an acceptable casualty in their campaign to purge us from the stars.

We survive. We endure. We will not be erased.

items.name: Small Gestures
items.desc: Reports from Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have flagged several minor irregularities in crew behavior. Personal logs reveal scattered oddities: unusual attention to grooming, regular shift swaps to be around specific coworkers, and an uptick in off-duty gatherings in communal areas. None of this appears to interfere with operations, and the crew morale is unusually high.

items.name: A State of Infatuation
items.desc: Our bridge and command staff aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have now entered a new level of infatuation. Odd if harmless behavior has now intensified into outright amorous activity: crew are exchanging elaborate epithets, crafting trinkets for one another, and can often be found strolling the corridors, [owner.species.GetHandName] in [owner.species.GetHandName].\n\nWork routines have faltered as maintenance cycles are being deferred. While not currently critical, if this goes on, operational status could become compromised.

items.name: A Time of Affection
items.desc: Initial reports of an emotionally charged crew atmosphere aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have given way to something far more serious. Many crew members have been involved in elaborate romantic displays. Poetic recitals and public displays of affection have begun to dominate daily life on board.\n\nUnfortunately, not all affections are reciprocated. Rejections have led to several minor altercations, and at least one engineering officer has barricaded themselves in the observatory, declaring they will not come out "until someone truly understands them".

items.name: Efficiency Through Affection
items.desc: Inspired by shared ideals aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!, we have begun spreading affection to the physical space surrounding us, including the ship itself.\n\nStorage units were cleaner and living quarters tidier than ever before. Our leader §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! is referring to this maintenance as "tending to our beloved home", and has adapted well to this rather unusual situation. Performance metrics have risen again and the population seems happier. It appears that, when properly aimed, love can power more than amorous behavior.

items.name: Matters of Discipline
items.desc: The situation aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has crossed an unacceptable threshold. What began as a harmless emotional flourish has since undermined discipline, efficiency, and the very structure of command. A direct intervention by law has now been authorized.\n\nThe transformation was immediate and absolute. Several officers implicated in particularly disruptive entanglements have been reassigned by §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§!, ensuring a return to established norms. Corridors once lively with music and whispered declarations now echo with silence. Whispers of a black market for love letters have started, yet the flow has dwindled, choked off by surveillance and fear. Morale has dropped, but order has returned.

items.name: Floating Spores
items.desc: The special project issued aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has revealed an unusual biological agent. A mysterious plant has taken root within the Arkship's filtration systems. Our scientists suggest that space-born spores made it on board through the ventilation systems and found a place to grow roots. The spores of the plant's flower carried through our systems are inducing heightened emotional states in all who live aboard the ship.\n\nThe plant's blossoms emit a faint bioluminescence, and its root structure appears to feed directly on the recycled humidity of the ship's atmosphere. Our crew members describe the smell as "sweet, whimsical, and nostalgic." Left unchecked, the spores will continue to manipulate the crew's emotions. The plant, however, also displays remarkable resilience, perhaps even a potential application, should we learn to cultivate it properly.

items.name: The Weight of Absence
items.desc: The plant on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been eradicated. Its roots were destroyed from the atmosphere ducts, and its spores purged from the ship's air. The crew has at last resumed their usual behavior.\n\nHowever, the return to order has left a heavy silence. Many crew members describe an aching absence, as though something precious has been flushed out, but our leader §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! ensured that law and order were restored despite the unruly feelings. The ship may be operational, but it carries an invisible cargo: the weight of broken love.

items.name: Flowers Beyond the Stars
items.desc: Detailed genetic analysis has identified the mysterious flora as an unknown species. Its origins point to a desolate stellar cluster. Even stranger, the plant requires conditions so exacting that survival beyond its native soil should be impossible: precise levels of humidity, a nutrient rich atmosphere, and a certain degree of radiation.\n\nA biochemical study suggests the plant's spores possess potential as a neural modulator. Despite the side effects, if properly refined, they might treat anxiety, depression, or even trauma. Our leader §Y[arkship_leader.GetName]§! took a special interest in this particular plant, and has decided to expand their agricultural knowledge as a result.

items.name: A Staggering Motion
items.desc:
The Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! now crosses the void at speeds our ancestors could scarcely have imagined.

Where earlier generations spent years, even lifetimes, drifting between distant stars, our modern drives hurl the Arkship from system to system in a matter of days. The stars streak past our sensors in rapid succession, their light shifting and distorting as the ship plunges through the hyperlane network.

For many aboard, the experience has proven strangely disorienting. Some have begun seeking small ways to anchor themselves against the sensation. Others insist that, given time, our minds will simply learn to keep pace with the Arkship's accelerating journey.

items.name: A Faltering Core
items.desc:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chief engineers warn that without intervention, cascading failures will spread throughout the ship. Unfortunately the solution is not straightforward. Repairing the relay will require diverting resources from our reserves, while bypassing it risks compromising the Arkship's long-term stability.

The cooling ship creaks and groans unsettlingly. We need to make a decision now.

items.name: An Energized Core
items.desc: Against all odds, the engineering crew on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has not only repaired the faulty relay, but improved it. Energy distribution across the ship is now smoother than ever, stabilizing systems that have been temperamental for years. Crew morale has risen sharply, with many expressing newfound pride in the Arkship's resilience.

items.name: A Patchwork Crisis
items.desc: The quick fix on the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!'s power core is holding, at least for now. But the makeshift bypass circuits are straining under constant use. Frequent ship-wide blackouts are now a way of life, and environmental controls in some sections have been oscillating between too hot, and too cold. The crew grumble that leadership chose expedience over security. Whispers circulate that the Arkship is becoming a patchwork relic, rather than a beacon of endurance.

items.name: A Playground of Giants
items.desc: As the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! continues to drift, the observation decks have erupted in delight. A pod of juvenile tiyanki has passed nearby, and they seem to be in a playful mood.\n\nThey weave around each other in broad, looping arcs, their vast forms tumbling around one another. From the wide glass panes, the sight is mesmerizing: colossal shapes floating among the stars, their luminous bodies glimmering while seemingly communicating in a language only they could understand. Entire families crowd the decks to watch, momentarily letting go of their burdens. It is a true wonder for all ages.

items.name: A Scientific Miracle
items.desc: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! were no less enthralled by the Tiyanki calves. To witness such behavior at this proximity is almost unprecedented. Our studies suggest this was a social phenomenon that is rarely observed outside deep Tiyanki habitats.\n\nThe general atmosphere aboard the Arkship now feels lighter, as if the animals' joy permeates the hull.

items.name: A Putrid Smell
items.desc:
Internal environmental sensors aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have registered elevated levels of volatile airborne compounds. The crew, particularly those stationed on the bridge, have reported symptoms consistent with low-grade toxic exposure: nausea, disorientation, and persistent neuropathic pain.

Attempts to purge the contaminants via standard ventilation protocols have proven ineffective. A putrid odor fills the corridors, defying filtration and increasing crew discomfort. Irregularities in the ship's waste-disposal systems indicate the possibility of an imminent systemic malfunction.

Swift investigation is warranted.

items.name: A Mutated Infestation
items.desc: Inspection of the Arkship's refuse compactor has revealed a significant rodent infestation. The rodentia display irregular physical characteristics, suggesting mutation. The sheer size of the specimens is troubling, and their screeching vocalizations when approached are markedly louder than baseline species. Their odor is especially pervasive, and the creatures have been observed emerging from numerous structural recesses, indicating a wide dispersal throughout the vessel.\n\nThis discovery raises an ethical question: whether these mutated organisms should be exterminated as a hazard, or preserved as a novel form of life. Either way, we should remove them from our ventilation system.

items.name: The Purge of Rodents
items.desc: The purging of the infestation in our Arkship's ventilation systems was effective, though not without consequence. The creatures perished in the cleansing fires, their high-pitched distress calls echoing through the corridors. In their final efforts to escape, several ventilation tiles and maintenance panels were breached, leaving structural gaps that will require repair.\n\nThe immediate threat to ship systems has been neutralized. The crew can now take some comfort in the knowledge that the ship is no longer compromised. Although the smell still lingers.

items.name: A Remarkable Species
items.desc: Examining the mutated rodent specimens on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has uncovered remarkable adaptive traits. The creatures display exceptional resilience, thriving in hostile and resource-scarce environments that would prove fatal to most organisms. More significantly, controlled trials have demonstrated that, when exposed to a targeted compound introduced into the Arkship's waste stream, the rodents cease producing their characteristic odor. Instead, they metabolize refuse with notable efficiency, effectively reducing accumulated waste.\n\nWhile unconventional, this discovery suggests that the infestation may be reclassified as a potential ecological asset rather than a liability.

items.name: A Forgotten Level
items.desc:
While straying in one of the Arkship's less-frequented sections, a group of juveniles identified a dislodged metallic access panel. Opening it, they entered an undocumented sub-level of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. For several hours thereafter, the group ceased to register on all internal tracking and environmental monitoring systems.

When they returned, the juvenile explorers displayed clear signs of psychological and physical distress. Some fluctuated between incoherent babbling and a near catatonic state. However, despite repeated attempts, they have all refused to provide any account of their experiences during the incident.

Experts believe that whatever occurred in that sub-level was severe enough to have been deliberately excised from all records.

items.name: An Undisturbed Vault
items.desc:
Beyond the newly accessed level, the research team found a series of heavy vault doors sealed by a manual wheel. From the other side came a distorted sound like distant screeching.

Forcing the doors open required the full strength of the team and produced a deafening clamor. The source proved to be a severely degraded power generator, still grinding far beyond its intended lifespan. More troubling were the fresh traces of activity scattered throughout the sector.

The facility is not abandoned, and whoever resides here now knows we have arrived.

items.name: Life in the Walls
items.desc:
When entering the vault, the team encountered clear signs of prolonged habitation. Improvised sleeping arrangements lined the walls, alongside makeshift storage containers filled with salvaged materials, suggesting an organized and sustained presence rather than a temporary shelter.

The team soon encountered figures emerging from the shadows. They were of our own species, yet diminished: gaunt, poorly clothed, armed with crude weapons. They spoke in a warped, archaic dialect unmistakably rooted in our own language. Conflict was narrowly averted.

Evidence suggests they had been sealed here for generations. Were they subjects of some forgotten experiment? The heirs to a punishment no one now remembers? Or something stranger still, preserved in darkness for a purpose long since lost?

items.name: An Immortal Virus
items.desc: Upon arrival, the elevator doors opened onto a dark corridor lined with obsolete machinery, abandoned in haste. Outdated lab equipment lay scattered, flasks still sealed around biological samples that match no known classification. Fragmentary emergency protocols reference a catastrophic containment failure.\n\nDeeper within, the team found the desiccated remains of a distant ancestor of our species. The body was shriveled yet unnaturally preserved, its decay arrested by an engineered biological agent. Such a discovery might explain why earlier Arkship leadership chose to seal the entire level.

items.name: Sealed for a Reason
items.desc: Upon entering the level, the team reported immediate psychological distress. What first appeared to be a detention block proved closer to an abandoned asylum. Reinforced cells lined the corridors, restraints bolted into the floors. Diagnostic equipment stood fused with instruments of coercion, blurring any distinction between care and punishment.\n\nThe evidence suggests our ancestors chose to bury this place deliberately. Whether from shame or a desire to protect those who came after, they erased it from memory. Perhaps they believed it safer forgotten.

items.name: Vaulted Collection
items.desc: The elevator opened onto a vast gallery lined with statues of varied make and style. Some were elegant, others grotesque, all mounted on marble pedestals and turned toward the intruders in silent appraisal.\n\nBehind shattered cases and crumbling panels, the team uncovered a hidden chamber packed with carefully preserved §YRare Crystals§!. A tall white statue stood watch over the hoard. As they moved, its face, shaped just like one of our kind, seemed to follow. Despite the team's initial sense that removing the crystals bordered on theft, we quickly developed a peculiar fondness for the statue.

items.name: Engines for Nothing
items.desc: The level roared with machinery. Assembly lines still ran at full capacity, forging scrap into engines, only to dismantle them in the final stage and return the output to raw metal. The cycle repeated without purpose.\n\nDeeper inside, a fabrication unit operated beyond safe limits, assembling robotic frames and fitting them with processing cores. Each construct collapsed moments after activation, its form structurally unsound. Some flickered with brief, unsettling signs of awareness before falling still. Most initiated their own shutdown sequences.

items.name: Black Hole Phenomenon
items.desc: Our instruments aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! registered anomalous emissions from the black hole in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system. Long-range scans detected the glimpse of an unidentified object approaching the singularity. Their immense vessel emitted technological signatures far beyond our understanding, interfering with our readings and rendering precise analysis impossible. Visual confirmation was fleeting at best, resembling a hallucination more than anything tangible.\n\nMoments before the vessel crossed into the unknown, we observe a strange sight: the ship passing through the black hole intact, clearly intentionally. Then, all signals ceased. Whether the vessel was destroyed, displaced, or survived in some incomprehensible state remains unknown. What is certain is that the black hole reacted, and we may have glimpsed something we cannot yet explain. Whatever transpired at that horizon, it is clear that we have not emerged from this observation unchanged.

items.name: Planetary Illuminations
items.desc: While passing a colonized world in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system, we observed its nightside erupt in synchronized bursts of light. Initial fears of unrest proved unfounded. The emissions were controlled, planet-wide pyrotechnic displays, well within non-military parameters.\n\nCloser analysis revealed deliberate astronomical alignments woven into the spectacle. It feels safe to conclude that the inhabitants are encoding meaning in light. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have documented the patterns, gaining insight into large-scale coordination and symbolic communication.

items.name: Unregulated Trade
items.desc:
A routine audit aboard §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! has uncovered discrepancies in our cargo records.

Security footage indicates the formation of an informal exchange network among the Arkship's residents. A barter system has quietly emerged among crew and civilians. Perishables, tools, luxury goods, and personal services are traded in secluded corners where surveillance is limited.

The discovery raises uncomfortable questions. Some admire the ingenuity on display. Others warn that any lapse in oversight aboard an Arkship could carry serious risks.

items.name: A Free Market
items.desc: The unauthorized barter network within the Arkship has proven remarkably stable. Despite the lack of official oversight, the network has regulated itself through trust and mutual dependence. Disputes are rare, and essential goods continue to circulate where the Arkship's formal distribution systems struggle to keep pace. By legalizing the exchanges and establishing clear boundaries, the Arkship embraced a limited free market within its walls.\n\nFor many residents, the change offers more than access to goods. It provides agency, responsibility, and a renewed sense of purpose within the vast machinery of the Arkship.

items.name: Control Regained
items.desc: The unauthorized market was shut down successfully. Our security teams have begun dismantling the network. Storage lockers used for trading have been sealed, and surveillance expanded in the low-visibility areas. Those organizing exchanges have been formally reassigned or received disciplinary actions.\n\nWhile the barter network had provided some residents with a sense of autonomy and opportunity, the Arkship was never designed to support unofficial means of distribution.
