On a vessel where every resource must be accounted for, control and predictability remain of highest importance.

items.name: Death and Taxes
items.desc: The barter network operating within the Arkship's maintenance corridors has proven surprisingly efficient. Goods continue to circulate through unofficial channels, filling small but persistent gaps in the Arkship's distribution systems.\n\nCertain intermediaries have been discreetly approached and offered protection from enforcement in return for cooperation. A modest share of each transaction now finds its way back into our official accounts. To the residents, the market remains unofficial and largely invisible to authority. In practice, however, its flows are carefully observed and surprisingly profitable.

items.name: The Skin of a Giant
items.desc: While passing through the planetary belt in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system, we observed several faintly shimmering objects drifting among the debris. Initial scans suggested irregular asteroids, but closer inspection revealed layered, scale-like structures reflecting stellar light in shifting bands of color.\n\nFurther analysis indicates these fragments were partly mineral in origin, partly biological. It seemed to be remnants of an §YEther Drake§! that appeared to have been hit by an asteroid and lost part of its armored hide before leaving the system. Starlight catches the discarded scales, scattering prismatic light across the Arkship.

items.name: Reinforcing the Arkship
items.desc: While studying the scattered scales, we noted the extraordinary resilience of the material. The complex, layered structure reveals a fusion of biological growth and natural armor engineering far beyond our previous assumptions. The scales' layered composition exhibits remarkable resistance to heat, kinetic impact, and energy discharge.\n\nWe experimented with replicating the plating and inserted it into the Arkship's outer hull, where we can enhance its defensive capacity. What once was the armor of a roaming drake will now serve our knowledge to shield us against the many dangers that await in the void.

items.name: Gilded Remnants
items.desc: The drifting fragments of §YEther Drake§! scales in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system have attracted significant attention.\n\nThe scales were cleaned and carefully polished before being crafted into striking ornamental pieces. Once offered on the market, these relics of a legendary creature fetched an exceptionally high price, proving very impressive and profitable.

items.name: The Only Sky We Know
items.desc: Deep within the §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value, it would likely not have ended up forgotten in a storage crate.\n\nThe technology was severely outdated, using data formats that predate several generations of Arkship systems. Some speculate that it may originate from the early days of the journey, perhaps even from the era when our species still lived on a planetary surface.

items.name: Cultural Insights
items.desc: The recovered data shows an old seasonal celebration from our planetary past. It appears to have marked the passing of the colder months and the awakening of nature. Communities gathered to welcome the return of warmth and light. Bonfires were lit, bright colors were spread among participants. The records also describe the sharing of special sweets, singing and dancing together, and simply watching the first blooms of the season as they appeared.\n\nThough such seasonal changes no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the fragments offer a small glimpse into how our ancestors once celebrated this fetsivity.

items.name: Fungal Contamination
items.desc: Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. The organism appears to thrive in the controlled humidity and nutrient-rich substrates of the arkship's agricultural systems, forming dense mycelial networks across multiple production tiers.\n\nContainment attempts have proven ineffective, as the fungus shows no measurable reaction to standard herbicidal treatments. We suspect the species may have adapted rapidly to the enclosed ecosystem of the vessel. If left unchecked, the outbreak could significantly reduce food yields and place additional strain on the arkship's limited agricultural capacity.

items.name: Cleansing Flames
items.desc: Conventional treatments having failed, the contaminated hydroponics tiers were subjected to controlled incineration. Unfortunately, much of the arkship's edible plant stock was lost in the process. Entire growth beds were reduced to ash alongside the infestation, leaving several agricultural sections temporarily barren.\n\nStill, the operation appears to have achieved its objective. With every spore-bearing surface sterilized and the remaining infrastructure thoroughly purged, the fungal species has been eradicated from the ecosystem for good. This knowledge will help us prepare for any other invasive species that might decide to settle on the arkship in the future.

items.name: Mycelial Intelligence
items.desc: The invasive species on §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! operates through a distributed mycelial network capable of rapidly isolating and sacrificing individual segments. Whenever we attempted to extract living samples, the surrounding growth would wither almost instantly, its nutrients seemingly redirected through the network to fuel new blooms elsewhere in the hydroponics decks.\n\nAfter numerous failed attempts, we finally managed to isolate a sufficiently stable sample for controlled observation. The fungus possesses an extraordinarily efficient nutrient redistribution system, one that may have applications in closed ecological environments such as those aboard the arkship, perhaps even copying our own distribution systems.

items.name: Biochemical Conversion
items.desc: Further experimentation with the fungal growth has revealed an unusual chemical reaction. When exposed to specific compounds, the organism rapidly metabolizes the additives and releases a distinct mixture of gaseous byproducts. We realized that these fumes could be harvested and refined.\n\nThe fungus effectively converts simple chemical inputs into a steady stream of volatile compounds, an unexpected but potentially useful process. By cultivated controlled fungal growth in isolated chambers, we believe that the organism could be repurposed as a small-scale biochemical processing system.

items.name: Shared Roots
items.desc: Closer observation of the fungal growth has revealed patterns that suggest a form of biological signaling within its vast mycelial network. To most species this behavior might seem insignificant, but our own biology allows us to recognize and adapt to the subtle exchange.\n\nBy introducing carefully calibrated biochemical signals, we established a rudimentary dialogue with the organism. Since then it has begun redistributing nutrients through its networks and shielding crops from harmful microbes. Soon we realized that what we thought was an intrusion became soon a meaningful symbiosis with another lifeform sharing our gardens.

items.name: Unknown Resource Usage
items.desc: During our monthly stock takes, we have found a persistent discrepancy in the §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! resource systems. Small amount of electricity, consumer goods, and other supplies are being taken at levels exceeding our recorded usage. Experts suggest a leak or malfunction, or a slight discrepancy in the numbers.\n\nAfter investigating further, the results remain inconclusive. No breaches, no failures, no inefficiencies beyond acceptable thresholds. And yet, the numbers remain unchanged. Resources continue to vanish from the system without explanation. Something aboard the Arkship was consuming our resources.

items.name: Unaccounted Generation
items.desc: In an unmonitored section of the Arkship, we discovered a group of young individuals living outside official systems. Drawing on diverted power, air, and food, they have created their own space, experimenting, modifying their surroundings, and expressing themselves beyond supervision.\n\n Research suggests that it is a natural part of the development process of adolescents. They appeared genuinely surprised by the investigation and acted rebelliously. They claimed to have taken only small amounts, carefully enough to avoid immediate detection. They made it clear that they have no intention of giving up this space, and wish to be left alone.

items.name: Legacy Processes
items.desc: In a forgotten maintenance sector, investigators discovered a cluster of outdated worker drones still operating under ancient directives. Their routines appear to predate several system updates, causing them to function outside current logging protocols while only requiring a small amount of resources to function.\n\nFurther inspection revealed the result of their continued activity: a substantial stockpile of refined alloys had been meticulously processed and stored over many cycles. The drones had been quietly gathering and optimizing resources far beyond any current operational requirement.

items.name: Wellness Retreat
items.desc: In a secluded section of the Arkship, we uncovered a hidden wellness retreat operating outside official systems. Diverted power, consumer goods, and water sustain this controlled environment designed for rest and recovery.\n\nThose present showed little concern at being discovered, explaining the space was meant to exist beyond constant need to focus on output and show off efficiency, an escape from the routines of ship life. Even though the Arkship was meant to fulfill every need, some still seek a place meant for pure relaxation.

items.name: Unaccounted Aggregation
items.desc: In a quiet section of the Arkship, we uncovered an undocumented community gathering at regular intervals. The small amount of diverted resources had been used to accommodate these meetings.\n\nMembers described the sessions as an informal exchange centered around specimens collected during the Arkship's harvesting operations, such as minerals, ore fragments, and crystalline formations pulled from surveyed systems. Participants would examine and discuss their findings, comparing compositions and debating their origins.

items.name: Contingency Hoard
items.desc: In a sealed storage compartment, we uncovered a private cache of supplies: consumer goods, air canisters, and power cells all carefully stockpiled and hidden from official inventory systems.\n\nThe individuals responsible were quickly found and offered a simple explanation: preparation. In a system where survival depends entirely on stability, they argued, it would be irresponsible to assume that stability is guaranteed forever. The scale of the hoard suggests long-term planning, far beyond personal use. Not all aboard the Arkship are confident that it will endure forever.

items.name: Total Reclamation
items.desc: In a sealed processing sector, investigators uncovered an unregistered reclamation system, one designed to convert biological remains into usable materials. The system has been operating continuously, far beyond its intended emergency function.\n\nWhile efficient, the process is resource-intensive. Large amounts of energy, chemical catalysts, and processing materials have been diverted to break down, sterilize, and refine organic matter into standardized outputs for reuse within the Arkship. Nothing on the Arkship should be wasted. Not even the dead.

items.name: Beyond the System
items.desc: Following the traces of the disappearing resources, we found a long-overlooked section of the Arkship. Apparently there was a small isolated community living outside official systems. Their habitat was simple, sustained by siphoned resources, taken in amounts small enough to avoid detection.\n\nDespite their circumstances, the environment was stable, attentively maintained, and adapted to their needs. It was clear this was a very deliberate way of living. They offered no resistance and instead asked to explain their choice.

items.name: A Different Way of Living
items.desc: The isolated group spoke openly about their decision. They did not reject the Arkship but they said that the way life within it had evolved. To them, existence had become overly optimized: every action measured, every resource tracked, and every moment accounted for.\n\nThey described a different approach to the mechanism of the Arkship. They valued the freedom to make choices outside of constant oversight. Their way of life was less efficient, but more fulfilling, they claimed. Some among our leadership now questioned whether such communities represented a risk to cohesion, or a necessary expression of individuality within a closed system.

items.name: A Necessary Reckoning
items.desc:
The senior engineering corps aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has submitted a structural assessment that can no longer be deferred. Our home is in critical need of repair.

The proposal is comprehensive: a rotating section-by-section overhaul, beginning with the power generation infrastructure and working through the cultivation decks, the defense section, and the residential districts in sequence. Residents will need to be temporarily relocated. Facilities will be taken offline. Engineering estimates place the full overhaul at approximately ten to eleven standard years, depending on the pace of work.

The work will be disruptive. But the alternative is a vessel that grows less reliable with every parsec.

items.name: The Cultivation Decks
items.desc:
The power generation infrastructure has been certified and brought back to full output. Construction crews are already moving equipment down to the lower agricultural levels.

The cultivation decks will be taken offline section by section. It is not only a structural challenge but a logistical one: food stores will need careful management, and construction residue will linger in the common areas for months.

The hardest part, the engineers say, is not the welding. It is the waiting.

items.name: The Defense Section
items.desc:
With the cultivation decks rebuilt and food production returning to normal, attention shifts to the forward defense section. From the weapons bays to maintenance corridors, everything has been surveyed, and all of it needs work.

Naval readiness will be limited during this phase. The crews responsible for keeping the ship safe are being asked to step aside while their workspace is taken apart and put back together.

They have, by most accounts, been remarkably patient about it.

items.name: The Living Quarters
items.desc:
The defense section has been inspected, reinforced, and returned to service. The crews working on it looked, if anything, relieved to have something useful to do again.

Now comes the final phase: the city districts themselves. The residential blocks, civic halls, and commercial corridors that constitute the living heart of the arkship. Everything else was infrastructure. This is the place inhabitants call home.

Construction barriers will go up one last time. The end is in sight.

items.name: Sector Allocation Disputes
items.desc: With the residential levels sealed for structural survey, engineering teams have begun the unenviable task of redistributing thousands of inhabitants across the rest of the ship. What began as an orderly process has devolved into competing queues, jurisdiction disputes, and at least one formal complaint about lost access to a particularly beloved section of the hydroponics bay.\n\nThe ship's social coordinators are requesting guidance.

items.name: Something Behind the Wall
items.desc: Removal of conduit casings in the generator district revealed something none of the original schematics showed: a three-meter section of structural spine exhibiting advanced fatigue fracturing. Material dating suggests the damage has been present, undetected, for decades.\n\nExpanding the scope of construction to address the damage will take additional time.

items.name: Disruption Allowances
items.desc: Residents of sections unaffected by the ongoing refurbishment are complaining at having to share quarters with relocated individuals.\n\nThey are requesting expanded resource allocations, priority access to recreation facilities, and the immediate removal of an automated announcement system that reminds them, every three hours, that their disruption is 'temporary and appreciated.'

items.name: The Second Shift
items.desc: To maintain the construction schedule, the lead engineer has proposed running three overlapping shifts around the clock. The residential decks adjacent to the work zone report noise levels that have made rest nearly impossible for eleven straight days. Three crew members have been treated for fatigue-related incidents.\n\nThe construction crews themselves are showing signs of strain. Faster, perhaps, but those in charge are not confident in the quality of work produced by exhausted crews.

items.name: Conduit Failure
items.desc: A primary power conduit has ruptured during removal of the old casing. The entire section, including the residential levels, the secondary medical bay, and two food processing units, is now running on emergency lighting only.\n\nOur [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] believe it will be possible to restore full power within a few months. Alternatively, the conduit's routing can be bypassed, drawing from an adjacent generator cluster instead. Faster, but it introduces a permanent workaround into the power grid.

items.name: The Major Concern
items.desc: The project's lead structural engineer has submitted a formal concern: the current timeline, while achievable, is producing work [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] would not personally certify as complete.\n\nNon-critical junction points are being sealed over rather than properly reinforced. Tolerance margins are being set to 'acceptable' rather than 'recommended.'

items.name: First Section Online
items.desc: The first section to complete its overhaul has been declared structurally certified and cleared for reoccupation. The work is genuinely impressive: new framing, modernized conduits, insulation that doesn't crumble at the touch.\n\nThe engineering team is eager to push forward. Residents are clamoring to move back in. However, the full battery of systems tests hasn't been completed. A decision will need to be made.

items.name: The Repair List
items.desc: The project supervisor has compiled the final list of repairs: forty-seven outstanding items before formal structural sign-off. The list ranges from the significant, such as three load-bearing junction upgrades in the aft section, to the cosmetic, including nineteen instances of misaligned paneling and one ventilation grille installed upside-down.\n\nCompleting every item on the list will take additional time. But the list exists precisely because these things matter.

items.name: Homecoming
items.desc: The displaced residents of the most recently renovated section have been given their move-back date. The corridors that were sealed for months are open again, smelling of fresh composite and new insulation. Infants who spent months in temporary quarters are seeing their home section for the first time.\n\nThe mood aboard is the best it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that goodwill of this kind does not last. The question is how to make use of it.

items.name: The Long Wait
items.desc: The residential district renovation is in its final stage, but 'final' has stopped meaning what it once did. The inhabitants relocated from the city blocks have now been in temporary quarters for longer than the original estimate promised.\n\nA request has come through for supplemental resources: better temporary furnishings, priority access to recreational facilities, and a small additional resource allocation. It will not fix anything structural. But it might make the waiting bearable.

items.name: Unauthorized Modifications
items.desc: During demolition of non-load-bearing walls in the mid-residential sections, the renovation crews have discovered something unusual: decades of unauthorized modifications. Hidden rooms, self-constructed alcoves, sealed corridors repurposed as storage or living space. None of it is in the original schematics, and some of it is load-bearing.\n\nThe lead engineer is requesting a decision. Removing everything not in the original plans is the correct approach. It will take time. Working around the modifications is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will be difficult to explain to future engineers.

items.name: The Final Deck
items.desc:
The last deck has passed its preliminary inspection. The scaffolding has already started coming down in the lower sections. By most measures, the renovation is complete.

The engineering supervisor has requested a full secondary inspection before [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] signs off on structural certification. It is, they acknowledge, largely a formality. The deck is almost certainly fine.

However, 'almost' is a word that often bears consequences.

items.name: Structural Overhaul Complete
items.desc: The last section of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been cleared, certified, and returned to its inhabitants. What began as a disruptive necessity has concluded as something approaching an achievement. The ship feels different: not just structurally sound, but somehow more like the vessel it was always supposed to be.\n\nThe engineering corps has submitted its final report with several strong recommendations. The choice of where to direct the fruits of this work belongs to leadership.

items.name: The Pod
items.desc: Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.\n\nA survival pod of unknown origin, its exterior was camouflaged to evade detection across vast stretches of space. No active transmissions were detected, but faint life-support traces persisted within. Whatever lay inside had been adrift for a very long time.

items.name: Dearly Beloved
items.desc:
Beneath the mineral shell, we uncovered a badly damaged stasis pod. Inside we discovered a single occupant, already deceased. Their body was draped in flowing ceremonial vestments, not suited for spacefaring. It appears they were forced inside in haste.

The pod's interior bore unmistakable signs of violence. Several internal restraints had been forcibly engaged. This vessel was no sanctuary; it was a prison. Only two artifacts could be recovered: a set of coordinates, and a sealed message. It bore a simple inscription: 

§H"For my Beloved."§!

items.name: Last Survivor
items.desc:
We have finally arrived at the capsule indicated by the recovered coordinates. Within, we discovered another being, this one still barely alive.

The physical damage is severe. Prolonged stasis failure has left [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] on the verge of death. The two pods had clearly been separated long ago, their destination never reached.

We have stabilized the alien, who has asked us to call [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]. Full recovery remains far from certain.

items.name: The Massacre
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"There was a massacre. Whole families, erased. It was presented as an attack by a rival empire. But that was a lie. Those in power had orchestrated it themselves, a fabricated atrocity to justify a senseless war. My beloved and I found the proof. Internal directives. Unaltered logs.

"We released it. We expected consequences. What we did not expect was exile."§!

Corrupted but recoverable records from the pod's data banks are already in our possession.

items.name: A Bloody War
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"The fleets were already on approach, we saw them long before they reached us. [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] had waged war against us for years, ever since we refused their demands for vassalage. Our forces were hopelessly outmatched.

"In the end, my parents placed their faith in these capsules. They forced my beloved and me into the void, our survival uncertain, our reunion left to chance with only the hope that we might begin anew."§!

A survey of the pod's systems has turned up engineering data from the war period.

items.name: A Dangerous Find
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"Our empire once took great pride in honoring both life and death. Our purpose was to prolong existence and ease the passage between them, but never to transcend it entirely. Immortality, through synthetic ascension, was an abomination to our beliefs. Such knowledge was never meant to be possessed. But curiosity spread among the population. When it could no longer be contained, the ruling authority deemed the risk unacceptable.

"They chose erasure. Our empire was destroyed to bury the truth. Only my beloved and I were spared, forced into these pods, condemned to drift between life and death."§!

The pod's data core has also been decrypted.

items.name: Ambition
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"I had a colleague. A friend, or so I believed. We had worked together for years. When I was appointed to lead the project, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe] offered congratulations.

"A month later, my beloved and I were seized. Fabricated charges. No trial. We were put into the pods before I had finished asking why. I know now that ambition does not need a reason. It only needs an opportunity."§!

Personal logs from the pod's internal systems have given us a detailed record of the empire's governance.

items.name: A Pest
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"A relentless virus swept through our empire. Our people perished swiftly and without mercy. It is believed to have originated from one of our vast landfill complexes, a consequence of our own excess and carelessness. My beloved and I chose to remain to stand with our people until the end.

"But my parents intervened. Against our will, we were forced into these pods and cast away. The technology was meant to preserve us. It seems it failed."§!

Biological residue from the pod's life support systems has been recovered.

items.name: The Hidden Deal
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"My parents knew that [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] was on the verge of awakening. Desperate to secure its favor, they struck a bargain. A quarter of our population was offered in exchange for power. My beloved and I uncovered their design.

"But few listened, and those who did were silenced. We were forced into these pods and cast into the void, discarded, as so many others had been before us."§!

Documentation from the pod's sealed compartments has been uncovered.

items.name: Forbidden Union
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"I was not exiled for what I had done. I was exiled for who I loved.

"Our people were at war. We had been, for generations. In the eyes of our people, our bond was a transgression, one that could not be ignored. We refused to part, believing that our bond might demonstrate the value of peace.

"We were forced into these pods and cast into the relentless void. But our love could not be sundered."§!

Private correspondence between the two exiles was found in the pod. Reading it was inspiring.

items.name: Whispers in the Void
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

§H"It began as a presence at the edge of thought. Then I heard the voice. The whispers followed me, growing clearer with time, speaking in fragments. My people feared what I had become, but my beloved stayed by my side.

"Together, we were forced into this pod and cast into the void, removed before whatever had touched my mind could spread. Even now, I still hear it. Whispering."§!

The pod's sensor logs have revealed an intriguing amount of data.

items.name: Final Words
items.desc:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s condition deteriorated rapidly. Shortly before their passing, we decrypted the sealed message from the companion pod. The transmission reads:

§H"My dearest,

"If you hear this, then fate has been kinder to you than it was to me. Know that, even in the void, I was never alone, I carried you with me, always."§!

Moments after the message concluded, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s vital signs ceased. For the first time since awakening, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] expression was at peace.
