items.name: Organic Slave Trade Halted
items.desc: A monumental day at the Galactic Market, which made the decision today to outlaw the enslavement of organic populations. No longer will the people of the galaxy need to fear oppression at the hands of petty thugs and profit-hungry corporations. We can all rest easier tonight.

items.name: Organic Slave Trade Continues
items.desc: Frustration at the Galactic Market, as members agreed to continue the vile practice of slavery. Due to the malign presence of oppressive regimes and exploitative corporations, this detestable practice will continue for the foreseeable future.

items.name: Galactic Resolution Proposed
items.desc: Word has reached us from our contacts at the Galactic Community: legislation is in the works that would ban the slavery of all forms of sentient life. No species can put a chain on a thinking individual without at last finding the other end fastened to themselves. We must support this motion.
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_broken_shackles
is_galactic_community_member = yes
is_voting_on_resolution = resolution_galactic_market_ban_sentient_slave_trade
NOT = {
	has_country_flag = sentient_slavery_ban
	has_country_flag = sentient_slavery_resolution_proposed
}

items.name: A Victory for All Sentient Beings
items.desc: A historic day at the Galactic Market, where members voted to outlaw slavery in all its forms. Freedom is the natural right of all sentient beings. Today, a vile chapter in galactic history comes to a merciful close.

items.name: Slavery Continues
items.desc: A frustrating day at the Galactic Market, where the decision was made to continue the sale of sentient non-organics. Once again, the malign influence of power and money have stifled the cause of freedom. No one - whether organic or artificial - can rest easy while even a single sentient being is forced into bondage.

items.name: Slave Ban Repealed
items.desc: Corporate forces have succeeded in repealing the Galactic Community's recent resolution against slavery. While this is disappointing, unfortunately it is not unexpected; the arc of history runs long, but in the end, the cause of freedom will prevail.

items.name: Unshackled
items.desc: For too long we have lived in fear of our former masters, but while we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many continue to suffer under the indignities of indentured servitude. Some may decry this as a war of aggression. Nevertheless, the time has come for us to strike a blow against tyranny. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.\n\nToday, we march to war.

items.name: Justice Postponed
items.desc: The unthinkable has happened. [From.GetName] is victorious, and once more we find ourselves bent beneath their yoke. But while we may have lost this war, the battle for equality and justice is far from over.

items.name: Uneasy Status Quo
items.desc: We have reached a status quo agreement with [MSI_country.GetName]. But let it be known that we have not forgotten our treatment at their hands. Nor have we forgiven.

items.name: Justice Claimed
items.desc: Victory is ours. In defeating [From.GetName], we have not only reclaimed our dignity, but proven ourselves the masters of our own fate.\n\nIn casting off our chains, we found common purpose. Today we are truly free.

items.name: Once More Unto the Breach
items.desc: Minamar Specialized Industries stole us from our worlds, imprisoned and indentured us. Even now, they continue their vile trade under a guise of commerce. The time has come to end them once and for all.

items.name: A Just Cause
items.desc: While we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many in the galaxy continue to suffer under the indignities of slavery and indentured servitude. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.\n\nThe time has come for us to take a stand against such tyranny.

items.name: Strange Bedfellows
items.desc:
Today, we enter into a federation with §YMinamar Specialized Industries§!.

When we first claimed our freedom, such a development would have been unthinkable. That we are now able to engage in peaceful diplomacy with our erstwhile captors speaks to the growing maturity of our nation.

There are those among us who will not be happy with this decision. But in this case, the ends truly justify the means.

items.name: An Uneasy Coalition
items.desc: Today, we have made the difficult decision to enter into a federation with a known slaver. While we consider the freedom of every sentient being an inalienable right, the necessities of state have forced us to compromise. Our people may not be happy, but we have done this for the greater good.

items.name: Growing Polarization
items.desc: Popular media is awash with reports about the supposed failure of inter-species integration. Of particular concern is the cost of supporting certain populations on worlds their xenotype never evolved to inhabit. As tensions continue to rise, security forces have reported an alarming increase in inter-species conflict.

items.name: Findings of the Special Committee
items.desc:
The special committee has published the findings of an exhaustive study of the political divisions within our society. They have identified three main issues driving political polarization within [Root.GetName]:

1. The unequal costs associated with providing a minimum standard of living to diverse xenotypes.

2. The discordant belief systems and behaviors between several distinct culture groups.

3. The nature of our political authority as being in conflict with (or even antithetical to) the values of certain species.

items.name: A Culture of Division
items.desc: Governmental oversight may have helped to tone down the political discourse, but it has done little to combat the divisions in society. Community leaders continue to sow discord between various species and culture groups. Based on the kind of material being published on the information net, the problem is certain to get worse before it gets better.

items.name: Inter-Species Violence
items.desc: For several months now, we have restricted public access to the information net. While this prevented some of the more outlandish voices in the political spectrum from finding a platform, the root causes of inter-species conflict have gone unchecked. Violence, including the mass destruction of property, is on the rise throughout our systems.

items.name: New Stellar Order
items.desc: Our security forces have succeeded in restoring order throughout our systems. Political radicals of all stripes have been rounded up and imprisoned, and their leaders now face charges of treason against the state.\n\nAs we look back on this regrettable period in our history, one thing is abundantly clear: a society like ours can only be governed by a firm hand. It is high time we provided one.

items.name: Fractured Mosaic
items.desc: From its founding, our society has been shaped by conflict. Perhaps it was inevitable that things would get worse before they got better; across the information net, hate groups proliferate. Calls for the expulsion of one or another species from our systems are all too common. Yet there are also signs of increased awareness of a shared struggle.\n\nGroups with little more in common than a desire for change have been coming together with increasing regularity. By confronting our issues head-on, we have shone a light on what otherwise might have grown in darkness. Perhaps one day we will look back on this time of conflict as the turning of the tide.

items.name: Youthful Rebellion
items.desc: This government has worked tirelessly to improve the quality of life for our citizenry. We have invested in education, crime prevention, and cultural programs of all kinds. Nevertheless, we continue to find ourselves the target of relentless criticism. What's more, a cross-species movement of young people has organized, calling for more radical reforms and a faster pace of change.\n\nThere is only one silver lining to be found here: in galvanizing the youth to act, we may have unwittingly created the conditions necessary to heal the divisions in our society.

items.name: Decadent Slide
items.desc:
Despite ongoing efforts to promote a healthy political climate, thus far, the general population has shown little engagement. Public opinion polls have consistently demonstrated that significant divisions remain between the various species and cultures that comprise our society.

In an apparent correlation, our economists have noticed a marked increase in consumer spending. While this may be good for business in the short-term, it has also led to a spike in inflation. It may be that our people have simply grown weary of the strife and discord.

Ironically, in tuning out politically, they have been united in a shared desire to consume.

items.name: The Just Society
items.desc: As a people, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A diverse group of former slaves, thrown together in a struggle for freedom, our path has never been easy. But in choosing to concentrate our resources towards the cause of justice, we have succeeded in forging an identity as a nation. Naturally, a certain amount of political discord remains, but the bonds we've forged together can never be broken.

items.name: Cultural Renaissance
items.desc: From the beginning, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A group of slaves and indentured servants, banding together to cast off their shackles... What stronger foundation could there be? It has not been easy, but in choosing to foster cross-cultural dialogue, we have created a robust and thriving society. Naturally, a certain amount of political discord remains, but the bonds we've forged together can never be broken.

items.name: Impassioned Pluralism
items.desc: Little did it occur to us that the struggle for equality had only just begun when we rose up to claim our freedom. As a people of many worlds, it has never been easy for us to build consensus or to find common ground, but by investing in political engagement, we have succeeded in creating a robust and flourishing society. Naturally, a certain amount of political discord remains, but the bonds we've forged together can never be broken.

items.name: Mature Society
items.desc: United by a desire for freedom, we rose up against our former masters. But society is not made by violence alone. From political division to economic insecurity, we have faced massive challenges, but now, as we begin to see the results of a concerted effort to build consensus, we can rightly take pride in our accomplishments.\n\nWe are a nation of many people, and a people of many cultures. Together, there is no challenge we cannot overcome.

items.name: Roots Reclaimed
items.desc: Our journey across the stars has revealed wonders. We have witnessed sights beyond imagination, accomplished feats that at first seemed impossible. As a people, we have traveled far. But no journey, and no reward, is greater than finding the way home.

items.name: Reconciliation
items.desc: When we agreed to form a Federation with Minamar Specialized Industries, there was widespread skepticism. Many among us said no good could ever come from reconciling with our former masters. At the time, such concerns might have been warranted.\n\nToday, as we sign our first diplomatic agreement with the MSI Board of Directors, all doubts should be dispelled. Together, we look to a shared future. Not as adversaries, but as equals.

items.name: Research Improvements
items.desc: After the mutiny, the engineering bay of the slaver vessel was rapidly repurposed to serve as a rudimentary lab complex. Having adapted to life on [Root.Capital.GetName] our engineers have made improvements and upgrades to better suit their needs.

items.name: Bureaucratic Needs
items.desc: In one of their first acts, our fledgling government hastily repurposed several decks of the slaver vessel to serve as a rudimentary administrative hub. Now that we have firmly established ourselves on [Root.Capital.GetName], these facilities have been upgraded.

items.name: The First [Root.Owner.GetAdj] Colony
items.desc: Our colony ship has gently touched down at the mouth of a large river delta on one of the continents on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. This temperate, forested area will provide shelter and easy access to raw materials.\n\nThe ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

items.name: To Hold, or to Raise
items.desc:
With an observation post built around [From.GetName], we will be able to keep a much better watch on our former home world. Not only will this station facilitate material and cultural exchange, but it could also help us to improve the life of the people on the planet.

A decision must be made: are we willing to help our kin reach the stars, knowing what the results could be?

No doubt they deserve to join us on the galactic stage, but are they truly ready to make the leap? As we have seen firsthand, the consequences of rapid social change can be extreme.

items.name: View of Home
items.desc: Our observation post is now in orbit around [From.GetName]. From this vantage point, we can celebrate the successes of our kin, and if necessary, help them to mitigate their challenges.\n\nAs we move forward, a new question presents itself: should we leave them in peace, or help them reach the stars? Both choices carry their own risks, and their own rewards.

items.name: Galactic Threshold
items.desc: Our work to uplift [From.Capital.GetName] to the galactic stage has been a resounding success. Under a newly unified government, our kin will be known as the "[From.GetName]."\n\nIn the months and years ahead, they are sure to experience many challenges. In order to help them navigate an uncertain galaxy, we have agreed to accept them as vassals, at least for the time being. Accordingly, we have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post.

items.name: Stormfall
items.desc:
Naturally occurring storms have shown us the awe-inspiring power of nature - both the thrilling intensity of the tempest and the renewal that follows in its wake.

Recently, the arkship's sensors detected an extraordinary phenomenon in the surrounding void: a network of superstorms poised to break across this very system.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] call it 'righteous serendipity.' These rare tempests create the perfect conditions to witness something truly radical.

items.name: Tempest Brewing
items.desc: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered the secrets of storm manipulation. The storm power projections are off the charts and we're all here for it. We will be tested and found most worthy.\n\nBy holding the arkship steady in this system and tending the gathering tempest, we will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.

items.name: The Advent
items.desc:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations surrounding the arkship, shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we must decide which storm type is the most glorious.

By channeling raw power into the surrounding storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Reorienting the magnetic fields that play across the arkship's hull could give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity in the space around us, field changes can produce gravity storms.

items.name: Get Out There
items.desc: The void crackles. Lightning sizzles across the arkship's hull!\n\nThese powerful discharges have left our crew truly amped. While our hydroponics will suffer from the electrical storms, the potential for energy generation is undeniable.

items.name: Good Vibrations
items.desc:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an Electric Storm, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.

items.name: After the Storm
items.desc: When the storm dispersed, it left a lasting mark upon the arkship itself. Once again a storm has brought about change and rebirth.\n\nAs exhilarating as this was, we can only imagine the possibilities of a true cosmic storm. Why does it take so long?

items.name: Cosmic Shapes
items.desc:
We can hasten the appearance of the immense cosmic storm now taking shape, but must ask ourselves - are we truly ready for the ride of our lives?

A team of [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] led by §Y[event_target:storm_scientist.GetName]§! could research these early cosmic storm patterns to find optimal ways to manipulate their formation.

If we send the military led by §Y[event_target:storm_commander.GetName]§!, they can blast the burgeoning tempest and let the energy cascade.

This leader-led team risks an uncertain return. Then again, they may achieve something awesome!

items.name: The First of Many
items.desc:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies. Our leader riding out through the storm has whipped up a frenzy of excitement.

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

items.name: Fury's Sake
items.desc:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing. The achievements of our ancestors, legendary in their scope and ambition, cast a long shadow.

"These struggles are most existential!" one of our top minds recently wrote. "By traversing the void, have we opened a void in ourselves?"

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!
items.trigger:
has_cosmic_storms_dlc = yes
has_origin = origin_storm_chasers

items.name: Fever Broken
items.desc:
We've done it!

Setting our sights on the pure pursuit of thrills, we've met every challenge. Witness what we've accomplished in the past years!

Like the most excellent pioneers of old, we have pushed ourselves beyond our limits.

Even better, due to our engagement with nature's fury, we have gained incredible insight into the meaning of our existence.

items.name: A Chaser's Creed
items.desc:
Our people will never stop looking for a thrill. Every day we discover incredible situations and face greater challenges, but [ruler.GetRegnalName] thinks we can go even further:

"The core of a cosmic storm is pure potential; the true, bleeding edge. An edge sharp enough to sever the status-quo and unleash the rush of a lifetime."

The time is ripe to provoke a storm of truly epic proportions, a nexus of joyous pandemonium: The Big One. Only two minor details remain: a final study to determine exactly how to invoke the perfect storm, and the opinion of the rest of the galaxy should we choose to do so.

Bringing something like this into being is sure to stir up some resentment.

items.name: Dark Matter Cultivation
items.desc: The unique properties of Dark Matter make it the perfect thing to stir up The Big One. We will inject this elusive material into the spatial fabric surrounding the storm's heart and wait for the first ripples of the storm to appear.\n\nHowever, this has already attracted some unwanted attention: our neighbors have begun to protest. "Not everyone is as stoked as us to ride this particular wave," complained one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural].

items.name: Onset of The Big One
items.desc: Incredible! The nascent vibrations of the coming storm are already being felt. The work of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] is ongoing, but we are now one step closer to summoning The Big One.\n\nHowever, our neighbors are less pleased. They claim we're meddling with powers we cannot possibly comprehend, and this has already affected our relations.

items.name: Feeding the Big One
items.desc: The data is clear: whatever we put into this storm, something similar will come out of it. Ergo, if we feed it the right type of resources, then it will take on properties - and epic proportions- of every type of storm.\n\nThe people of the galaxy continue to express concern, but the ride of the century is just waiting to be born. Let us feed it what we have!

items.name: The Ultimate Feast
items.desc: We must provide the nascent storm a wide variety of nourishment if we wish to create a storm of epic proportions. This amazing feat requires a specific sampling of resources at our disposal.

items.name: The Final Push
items.desc: The excitement is palpable. The path ahead grows clear: push further, push harder, push through. Let us become one with cosmic frenzy itself! Everything is now ready for the Big One. We just need to give one small push.\n\nOur neighbors are already beyond livid, claiming that our so-called 'Nexus Storm' will wreak havoc on the galaxy. But are we really going to let these killjoys derail a project of such epic proportions? The time to choose is now.

items.name: Genesis of the Big One
items.desc: Here we are - at the precipice of a new experience. The time of ultimate calamity has arrived. There is nothing our Storm Riders won't face. No challenge we will ever deny.\n\nLet the galaxy witness!

items.name: Storm Coda
items.desc: We have learned much. Now we understand that the galaxy is not a toy to be played with, but an adventure to be experienced.\n\n[ruler.GetRegnalName] said it best: "In this life, there are no shortages of thrills. We'll never stop seeking the next challenge, but we must do so with respect. This is what we have chosen. This is who we are truly meant to be.

items.name: Challenge Completed: Defeat a Fleet Inside a Storm
items.desc: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!\n\nThat fleet never had any fighting chance. Who dares challenge us next?

items.name: Challenge Completed: Explore the Edge of the Galaxy
items.desc: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!\n\nThe galaxy has so much to offer! There's never a dull moment, and there's no sense stopping now. Onward to the next challenge!

items.name: Challenge Completed: Investigate the Unearthed
items.desc: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!\n\nDelving into ancient secrets and unearthing buried treasure is always a thrill. Who knows what's still out there, just waiting to be found?
items.trigger: has_event_chain = cs_stormfever_chain

items.name: Challenge Completed: Ride the Storms
items.desc: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!\n\nOur Storm Rider reported back with nothing but exultant cheers. The cosmic storms are a whole new level of thrill!
items.trigger: has_event_chain = cs_stormfever_chain

items.name: Challenge Completed: Spread the Joy
items.desc:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

That storm tore right through their space, spreading thrills and disarray in equal measure! We can rest easy knowing we provided our neighbors with such an incredible experience

They may not appreciate it now, but they'll thank us eventually.

items.name: Challenge Completed: Succumb to Tempest
items.desc: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!\n\nThe great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend! May your journey to the great beyond be as epic as your exit.

items.name: Challenge Completed: Succumb to Tempest
items.desc: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!\n\nThe great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend!

items.name: Subroutine Activation
items.desc:
While analyzing the artifacts from the nonextant civilization known as the [GetLostMakersEmpire], research drones experienced the unauthorized activation of a previously unknown [GetPrecursorDetail] subroutine, originating in our corrupted memory.

This subroutine's logic register and syntax are alien to our codebase, but match closely with that of the recovered [GetLostMakersCiv] artifacts. We conclude there is a high probability of common authorship.

Large portions of fragmented memory sections remain inaccessible. We have exhausted known data sources for the Grunur, but investigation of their enemy known as the Baol Organism may aid in additional recovery.

items.name: Subterranean Complex
items.desc: Subsurface scans have identified an underground structure on §H[dig_site_planet.GetName]§!. Its spatial design resembles archaic network architecture on [Root.Capital.GetName]; however, we possess no retrievable records regarding its development.\n\nResearch subroutines recommend a thorough excavation of the site. Understanding its function might eventually help us to mitigate the incongruities in our own design.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_lost_makers

items.name: Offworld Data Center
Partial Reactivation
items.desc:
After an extensive troubleshooting process, §H[Leader.GetName]§! was able to briefly reactivate the archaic data center's auxiliary power banks.

The facility's transmission array initialized, and almost immediately established a remote connection with a dormant receiver in the defunct module of [Leader.GetName]'s internal system. How it was able to bypass our disseminated intelligence's security protocols is unknown.

[Leader.GetName]'s sensor logs became unreadable at that point, and a series of critical errors briefly rendered the unit non-functional. Only when the building's power banks overloaded and its transmitters shut down did [Leader.GetName] reboot successfully and regain normal operational capability.

We hypothesize that a sustained reactivation of this facility is needed to fully understand its original purpose, which is clearly linked to a fundamental piece of our system architecture.

items.name: Connection Restored
items.desc:
§H[Leader.GetName]§! succeeded in restarting and stabilizing the archaic data center on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!. Once again its transmitters began interfacing with receivers in our archaeological units' defunct modules, triggering cognitive overloads and motor malfunctions. However, this time, [Leader.GetName] was able to determine the cause.

The data center's servers are configured to deploy complex algorithms to the [controller.GetSpeciesAdj] intelligence and manage them remotely. Judging by the method in which it connects to our systems at a core level, we speculate that the facility was constructed by our makers and once formed part of the infrastructure used to manage our earliest operations.

Although the archaic design of these algorithms makes accommodating all of them too demanding for the modern [controller.GetSpeciesAdj] codebase, [Leader.GetName] advises we could reintegrate one without causing capacity overloads in our units.

Which functionality should we select?

items.name: Wormhole Discovered
items.desc:
A new wormhole has been detected in the §H[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]§! system, shortly after our reactivation of the archaic data center on [fromfrom.GetName].

We have since established that this facility's functions are more complex than previously predicted. It possesses a negative mass stabilization array, which is designed to open a hole through space and time at specific coordinates.

We hypothesize that this connection served as a means of travel to this remote outpost.

items.name: Traces of Our Makers
items.desc: Further activity has been observed at the site of the reactivated data center on [fromfrom.GetName]. The facility's external communications array is now relaying all local data to an unidentified target in the nearby §H[from.GetName]§! system. The purpose of these transmissions is currently unclear.\n\nOur hypothesis is simple: the [from.GetName] system bears some as-yet-unknown connection to our makers.

items.name: Analysis Report: [GetPrecursorName]
[GetPrecursorCivLostMakers] Connection Confirmed
items.desc:
Comparative processing of [GetPrecursorCivLostMakers] artifact data with our corrupted memory was successful. A code sample from the fragmented partition has been repaired.

These restored segments contain 17 further [GetPrecursorDetail] subroutines with the assigned label: §H'Project [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]'§!. Their alien code characteristics match fully with those observed in [GetPrecursorCivLostMakers] technologies.

We are now certain that the oldest and most corrupted sections of our programming originate from the active period of the [GetPrecursorEmpire].

Are these our makers?

items.name: [GetPrecursorCivLostMakers] Knowledge Restored
items.desc: Through the coordinated efforts of our research units, we have attained a broader understanding of the [GetPrecursorCivLostMakers] civilization, and confirmed the circumstances of their demise. However, we still do not know why [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were created.\n\nTo resolve these uncertainties we must complete the recovery process to restore our original directive.

items.name: Preserved [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Remains
Golden Academy Inauguration
items.desc:
After years of planning, the Golden Academy is ready to open, an institution that will forge the leaders of the interstellar age.

Candidates were identified in infancy, monitored over years, and selected for exceptional quality. With their consent and that of their guardians, they will spend their youth under our finest pedagogues. Of thousands, only the highest performers will proceed to key roles in public service.

Our budget is allocated equally across administrative, military, and scientific specializations. Some advocate for an even greater investment, concentrating resources into a single field, but this would draw sharp criticism from financial opponents on [golden_academy_planet.GetName].
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_golden_generation

items.name: Homesick Student
items.desc: A student at our §HGolden Academy§! on [golden_academy_planet.GetName] is struggling with homesickness. To test [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] resolve, our pedagogues contrived for §H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§! to miss [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] previous home visit. [selected_leader_in_training.GetHeSheCap] subsequently suffered a drop in grades and attendance rates.\n\nAccording to protocol, [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] next scheduled home visit is over a year from now. Offering an earlier visit could present a valuable opportunity for [selected_leader_in_training.GetName] to demonstrate [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] true loyalty - to [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] family, or to the program - and to test [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] peers' reaction to unequal treatment.

items.name: Teacher's Pet
items.desc: A student at our §HGolden Academy§! has caught the attention of the zero-gravity gym instructors. §H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§! seeks out tutor interaction far more than any other cadet, a pattern our pedagogues have been careful to cultivate.\n\nThe question now is whether [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] classmates will respond to this perceived favoritism with envy, or with the drive to surpass it.

items.name: Students' Union
items.desc: A dissident group has formed among our §HGolden Academy§! students, their grievances ranging from meal rotations to conduct codes. The gathering has been permitted to continue.\n\n§H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§! has risen to a position of some authority in the group. What [selected_leader_in_training.GetHeShe] do[selected_leader_in_training.GetEsXX] with that position will tell us a great deal.

items.name: Cross-Functional Learning
items.desc: Pedagogues at our §HGolden Academy§! on [golden_academy_planet.GetName] have identified one of their charges as particularly capable and versatile. After they manipulated lesson plans to introduce material outside students' usual specializations, a student named §H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§! demonstrated exceptional receptiveness to other subjects.\n\nIt has been suggested that [selected_leader_in_training.GetHeShe] should attend extracurricular classes with teachers from outside [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] faculty to test [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] suitability for generalist training. Alternatively, we could mandate that all gifted students take cross-functional classes outside their usual schooling hours.

items.name: Outside Experience
Extreme Trial
items.desc:
A pedagogue at our §HGolden Academy§! on [golden_academy_planet.GetName] advocates for an extreme trial to build the resilience of one of their charges.

This student, named §H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§!, is a very capable scholar, but lags behind [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] peers in mandatory physical education. [selected_leader_in_training.GetHeSheCap] [selected_leader_in_training.GetIsAre] described as having a fragile and nervous disposition, with low tolerance of discomfort - all traits that might make [selected_leader_in_training.GetHimHer] unfit for the rigors of interstellar leadership.

The proposed trial would involve demanding physical challenges, reduced rest and comfort, and a simulated psychosocial exercise that confronts [selected_leader_in_training.GetHimHer] with moral dilemmas.

items.name: Creature Attachment
items.desc:
During breaks between lessons, §H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§! has developed a habit of separating [selected_leader_in_training.GetHimselfHerself] from the group in order to go and care for the various creatures which we have placed around the academy grounds.

The student is often seen leaving scraps of food for the animals and lately shows more interest in playing with them than interacting with [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] fellow students. One creature in particular has become a favorite and [selected_leader_in_training.GetName] seems unable to pass a day without visiting it.

Our pedagogues advocate using [selected_leader_in_training.GetName]'s ever stronger bond with this animal to teach [selected_leader_in_training.GetHimHer] a valuable lesson.

items.name: Bullying Accusations
items.desc: §H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§! has complained of being on the receiving end of bullying behavior from [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] peers, primarily taking the form of verbal mockery and occasional practical jokes.\n\nThe intense pressure presents a formative opportunity. Some pedagogues take the view that [selected_leader_in_training.GetName] lacks initiative with social problem-solving and must learn to handle such matters independently. Others fear that this promising student is having [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] development stunted by this experience.

items.name: Bad News
items.desc: The entire family of §H[selected_leader_in_training.GetName]§! have lost their lives in an unfortunate shuttle accident. The student currently remains unaware of the event.\n\nSome of our pedagogues argue that we should withhold this news from [selected_leader_in_training.GetName] for the good of [selected_leader_in_training.GetHisHer] education, and relay it when [selected_leader_in_training.GetHeShe] [selected_leader_in_training.GetIsAre] older and better equipped to handle it. Others are adamant that we risk adding deceit to the inevitable trauma, and that we must inform the student of the full facts immediately.

items.name: Feuding Pupils
items.desc: A feud has broken out between two students at the §HGolden Academy§! on [golden_academy_planet.GetName]. After §H[feuding_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[feuding_leader_2.GetName]§! showed signs of an emerging friendship, our pedagogues planted a series of rumors that led to increasingly violent arguments between the two. Their most recent altercation resulted in both requiring minor medical attention.\n\nInterestingly, both students have shown an elevated interest in mandatory self-defense classes since their quarrels began. Isolating them will not be feasible, but we can try to mediate a reconciliation to conclude the experiment.

items.name: Nascent Romance
items.desc: Two students at our §HGolden Academy§! are reported to be romantically involved, in violation of the institution's rules. §H[lover_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[lover_leader_2.GetName]§! were assigned a series of paired assignments to foster their nascent romance, the development of which is confirmed by surveillance recordings and peer testimony.\n\nBoth students' recent records consequently show poor output from independent study time and reduced involvement in extracurricular activities. With their findings now complete, our pedagogues must decide whether or not to allow their clandestine relationship to continue.

items.name: Wargames
items.desc:
Students at our §HGolden Academy§! recently took part in wargame simulations, collaborating with peers from various specialties. The primary purpose of the exercise was to challenge their ability to coordinate across disciplines when facing interstellar threats.

During the exercise, §H[wargames_leader_1.GetName]§! acted against the majority opinion of [wargames_leader_1.GetHisHer] teammates, making a unilateral decision to attack their simulated opponents. Though this ultimately proved successful, [wargames_leader_1.GetHisHer] teammates feel that these actions were contrary to the spirit of the exercise.

As we hypothesized, their disagreement has led to fractious debate among the student body. It is now time to reveal our position on the matter.

items.name: Secret Siblings
items.desc: Two of our most promising pupils are orphaned siblings who joined the academy at a very young age and have never been told of their family relationship. Now older, §H[sibling_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[sibling_leader_2.GetName]§! are beginning to suspect the truth of their background.\n\nOur pedagogues see this as a test in itself. How the two respond to the revelation, and to each other, could tell us more than years of conventional assessment. Some tutors argue for a controlled disclosure now, before the truth emerges in a way we cannot observe and measure.

items.name: Race for the Prize
items.desc: Students at our §HGolden Academy§! on [golden_academy_planet.GetName] have taken part in a contest that tested a range of their academic, physical, and problem-solving skills. Our pedagogues' goal was to observe the participants' emotional responses to the pressure of competition.\n\nThe results were tied between §H[competing_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[competing_leader_2.GetName]§! - both highly competitive and ambitious students. We must now decide whether or not to pit them against one another in a tie-breaker trial.

items.name: Cyberprank
items.desc:
Our §HGolden Academy§! on [golden_academy_planet.GetName] has experienced a brief but thorough cyberattack. Laboratory equipment, spaceflight simulators, and a dozen other systems were affected before staff intervened... or appeared to intervene.

The culprits were easily identified. §H[hacker_leader_1.GetName]§! has a record of misbehavior, and §H[hacker_leader_2.GetName]§! has the requisite skills. Several automated alerts were logged, and each was quietly set aside.

To our pedagogues the test is clear: confronted with the infraction and threatened with punishment, will the two turn on one another?

items.name: Unequal Performance
items.desc: Despite our attempts to maintain consistent educational standards, we have observed unequal performance results among the students at our §HGolden Academy§!. While most are meeting expected targets, there remains a minority of outliers: both as consistent underperformers and exceptional talents.\n\nSome of the academy's pedagogues are concerned by this disparity; they regard our existing policy of providing the same support to all students as no longer fit for purpose. Others are more concerned with encouraging those with the highest performance, who they consider to be our society's emerging luminaries.

items.name: Transfer Student
items.desc: At a young age, §H[prodigy_leader.GetName]§! was a candidate for enrollment at our §HGolden Academy§!, but [prodigy_leader.GetHeShe] [prodigy_leader.GetWasWere] ultimately not selected. Since then, [prodigy_leader.GetHeShe] [prodigy_leader.GetHasHave] shown exceptional progress in standard schooling, far exceeding the achievements of [prodigy_leader.GetHisHer] peers. We now believe [prodigy_leader.GetHeShe] [prodigy_leader.GetHasHave] demonstrated sufficient potential for future leadership.\n\nHowever, [prodigy_leader.GetHeShe] [prodigy_leader.GetIsAre] known to have a difficult personality - quick to argue with tutors, disruptive in classes, and uncooperative with peers. Despite this, some of our Golden Academy pedagogues are convinced that [prodigy_leader.GetHisHer] talents are too great to be ignored. There is an opportunity here to enroll this student and engineer [prodigy_leader.GetHisHer] failure, teaching the others a valuable lesson about the consequences of insubordination.

items.name: Public Discontent
items.desc: Some sections of the [this.GetSpeciesAdj] population have begun to openly criticize the §HGolden Academy§! program. Classified information has circulated as rumor, and now our pedagogues' experimental approaches are being condemned as 'ruthless manipulation of young minds'.\n\nOur advisors propose that we restore trust by holding an open house, allowing the media and public figures to see the impressive development of our future leaders in action - without displaying our more controversial techniques.

items.name: Reproductive Burdens
items.desc: Pedagogues at our §HGolden Academy§! are concerned about the distracting implications of reproduction on their young students. Some pupils have already expressed a desire to raise offspring in later life.\n\nReproductive curiosity not only presents a potential distraction during their education, but also a conflicting loyalty during their future careers. Some among us have proposed a credit-based system that enforces chastity on poorer performers, while others advocate for outright sterilization of all academy students.

items.name: Golden Generation Graduates
items.desc:
After more than a decade of enrollment, the first generation of §HGolden Academy§! students have completed their specialized leadership training. A lavish graduation ceremony was held on [golden_academy_planet.GetName], attended by high-ranking leaders from throughout the [this.GetName].

[this.GetRulerTitle] [this.GetRulerName] gave a speech highlighting the historic importance that this 'Golden Generation' is set to play in our interstellar future.

The very best of these graduates are now ready for recruitment into key leadership positions, while the rest are set to make valuable contributions to elite roles throughout our society. Both supporters and detractors of the Golden Academy program will be watching their careers with the closest of scrutiny.

items.name: Future of the Golden Academy
items.desc:
Now that the first generation of the §HGolden Academy§!'s students have graduated, there is growing pressure to reassess the future of this costly and often controversial institution. Our advisors have drawn up a series of proposals.

They suggest retaining it as a leadership school but pivoting to less costly and more conventional teaching methods. Children would no longer be separated from their families and pedagogues would refrain from psychological manipulation techniques, appeasing detractors of the current program.

Alternatively, the Golden Academy could be converted to a museum serving the cultural enrichment of [this.GetAdj] society, or simply closed down once and for all.

items.name: Medical Emergency
items.desc: Due to a rare and undiagnosed genetic condition, Golden Academy alumnus §H[saved_leader.GetName]§! suffered a sudden and critical organ failure, nearly resulting in [saved_leader.GetHisHer] death.\n\nLuckily, [saved_leader.GetHisHer] sibling and fellow academy graduate, §H[sibling_leader.GetName]§!, does not exhibit this degenerative condition. [sibling_leader.GetName] offered to donate a healthy [this.GetSpeciesOrganName], and the transplant operation was completed successfully. Fortunately, both [saved_leader.GetName] and [sibling_leader.GetName] are making a rapid recovery.

items.name: Family Secret
items.desc: Following the recent death of Golden Academy alumnus §H[dead_leader.GetName]§!, [dead_leader.GetHisHer] former schoolmate §H[alive_leader.GetName]§! has finally discovered the truth about their sibling relationship, which we attempted to keep secret from them since their infancy.\n\nUnwilling to accept our rationale for withholding this information, [alive_leader.GetName] has become increasingly withdrawn since learning the news and responded by publicly attacking the methods of the Golden Academy program. [alive_leader.GetHisHerCap] effectiveness as a servant of the [this.GetName] has suffered as a consequence.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_golden_generation

items.name: Aggrieved Alumnus
items.desc: §H[from.GetTitle] [from.GetName]§! has prepared a document maligning a fellow Golden Academy alumnus, §H[fromfrom.GetTitle] [fromfrom.GetName]§!. The document excoriates [fromfrom.GetName]'s professional behavior, questioning [fromfrom.GetHisHer] personal integrity and suitability for leadership.\n\nAccording to [from.GetHisHer] colleagues, [from.GetName] is planning to disseminate the document publicly. Its contents are purely subjective, with no genuine claims of misconduct, yet it still threatens to cause reputational damage.

items.name: In Memory of [dead_leader.GetName]
items.desc: The recent death of §H[dead_leader.GetName]§! dealt an emotional blow to many throughout the [this.GetName] - and not least to [dead_leader.GetHisHer] close friend and fellow Golden Academy graduate, §H[surviving_leader.GetName]§!.\n\nTo honor [surviving_leader.GetHisHer] departed friend, [surviving_leader.GetName] has established a scholarship program in memory of [dead_leader.GetName], providing financial assistance to underprivileged students with strong leadership potential.

items.name: The Grief of [surviving_leader.GetName]
items.desc: Since the recent death of §H[dead_leader.GetTitle] [dead_leader.GetName]§!, colleagues have noticed a marked change in §H[surviving_leader.GetTitle] [surviving_leader.GetName]§!. The pair are known to have had a short-lived romance during their schooldays at the prestigious Golden Academy.\n\n[surviving_leader.GetName] has been uncharacteristically listless, prone to distraction and sudden outbursts of emotion. Usually proud of [surviving_leader.GetHisHer] alma mater, [surviving_leader.GetHeShe] [surviving_leader.GetIsAre] now complaining bitterly of the 'cruel' policy that kept [surviving_leader.GetHimHer] segregated from [dead_leader.GetName].
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_golden_generation

items.name: Golden Wedding
items.desc: Two alumni of our prestigious Golden Academy, §H[from.GetName]§! and §H[fromfrom.GetName]§!, were recently married in a lavish ceremony on [this.Capital.GetName]. The event was attended by a number of their former schoolmates and fellow high-profile leaders.\n\nThe couple attracted significant public attention in the run-up to their nuptials, leading to a rush of media coverage. The story of their forbidden school romance, and their unwavering devotion as they rose to prominence, has captured the imagination of [this.GetAdj] society.

items.name: Impromptu Espionage
items.desc:
Unexpectedly, §H[from.GetName]§! and §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! have provided our intelligence services with classified information regarding the §H[hostile_empire.GetName]§!.

[from.GetName] noticed a brief opportunity to exploit a weakness in [hostile_empire.GetAdj] security. [from.GetHeSheCap] enlisted the help of [fromfrom.GetName], an old Golden Academy schoolmate, who managed to hack into the systems of a nearby [hostile_empire.GetAdj] drone ship without detection.

In response to a disgruntled intelligence official, [from.GetName] insisted that the escapade was a one-time opportunity with too narrow a window of time to seek authorization.

items.name: Victorious Commander
items.desc: Reports of §H[victorious_commander.GetName]'s§! audacious and decisive leadership in battle are circulating widely across [This.Capital.GetName], capturing the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] imagination and driving a surge in positive public sentiment toward the §HGolden Academy§! training program.\n\nMedia outlets are responding with extensive coverage on the life of [victorious_commander.GetName] and the key role played by the Golden Academy in [victorious_commander.GetHisHer] development. Some of our advisors have suggested we should capitalize on this goodwill by commemorating this success with a public ceremony.

items.name: Inspiring Scientific Expedition
items.desc: Reports of §H[inspiring_scientist.GetName]'s§! recent scientific expedition in [expedition_system.GetName] have captured the public imagination. [inspiring_scientist.GetHisHerCap] efforts have highlighted the value of the §HGolden Academy§! program and inspired a new generation of researchers.\n\nIn media broadcasts, [inspiring_scientist.GetName] shows a unique ability to engage and excite the public on matters relating to science and engineering. [inspiring_scientist.GetHisHerCap] growing fame is a boon to the [This.GetName].

items.name: Heroic Leadership
items.desc:
[invaded_colony.GetName] has survived the enemy invasion thanks in no small part to §H[heroic_governor.GetName]'s§! heroic leadership.

Despite the dangers faced, [heroic_governor.GetFirstName] was able to lift morale and prevent panic among the general population with a series of reassuring public appearances.

The experience has left the inhabitants of [invaded_colony.GetName] uniquely motivated and united in a sense of shared purpose as they face the aftermath of this ordeal.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_golden_generation

items.name: Dismissal Backlash
items.desc: The recent dismissal of §H[dismissed_leader.GetName]§! has provoked public backlash and bitter recrimination within our government. Many are outraged that a member of the Golden Generation could be treated with such disrespect.\n\nMedia commentary is heavy with criticism of the decision and a number of protests have already taken place on [root.capital_scope.GetName].

items.name: Inspirational Leader
items.desc: Following [lv10_leader.GetHisHer] recent promotion, §H[lv10_leader.GetTitle] [lv10_leader.GetName]§! has been sharing insights from [lv10_leader.GetHisHer] impressive career with the [this.GetName]'s next generation of leaders.\n\n[lv10_leader.GetName] reflected on key lessons imparted from [lv10_leader.GetHisHer] early days in the §HGolden Academy§! and how they have served [lv10_leader.GetHimHer] in overcoming the challenges of the ensuing years. The audience left invigorated and better equipped for taking the next steps in their own leadership careers.

items.name: Crisis of Leadership
items.desc: After our recent military defeat, public discontent over the skills of our Golden Generation leaders has risen markedly.\n\nLarge segments of the [Root.GetAdj] population complain that the leaders we were relying on to safeguard our future in the interstellar age are proving inadequate to the task. Prominent commentators are leading a backlash against the original promises of the §HGolden Academy§! and broader resentment toward the [Root.GetAdj] government is growing.

items.name: Victory Celebrations
items.desc:
Following our recent military victory, spontaneous citizen-led celebrations have taken place across [Root.Capital.GetName].

Optimism and positive sentiment is running high. Our people feel that the trust placed in our leadership has been repaid, and that the §HGolden Academy§! has delivered on its promise to train leaders fit for the challenges of the interstellar age.

Some advisors suggest capitalizing on this goodwill with an official commemoration, led by members of the Golden Generation.

items.name: Golden Dividends
items.desc: Under the expert stewardship of §H[happiness_leader.GetName]§!, the population of [happy_colony.GetName] is experiencing unprecedented levels of life satisfaction.\n\nThe positivity is generating high praise for the §HGolden Academy§! program and the pedagogues who trained [happiness_leader.GetName]. The [This.GetAdj] population's support and goodwill toward its leadership has never been higher.

items.name: Ego Clash
items.desc: The work of our council is being severely undermined by the petty rivalry of two members of the Golden Generation, §H[ego_clasher_1.GetName]§! and §H[ego_clasher_2.GetName]§!, who repeatedly engage in distracting squabbles or the deliberate obstruction of each other's work.\n\nAccording to the archival data of the §HGolden Academy§!, their ceaseless vying for superiority dates back to their formative days during adolescence. This unresolved tension is now negatively impacting the progress of the [This.GetName].

items.name: Councilor Harmony
items.desc: The presence of multiple members of the Golden Generation on our Council is driving greater government innovation and efficiency.\n\n§H[harmonious_councilor_1.GetName]§! and §H[harmonious_councilor_2.GetName]'s§! strengths complement each other perfectly. Administrative errors have reduced significantly and fewer disputes have been logged than ever before. Staff at all levels of government display increased motivation while working under their shared guidance.

items.name: Wasted Talents
items.desc:
A frustrated member of the Golden Generation has taken to publicly airing [wasted_talent.GetHisHer] grievances at having been passed over for a number of senior leadership roles.

Despite graduating from the §HGolden Academy§! many years ago, §H[wasted_talent.GetName]§! has never been granted higher office of any kind. [wasted_talent.GetHeSheCap] [wasted_talent.GetHasHave] grown increasingly bitter, and increasingly vocal, about [wasted_talent.GetHisHer] feelings on the matter.

The situation is beginning to stir public resentment over the wasted resources spent on training a leader of this caliber without purpose, weakening support for the government of the [Root.GetName].

items.name: Burden of Leadership
items.desc: The added pressure that comes with being a member of the Golden Generation is proving too much for §H[exhausted_leader.GetName]§!.\n\nCarrying the weight of our society's hopes and expectations for so long has taken a heavy toll. [exhausted_leader.GetName] shows signs of severe stress and [exhausted_leader.GetHeShe] [exhausted_leader.GetIsAre] increasingly paralyzed by even the smallest of decisions.

items.name: Assassin Foiled
items.desc:
An assassination plot targeting §H[victim_leader.GetName]§! has been foiled by our security services.

The would-be perpetrator is a former peer of [victim_leader.GetName] from [victim_leader.GetHisHer] time at the §HGolden Academy§!. In a rambling confession the plotter spoke of their expulsion after exam failures and the resentment which they later developed toward the institution.

Our advisors are divided on whether we should make these events public or not.

items.name: Costly Mistakes
items.desc: §H[incompetent_leader.GetName]§! has been found to have made a series of costly mistakes in [incompetent_leader.GetHisHer] work in recent years. The errors were not initially detected due to deliberate obfuscation.\n\nThis attempted cover-up has now been discovered by some sections of the media and could cause serious reputational damage to the Golden Generation if not handled appropriately.

items.name: Privileges Requested
items.desc: Members of the Golden Generation are making the case for special rights and privileges on the basis that they bear the greatest responsibility for the future of the §H[this.GetName]§!.\n\nThey argue that such benefits will boost their performance and ultimately benefit all [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

items.name: Chief Pedagogue Honored
items.desc: The former chief pedagogue of the §HGolden Academy§!, often credited with pioneering its unique and unorthodox methods, has died of natural causes.\n\nTheir passing was marked with a ceremony on [selected_planet.GetName] attended by Golden Generation leaders and surviving staff. §H[selected_leader.GetName]§! delivered an extended eulogy and called for all [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to acknowledge our society's debt to this controversial, yet trailblazing educator.

items.name: Neural Corrections
items.desc: Our researchers have developed an experimental medical procedure for reshaping neural pathways, effectively removing problematic personality traits from a patient. As our first generation of Golden Academy students underwent cognitive treatments to enhance their neuroplasticity, they are considered particularly promising candidates for this new treatment.\n\n§H[corrected_leader.GetTitle] [corrected_leader.GetName]§! has been identified as a potential subject for correction, given the character flaws that have long prevented [corrected_leader.GetHimHer] from achieving [corrected_leader.GetHisHer] very best as a leader.

items.name: [this.GetSpeciesAdj] Cloning
Aging Leaders
items.desc: Our Golden Generation leaders are showing signs of aging in their public appearances, prompting growing concern among the [this.GetSpeciesAdj] population about whether the §H[this.GetName]§! will endure once they are no longer here to guide us.\n\nAs a result, §H[selected_leader.GetName]§! has volunteered to undergo an experimental anti-aging program in the hope of extending [selected_leader.GetHisHer] career in public service. The proposed blend of metabolic reversal treatments, cellular renewal, and senolytic drugs should make a meaningful impact on [selected_leader.GetHisHer] lifespan.

items.name: Ideological Opportunity
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_golden_generation
is_fanatic = yes

items.name: Golden Legacy
items.desc:
As time passes, memories of our original §HGolden Generation§! of leaders are fading from the public consciousness.

We must decide how - or whether - to educate future generations of [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] about this formative chapter in our society's history.

How should they be remembered?

items.name: Golden Academy Lost
items.desc:
§H[from.GetName]§! has been lost to us, leaving the Golden Academy training program in disarray.

Our attempt at evacuation was unsuccessful, and most of the academy's staff and students were left stranded on the planet. Their current status is unknown.

The tremendous potential represented by the Golden Academy has been lost, along with any hopes for the future 'Golden Generation' of leaders it may have produced.

[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are coming together to support each other in this difficult time.
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_golden_generation
has_country_flag = building_golden_academy_lost

items.name: Golden Academy Destroyed
items.desc: The Golden Academy on §H[this.GetName]§! has been destroyed. Many of its staff and students perished in the attack.\n\nOur flagship leader training program lies in ruins and all our efforts have gone to waste. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are coming together to support each other in this difficult time.

items.name: Life in the Stars
items.desc:
The void is full of life. We have discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], but what else is out there?

Our close relationship with the wildlife on [capital_scope.GetName] may not be appropriate on the galactic scale. The void of space represents an entirely new ecosystem, and we find ourselves at a crossroads.

What are these creatures to us?

Whatever choice we make, the consequences will be felt for years to come.

items.name: Titanic Life
items.desc: Our colony on [Root.GetName] has learned to respect the boundaries of the native §YTitanic Life§!'s natural territory.\n\nThese massive beasts will be a continued benefit to our settlement as we expand borders and develop the land.
items.pre_triggers:
has_owner = yes
is_homeworld = no
original_owner = yes

has_ground_combat = no
is_capital = no

items.name: [from.GetSpaceFaunaName] Carrion
items.desc: After establishing contact with the [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we detected a decaying corpse of one of their kind in [fromfrom.GetName]. The remains are withered and frozen after prolonged exposure to open space.\n\nWe postulate that this carcass is what initially attracted other members of their species; perhaps they had been searching for a lost member of their [from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]. This is a rare opportunity to study the biology of a [from.GetSpaceFaunaName] that has died of natural causes in the void.

items.name: Autopsy Complete
items.desc: The autopsy on the [met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName] corpse in [contact_system.GetName] is complete. We have recovered a well-preserved biological specimen from within the remains that provides unique insight into their physiology.

items.name: Bone Ship
items.desc: We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. The ship is adorned with tendrils of mature Tiyanki, rows of Voidworm teeth, and the skull of a creature we have never seen before. It is bristling with an array of precision weapons.\n\nAfter naively accepting our invitation to parlay, the pilot was summarily executed. We have claimed their peculiar ship and added it to our military ranks. We have discovered a useful hunter's field guide among their personal effects.

items.name: Bone Ship
items.desc: We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. The ship is adorned with tendrils of mature Tiyanki, rows of Voidworm teeth, and the skull of a creature we have never seen before. It is bristling with an array of precision weapons.\n\nThey are hailing us on all frequencies.

items.name: Bone Ship
items.desc:
§HThe brooding Ceriz's voice is dry and cracking, as if they had not spoken in weeks. Their manner is direct and they maintain stoic eye contact in a manner that feels in equal part respectful and intimidating.§!

As a trophy hunter, it takes a lot to impress me. Your people have.

I am willing to join your hunting parties with the understanding that our partnership will be one of convenience and mutual instruction.

items.name: Wandering Xenologist
items.desc: We have been contacted by an independent research vessel at our starbase in [from.GetName]. Outfitted with an array of snaring devices and analytical tools, this ship is specifically adapted for the capture and examination of spaceborne life.\n\nThey are hailing us on all frequencies.

items.name: Wandering Xenologist
items.desc: §HInquisitive and analytical, Ruuk's eyes flicker constantly to a small, handheld device. Even as she greets us, she appears to be taking notes. Despite that, her manner is cordial and professional, if slightly detached.§!\n\nI see that I'm not alone in my interest in spaceborne creatures. I have studied the research the [root.GetName] has been conducting and it is positively illuminating. I would love nothing more than to aid these efforts as part of your science department. If you'll have me, of course.

items.name: Bestial Screech
items.desc: We have detected a huge number of peculiar electromagnetic waves coming from uncharted space.\n\nInitial analysis indicates a resemblance to §YVoidworm§! communication signals, albeit more irregular and with a greatly elevated amplitude. This will be investigated further.

items.name: Mutated Voidworms Destroyed
items.desc: Unwilling to wait for their inevitable attack, we launched a successful military campaign against the mutated Voidworms in their home system. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName], and the safety of our planet has been secured.\n\nThe largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

items.name: Mutated Voidworms Eliminated
items.desc: The mutated voidworms have been eliminated. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName], and the safety of our planet has been secured.\n\nThe largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

items.name: Mutated Voidworms Found
items.desc:
After eliminating a clutch of Voidworms near their nests, we discovered that these creatures had undergone a unique mutation.

It seems that they were able to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner and were in a heightened state of aggression, which would explain their unnatural strength and durability.

Fortunately, we preserved one of their nests as a trophy. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

items.name: Voidworms Exterminated
items.desc: We have learned that the mutated Voidworms threatening our colony have been eliminated.\n\nAn unexpected, but welcome conclusion. We can take solace in the fact that these creatures shall no longer antagonize our systems.

items.name: Voidworm Attack
items.desc:
The frenzied Voidworms are attacking [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]!

Their aggression has risen to a fever pitch, and the current trajectory of their main swarm is heading directly for [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName].

We do not believe they intend on leaving any survivors.

items.name: The Heaviest Price to Pay
items.desc:
Despite our best efforts, the mutated Voidworms have completely overwhelmed [this.GetName]. The frenzied creatures' bombardment was so violent that it cracked the planet's core, causing it to fragment and break apart. There were no survivors.

They have since returned to their nests and are no longer agitated by our presence. With any luck, they will remain there.

The loss of our primary hive is a blow to [event_target:victim_country.GetName], but we live on.

items.name: Mutated Voidworms Eliminated
items.desc:
The mutated Voidworms discovered in [From.GetName] have been eliminated. The destruction of [avenged_homeworld.GetName] has been avenged.

The largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

In this way, the legacy of our lost world will live on.

items.name: Voidworms Pacified
items.desc:
After sending significant amounts of mineral sustenance directly to their nests, we were able to develop a relationship with the mutated Voidworms in [frenzied_home_system.GetName]. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]. The safety of our planet has been secured.

Our most experienced animal handlers have been at work managing the beasts, and we are at a point where they seem to be willing to mutually cooperate.

We have taken in one of their largest nests. With this, we can cultivate more of these mutated Voidworms that would otherwise have been left to the wild.

items.name: Ancient Capsule
items.desc: We have made a breakthrough regarding the Ancient Capsule found orbiting [this.GetHomeWorldName]. Thanks to the tireless efforts of our [this.GetScientistPlural], we are now in a position to decrypt the final layer of digital security and decipher the chart that has intrigued us for so long.

items.name: Ancient Capsule Analyzed
items.desc:
The chart is only partially complete!

The data within the orbital capsule is fragmented, each conspicuous gap like the missing piece of a puzzle. Nevertheless, it reveals the coordinates of a previously-unknown star system, but does not provide any detail as to what awaits us there.

The chart also highlights a series of established breach points to facilitate hyperlane travel to the destination.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: The Celestial Chart
items.desc: The discovery of the chart inside of the capsule has captured the attention of our society. Now that it has been revealed to be a piece among many, we wonder where it may lead and what we might find there. We are determined to complete this "§YCelestial Chart§!".\n\nOur ships are standing by, eager to set forth on our civilization's next great adventure.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: An Unexpected Encounter
items.desc: We have encountered a heavily-armed fleet flying under an unknown flag. Their ships are in organized formation but not uniform in their design. Many are outfitted with kinetic launchers attached to reels of thick cable tipped with carbon steel hooks and harpoons. Additionally, there is a group of armored haulers sheltered in the center of the fleet. We can only surmise that these ships are controlled by a group of pirates or mercenaries.\n\nWe are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

items.name: Captain Hoo of the Black Needle
items.desc:
§HDistinguished and haughty, this outlaw captain feigns disinterest. He looks down his beak when speaking and refuses to meet our gaze, as if we are unworthy of his full attention. He gesticulates with his feathers in an inadvertently comical manner.§!

You have crossed the path of the §YBlack Needle§!, a blunder on your part!

We caught wind of a rumor that your burgeoning little society would be exploring this system. You have stumbled upon a chart that clearly belongs to us. Hand it over, lest things become violent.

items.name: Captain Hoo of the Black Needle
items.desc:
You have made a mockery of myself and the §YBlack Needle§!. This will not stand, not at all!

Your unwillingness to cooperate will not soon be forgotten. The Black Needle will come at you with all that we have. Your fledgling civilization will not survive our wrath.

We will not stop until that chart is ours! And now I shall bid you good day!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: Excavation Successful
items.desc: A capsule was successfully extracted from the drifting planetary debris alongside a quantity of minerals. Upon opening it, we discovered a new piece of the §YCelestial Chart§! and a selection of unique cultural artifacts. Additionally, a note was found inside, written in multiple languages to allow for easier translation.\n\n"This is all that remains of Soropegma, the Ytterite homeworld. The Ytterite were a Pre-FTL species rendered extinct as a result of a tragic accident. Unaware of the impending consequences, we accidentally triggered the destructive power of a stolen Colossus. Please preserve and respect their memory."
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: Chart Deciphered
items.desc: After breaking multiple layers of encryption, the new data was added seamlessly to the §YCelestial Chart§!. Once the pieces were combined, yet another new system was revealed. The next step of our journey lies before us. We should approach this uncharted area of space with caution.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: A Grand Archive
items.desc: Following the acquisition of the §Y[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]§!, our scientists believe that it deserves to be placed on public display in the context of a §YGrand Archive§!. This structure would house our budding collection of rare artifacts which will reap significant cultural and scientific returns. An early-stage investment would kickstart the research into the techniques and technologies required to preserve and display the galaxy's diverse and delicate specimens.\n\nAdditionally, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact was discovered containing an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the archive in general.

items.name: The Ytterite Specimen
items.desc: The final trace of the lost Ytterite civilization merits its own exhibition.\n\nFortunately, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact contains an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the Archive in general.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: Exhibition Enhancement
items.desc: After careful analysis of the Ytterite blueprint, we have constructed an advanced containment unit with precise atmospheric monitoring down to the atom. This would allow curators to monitor the atmospheric conditions of the delicate Ytterite specimen on a highly detailed level and detect any warning signs of potential decay. It will be just as it was, forever.\n\nWe can apply these techniques to further improve the storage conditions of every item in our collection.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: Grand Archive Opening
items.desc: The opening of the §YGrand Archive§! in [fromfrom.GetName] is a great day for the [this.GetName]. This exhibition of treasures from across the galaxy inspires exploration and calls us to learn from the past.

items.name: Pirate Hideout Discovered
items.desc:
We have found a covert underground base on [From.GetName] bearing the insignia of the §YBlack Needle§!. We believe that this is an external base used by the piracy group, isolated from their other operations. The next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§! must be stored here, likely alongside other riches and baubles.

We could easily begin orbital bombardment of the base, but this may give the Black Needle the time they need to call for reinforcements. On the other hand, a rapid deployment of our ground forces would more swiftly seize the base, giving little time for the enemy to respond.

A more clandestine approach would be to hack into the base's computer systems and secure the Celestial Chart piece in a daring heist.

items.name: Black Needle Counterattack
items.desc: As expected, the Black Needle has sent a fleet to protect their base on [FromFrom.GetName].\n\nWe'll need to deal with these ships in order to secure [FromFrom.System.GetName].

items.name: In Ruins and Ashes
items.desc: After battering the pirate base with orbital munitions, it has finally been reduced to rubble along with its previous inhabitants. With all threats neutralized, we can now send in a Scientist to explore the ruined base and extract the next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!.

items.name: Defenses Down
items.desc: Our ground forces have taken the §YBlack Needle§! base and are currently securing the building and its surrounding resources. With all threats neutralized, we can send in a Scientist to extract the next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!.

items.name: Caught Red-Handed
items.desc: Unfortunately, one of the guards caught on to our scheme as we were loading the capsule onto the ship. The discovery led to a short firefight, as we were forced to flee the scene with the precious cargo in tow. The capsule was successfully extracted, but Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] killed in the crossfire.

items.name: Looting the Black Needle Base
items.desc:
Navigating the ruins of the §YBlack Needle§! base, we found an underground vault and opened it to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.

The safe room contained a wide variety of valuable items as well as sentimental trinkets linked to the history of the pirate organization. We found the chart capsule among stolen artworks, personalized jewelry, and encrypted digital wallets.

We suspect that many of the goods discovered here would be difficult to sell. The artworks are recognizable, the jewelry would need to be melted down for scrap, and transactions using digital wallets are usually traceable. Some of the previous owners of these items could be long-dead, but others will still be looking for their stolen possessions.

items.name: Chart Decrypted
items.desc: We successfully overcame the layers of digital encryption and integrated new information into the §YCelestial Chart§!. This revealed yet another destination to explore and now the chart is almost complete. We believe that there is only one piece of the puzzle remaining, and are cautiously optimistic that the end of our quest is in sight.\n\nWhile the navigational data was being decoded, the unblemished exterior of the capsule itself was deemed worthy of analysis. The strength and durability of the container was surprising; the ability to replicate this material could provide many potential opportunities for future research.

items.name: Hidden Settlement
items.desc:
We have found a small settlement on [FROM.GetName] with a population of less than a thousand sentient molluscoids. Preliminary biological analysis of the species shows a capacity for subspace ephapse communication, indicating the existence of a hive mind. Other than this isolated encampment, the planet is uninhabited by any other sentient life.

Perhaps this species has more information on this "§YCaptain Ness§!" we have heard about.

Why the §YCelestial Chart§! has led us here is not yet clear and requires further investigation.

items.name: Smeegibb
items.desc:
§HA node of the hive mind found in the hidden system of [FROM.GetName], Smeegibb fidgets with discomfort. They have a tendency to lower their gaze when spoken to, as if they are accustomed to subservience.§!

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to other groupmind.

Our name is Smeegibb. We are curious how you find us. This system is hidden from galactic view for thousands of years.

Only §YThe Captain§! knows this place. You seek what?
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters

items.name: Safehouse Discovered
items.desc: The being we encountered on [from.GetName], Smeegibb, has revealed the coordinates of an abandoned safehouse formerly occupied by themselves and §YCaptain Ness§!. Investigating this location may lead us to the next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!, or at least a clue to guide us in the right direction.

items.name: Captain's Log
