items.name: Psiarch Uk-Hogolath Scarat
items.desc:
§HAs soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.§!

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission. Your rebuilding of the Shroud Seal has extinguished any hopes we had for your redemption. Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.

Be prepared to meet our fleets.

items.name: Sealing §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!
items.desc:
With its colossal psionic attenuators flared into action, our §HShroud Seal§! is now in the process of driving out the §HPsionic Aura§! from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system.

Interstellar scans have confirmed that the rest of our enemy's territory is directly connected to [exiled_center_system.GetName] via hyperlane. This single Shroud Seal is therefore capable of dissipating Psionic Auras throughout the entire territory of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!.

Our victory hinges on the protection of the Seal.

items.name: The Assembly of Mindways
items.desc:
The colony of the psionic menace on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! has been conquered.

We have learned that the §HPsionic Aura§! present in this system was being amplified by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices are led by a group of elite telepaths, the §HAssembly of Mindways§!. This psionic cult promotes devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud, known only as §HThe Dreamer§!.

Their sacred texts make repeated mention of an artifact related to this being - apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Acquiring this object will aid us in preventing further spread of their influence.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.name: Ruins on [current_planet.GetName]
items.desc:
We have completed our colonization of §H[current_planet.GetName]§!, a former world of the [exiled_country.GetName].

From the remains of their records, we have learned that the Psionic Aura previously present in this system was caused by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices were led by a psionic cult that promoted devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud known as §HThe Dreamer§!.

Fragments of their sacred texts refer to an artifact related to this being, apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Securing this object would require a more measured conquest of [other_planet.GetName], leaving some of its population intact.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.name: Sanctum of the Dreamer
Psionic Threat Eliminated
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.name: The Power Within
items.desc:
Our researchers conducted a thorough analysis of the 'cocoon' on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!.

External scans of this imposing structure revealed it to be a highly secure receptacle designed to contain a powerful psionic entity. Despite the container's insulative layers of heavy alloys, high levels of psi-radiation are permeating through the enclosure nonetheless.

A group of psionic attenuators were installed around the cocoon; when activated, everyone in the vicinity was struck with searing levels of neural distress.

The surface of the cocoon then twisted, its ovoid form becoming a shifting helix. The aperture has opened, and we are receiving direct communication from within...
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.desc: §HYou hear, but do not listen. Why?§!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.name: The Dreamer
items.desc:
The cocoon we discovered on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§! harbors a powerful interdimensional entity. It is likely that this being was somehow responsible for the Psionic Aura that threatened the sanctity of our minds.

Our psionic attenuators are mitigating the danger it poses for now, but it is unclear how long our devices can restrain its influence. It is possible that, under controlled circumstances, we can harness its terrible power for our own purposes.

Nevertheless, many in our society are calling for its immediate destruction. Its very existence stands against our long-held values.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.name: The Dreamer
items.desc:
Thoughts penetrate our minds.

We hear a melody, bright and abrasive.

We know this pain, great and familiar.

§HYou listened. The dream is yours... Sing, sing...§!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.name: The First Enclave
items.desc:
We have amassed great knowledge of the §HShroud§!, and developed advanced technologies to suppress its pernicious effects. While debating how to apply this mastery galaxy-wide, our fleet commanders have put forward an interesting proposal.

They suggest setting up one of our fleets as an independent §H'Mindwarden Enclave'§!, which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_mindwardens

items.name: Mindwarden Enclave Foundation
items.desc: The §H[This.GetName]§! has been identified as a suitable candidate to form the basis of our first independent §HMindwarden Enclave§!. If authorized, the fleet would establish a new facility in §H[This.Solar_System.GetName]§! and begin providing anti-psionic services forthwith.

items.name: The Mindwardens
items.desc:
Contending with the §HShroud§! and the irresponsible use of psionics has strengthened our people and clarified our goals into sharper focus. The foundation of the first §HMindwarden Enclave§! is the advent of a new age of healing and resistance.

Throughout the galaxy, no mind need be invaded by psionic aggressors, and no world tormented by forces from the Shroud.

It is now the age of the Mindwardens.
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_mindwardens
has_country_flag = should_fire_shroud.6830

items.name: The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, our recent contracts have been fruitful. We have expanded our civilian operations, and several corporations have hired us for a variety of security and peacekeeping services. While on contract, our operatives chanced upon some valuable scientific research. You will find it attached along with your regular dividends.

items.name: The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, the company is doing well, and our earnings are steadily increasing. Here are your dividends, along with an extra delivery of resources we recovered from a civilian client who defaulted on their payment.

items.name: The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, we are pleased to announce record profits during this fiscal interval! As such, we have included a generous bonus to your regular dividends.

items.name: The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, our latest peacekeeping operation had us dismantle several pirate operations and we recovered an extraordinary amount of resources and technological data. Most of these have been set apart for you, in addition to your well-earned dividends.

items.name: Mission to [shrouded_planet.GetName]
items.desc:
Exploratory satellites orbiting §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! have identified a promising target for our first crewed mission to the surface of this 'Shrouded World.' The landing zone emanates a strange radiation that ripples across the planet, carried forth on ultraviolet winds.

There are many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who protest against this mission in fear of unleashing the same curse upon our homeworld. Their concerns are not without justification, but the overriding need to understand this distant phenomenon must take precedence.

If we are fated to one day suffer this same calamity, at least we will die knowing why.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: The End is Nigh
items.desc:
The terrain on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! is as treacherous as predicted. Swirling vortices of gloaming particles carve through the air, slowing the initial progress of §H[Leader.GetName]§! and [Leader.GetHisHer] crew.

Alarmingly, our research team has begun to report sensory inconsistencies; they describe distant howls carrying on the winds and shadowed figures stalking in the mists. Is it truly a mistake to be here?

The first public broadcasts of the landing have triggered widespread panic on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Many are fearful that we may be courting the mysterious destructive powers that once visited [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Organized protests proclaiming that 'The End is Nigh' are sweeping across our homeworld, shutting down much of our infrastructure.

Telemetric scans have revealed a cavity emanating particularly high radiation levels deep within a nearby mountain range. We are determined to push farther, whatever the cost.

items.name: Alien Structure
items.desc:
We are not the first.

The mountainous cavity on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been breached, revealing an abandoned alien structure lost to the cataclysm. We find it best to keep this information classified in order to prevent further panic.

Preliminary analysis confirms that materials used in the facility's construction do not match the molecular composition of available minerals on the planet, suggesting that a spacefaring civilization built this installation using exotic materials. The exact purpose of this place remains unclear, but its functionality appears to have been mostly automated.

Meanwhile, the team's psychological symptoms are worsening. Some report voices whispering through encrypted frequencies, while others describe distorted perceptions of their surrounding physical environment. Occasional fits of laughter are becoming uncomfortably commonplace.

We have gone too far to turn back now.

items.name: The Watchers
items.desc:
They are all dead.

At the seat of each station in the heart of this facility slumps the desiccated corpses of an unknown alien race, their many pale eyes staring toward the ceiling. Despite their frightening appearance, §H[Leader.GetName]§! is reasonably certain these figures are not a product of hallucinations. Images of these life forms are currently classified as strictly confidential.

No weapons of any form can be found, suggesting that their presence on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! lacked hostile intent. This facility was likely an observation post, with sophisticated monitoring equipment trained directly on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Radiocarbon dating places their activity here long before the cataclysm struck.

We have decoded many of their records; aside from routine communication logs, they largely concern our civilization's early history.

items.name: Powers Beyond Understanding
items.desc:
The database on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been deciphered, proving many of our discredited legends to be true. We were the subject of an experiment in the mental science known as 'Psionic Theory'.

Our species was determined to have this latent potential. Many of our ancestors would have sensed these communications in dreams or as distant voices, phenomena that might otherwise indicate mental illness or paranoia. However, their experiment was cut short; in its last days, this place was no observation post, but a survival shelter.

Their reports on our society cease after a disastrous experiment on their capital world involving the reckless manipulation of the barrier between realities known as §H'the Shroud'§!. Their scientists referred to this incident as 'The Reckoning', and we suspect this was the true source of the cataclysm.

Whatever this incident was, its influence soon extended to §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!. Their last moments are recorded in a single log entry:

§LThe End has come.§!

items.name: Fragment of Reckoning
items.desc:
We have found definitive evidence of the cataclysm's source. It was not difficult to find; §H[Leader.GetName]§! claims it called out to [Leader.GetHimHer].

Deep within the facility, defying conventional analysis, a pulsing intangible mass has been identified. Existing neither as matter nor energy, §H[Leader.GetName]§! has described it as the lingering resentment of consumed wills, referring to it as a §H'Fragment of Reckoning'§!.

In a misguided effort to contain and channel the ethereal energies of the §HShroud§!, this object was intended to be used as defense against the Reckoning. However, it was only partially successful. In the last moments of this world, the malevolent entity was forcibly banished from this dimension, taking the unwilling minds of the scientists with it. This fragment is now all that remains.

This object amplifies the visions and hallucinations of our researchers, granting them a second sight beyond this limited reality. It is a dangerous but promising proposition.

items.name: A Realm of Madness
items.desc:
Research into the recently discovered field of Psionics has confirmed the existence of hitherto unseen dimensions of reality, to which our minds are the gateway. Beyond this veil lies a realm of chaos we struggle to understand.

From within the depths, a §RVoice§! beckons. Its promise is not of salvation, but of a new beginning. To wield its unknowable power would be to abandon all we were, and to forge a fate inscribed in the fabric of madness itself.

§R"IT IS TIME."§!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: Psionic Ascension
items.desc:
We have been called to higher levels of existence. Those among us who clung to fruitless resistance are being purged to preserve the sanctity of our ascension. Our fate is sealed; the way behind us has crumbled into the shadow of the Shrouded World.

The §RVoice§! speaks to us now with compelling clarity.

§R"THE PATH IS SET."§!

It longs for willing sacrifice.
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_endbringers
is_psionic = yes

items.name: We See Clearly
items.desc:
§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§! has shown us the way. Our extraneous senses muffle the call of the §RVoice§!. By removing one, we can elevate our psychic abilities even further.

Relinquishing our eyes is the most effective in this regard. Our vision in the physical realm obscures our view into the §HShroud§!. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have already followed §H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!'s inspiring example, removing their eyes without hesitation.

Those who elect to do so report a surge of contentment as the §RVoice§! fills their mind with its approval.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: A Leap of Faith
items.desc:
Frustrated by the limitations of our flesh, §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! has sought to accelerate [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] psionic transformation by imbibing a lethal toxin in dramatic public display.

As [forsaken_leader.GetHeShe] expired, [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] body was consumed by a vivid purple hue and disintegrated into a fine dust of pure psionic energy. Such miracles become possible through the will of the §RVoice§!.

We have taken this as a clear sign; where §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! led, others must follow.

items.name: Lobotomy Reports
items.desc: Some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are struggling to live in harmony with the presence of the §RVoice§!.\n\nDesperate for peace, the weakest among us have resorted to crude and unregulated lobotomy procedures. Such practices threaten to become widespread if no action is taken.

items.name: Psionic Self-Experimentation
items.desc:
We continue to embrace the §RVoice§!. It speaks plain truths to us that cannot be denied.

Many [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are seeking further ways to amplify the §RVoice§! and benefit from its wisdom more directly.

The use of black-market drugs has increased dramatically. Unregulated medical facilities are offering experimental services to help individuals maximize their psionic sensitivity.

Where will this lead us?

items.name: Apocalyptic Nightmares
items.desc:
As our psionic abilities have grown, the [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population has become plagued by horrifying nightmares foreshadowing the end of the universe.

Our dreams have become apocalyptic prophecies, intensifying the existential dread felt among our people. Sleep has given way to unquiet stupor, with many unable to carry on their normal daily routines.

In these dreams, the §RVoice§! speaks to us.

§R"EMBRACE ENTROPY."§!

items.name: Mark of the End
items.desc:
There is a growing trend of self-mutilation among the populace.

Extremely devout followers of the §RVoice§! have been branding their flesh with the symbol of 'The End'. They proclaim that these designs bestow a terrible blessing upon those who bear them.

Whether true or not, the number of practitioners engaged in such rituals is increasing rapidly. Is this truly the will of the §HShroud§!?

items.name: The Trial of Silence
items.desc:
We descend into the Shroud, our unified will helping to silence the chaotic noise that would distract us from our goal, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

But purpose alone cannot shield us. Voices whisper empty platitudes, indulging us with paltry distractions, each more meaningless than the last, but all equally tempting.

As we begin to fracture, the entity returns. A single command reverberates through the void:

§R"SILENCE."§!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: The Trial of Silence
items.desc:
This command cleaves through the chaos, scouring the discordant noise, purging the obtrusive disorder that sought to consume us. Our psyche holds as we endure the fragmentation.

The §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! recedes further into the Shroud. The clarity that follows is almost as deafening. It settles into gaps in our minds, leaving us with newfound resolve.

And gifts. Such wonderful gifts.

items.name: The Trial of Purity
items.desc:
As we delve into the Shroud, we observe a corruption of sentient chaos.

Festering, idle minds generate layers of psionic turbulence, polluting the Shroud with fetid rot. Within this odious mess, we begin to feel the overwhelming presence of our quarry, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

The malice of its intentions saturates our psyche as it bears down upon the chaos. We brace for the impending absolution as a command resonates throughout the void:

§R"ORDER. UNITY."§!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: The Trial of Purity
items.desc:
The command courses through the malignant chaos.

Innumerable voices cry out in pain as the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! washes away the sentient deformations plaguing the Shroud. A realm of absolved imperfections remains in its wake.

As the entity submerges itself deeper within the Shroud, we are left to observe and study the aftermath of its absolute purification.

items.name: The Trial of Flames
items.desc:
Entering the Shroud, we know only pain. The usual swirling psionic mists are an inferno, igniting the very essence of our minds.

Through the torment, we perceive cities crumbling into molten ruin, planets devoured by fire, entire populations writhing in agony as spectral flames reduce their corporeal forms to smouldering ash.

At the centre of the pyre, we detect the presence of the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. As its power threatens to consume reality, the entity decrees:

§R"LIBERATION."§!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: The Trial of Flames
items.desc: The psionic flames engulf our minds, burning away complacency. Leaving only a purified resolve.\n\nNow we can see the glorious purpose of the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! and the magnificent simplicity it offers.

items.name: Covenant Formed
items.desc:
A declaration rings out:

§R"YOU KNOW MY NAME."§!

The culmination of our voyage to the stars, the answer to centuries of questions, is here. The §REnd of the Cycle§! compels us. Our Covenant is formed.

§R"THE END BEGINS."§!

Pain. Writhing. Certainty. As the words fade, our fate is sealed.

We see it now. A galaxy rendered silent, saturated in the inevitability of the §RAura of the End§!.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: The Hourglass Tips
items.desc:
The power of the §REnd of the Cycle§! comes at a cost, and we are running out of time.

The galaxy remains unsaturated by our patron's cleansing Aura. Our efforts thus far amount to insignificance.

To see this monumental work completed, a surge of energy flows newly into us from beyond the veil. It is a promised blessing!
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: The End is Nigh
items.desc: The power of our patron is immense, but we are nearly out of time. Such flagrant incompetence will not be tolerated by the benevolent oblivion of the §REnd of the Cycle§!.\n\nA slim hope remains: We must engulf the galaxy in the Aura of the End, no matter the cost. In desperation, our telepaths now draw every ounce of energy they can from within the §HShroud§!.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: Galactic Focus Repealed
items.desc: The resolution designating the emitter of the destructive §HPsionic Aura§! as a focus for defense efforts has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the §H[former_malevolent_aura.GetName]§! are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

items.name: Galactic Focus Repealed
items.desc: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us as a target for their 'defense' efforts, hence all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

items.name: Harbingers of the End
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: The End Has Come
The Price of Weakness
items.desc:
We have failed. As a consequence of our weakness, the §REnd of the Cycle§! has not come to glorious fruition. The price we must now pay for this incompetence is upon us.

It took everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there is only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the §HShroud§!.

So it is now that our patron has manifested a massive Shroud entity in space above [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our psionics, it now roams the galaxy seeking to finish the task we could not complete.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: Surviving the Apocalypse
items.desc:
It is done. The §RReckoning§! has been destroyed.

The §REnd of the Cycle§! has retreated back into the depths of the §HShroud§!. The threat it posed to our physical reality has been forestalled for now.

As the shrouded corpse of its avatar spiraled out of this existence, a physical remnant of its manifestation was successfully recovered. Even in death, our telepaths can feel it emitting staggering levels of psionic energy, vastly more powerful than the fragment recovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!.

This core of concentrated inevitability can be used to rebuild from the ashes of the galaxy that survived this Reckoning.

The End has come and gone, yet somehow we remain.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_endbringers

items.name: A Planned Awakening
items.desc: The desolation of [from.GetName] is perhaps painful to witness, but not for much longer. Life in this galaxy has so far seen fit to ignore this barren world, but now we, the [root.GetName], wield the tools and knowledge to amend this.\n\nDespite all we have learned so far, we face a daunting task in the restoration of [from.GetName]. By our will, and with the climate-altering tools we have discovered, life shall soon exist where previously there was none.

items.name: Combing the Wilds
items.desc: Our semi-autonomous operatives have identified several viable sites for our unique microbiome. They will now monitor these habitats for a time, prioritizing those which offer us the greatest chance of long-term success.

items.name: Potential Site Identified
items.desc: We have secured the aid of an unwitting [target.GetSpeciesAdj] who believes they are about to engage in a dutiful act of nature conservation. Instead they are poised to deliver our 'seed bomb' microbiome to a hinterland site on §H[roots_planet.GetPlanetMoon] [roots_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nAlthough the symbionts bred within this package may be short-lived, and shall never amount to a full extension of our self, we feel their eagerness to infiltrate and observe this alien landscape as much as they are able.

items.name: Planetary Roots Embedded
items.desc: From the moment our microbiome was delivered to its new wild habitat home we began to take in its forbidden air, and to perceive the world known as §H[roots_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nOur presence here shall be tenuous, so long as these symbionts remain fundamentally disconnected from our wider self. However, they will serve us well when the time comes to resume operations in [target.GetAdj] space.

items.name: Veiled Tunnel
items.desc: Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, and the crew of our science vessel reports strange disturbances: wildly visceral dreamlike visions, a persistent sense of being watched, fitful hallucinations...\n\nDespite the frustrating lack of useful telemetry, it seems clear we have stumbled on a tunnel through uncharted reaches. A dangerous path, yet the rewards may be great; on the tunnel's far side lies a distant corner of the galaxy.

items.name: Mercenary Enclave Foundation
items.desc: We are debating whether or not to help set up the [fleet.GetName] as an independent §YMercenary Enclave§!. The proposal, first put forward by the fleet commanders, would result in us losing control of the fleet. We would also be responsible for providing them with a sizeable investment in §YEnergy Credits§! and §YAlloys§!. In return, they would give us a number of shares in the company. These would come with periodic dividends and special privileges.\n\nThey assure us that in times of need, they will always be ready to fight for us. And our money.
items.trigger: is_merc_enclave_founding_allowed = yes

items.name: Mercenary Enclave Destroyed
items.desc: Our fleet has overcome the defenses of the mercenaries in [merc_system.GetName], and their station has been blown to pieces. The rest of the [FROM.GetName] collapsed quickly after, and their remaining fleets have disbanded. While some of the surviving captains may turn to piracy, others have announced their plans to honor smaller contracts, offering logistical support or space station garrisoning. But such trifling affairs are of little consequence. The important fact is that the Mercenary Enclave is no more, and from its wreckage we have been able to salvage a sizable amount of resources.

items.name: Mercenary Enclave Destroyed
items.desc: Word has reached us that a Mercenary Enclave has been destroyed by the [mercenary_destroyer.GetName] in [merc_system.GetName]. The aggressors proved too strong for the [FROM.GetName] to face on their own, and the station housing the Board, barracks, and their shipyards was destroyed. The mercenary fleet disbanded shortly after, as every captain was left to fend for themselves, but some representatives have stated that they will honor the company's contracts in logistics and starbase garrisoning as best they can despite the dissolution of the Company.

items.name: Emergency Fleet Recall
[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]
items.desc: Welcome! [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] offers state of the art security services to our customers. We have civil contracts across multiple worlds, ranging from personal security details to training drills for enforcers.\n\nBut for our high profile clients, we aim to provide the best of the best. Fleets, armies, military advisors... A range of peacekeeping options is available. For a modest fee of course.

items.name: Commandeered Fleet Arrives.
items.desc: The Mercenary Fleet that we commandeered from our enclave is awaiting orders.

items.name: Termination Notice
items.desc:
Dearest client,

As provisioned by clause 285b.15 of our contract, we must regrettably bring our arrangement to an early close and recall the Mercenary Fleet that you rented from us. As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

items.desc:
Dearest client,

As provisioned by clause 285b.15 of our contract, we must regrettably bring our arrangement to an early close and recall the Mercenary Fleet that you rented from us. As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

items.desc:

As provisioned by clause 285b.15 of our contract, we must regrettably bring our arrangement to an early close and recall the Mercenary Fleet that you rented from us. As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

items.name: The [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, our recent contracts have been fruitful. We have expanded our civilian operations, and several corporations have hired us for a variety of security and peacekeeping services. While on contract, our operatives chanced upon some valuable scientific research. You will find it attached along with your regular dividends.

items.name: The [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, the company is doing well, and our earnings are steadily increasing. Here are your dividends, along with an extra delivery of resources we recovered from a civilian client who defaulted on their payment.

items.name: The [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, we are pleased to announce record profits during this fiscal interval! As such, we have included a generous bonus to your regular dividends.

items.name: The [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, our latest peacekeeping operation had us dismantle several pirate operations and we recovered an extraordinary amount of resources and technological data. Most of these have been set apart for you, in addition to your well-earned dividends.

items.name: The [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
items.desc: Esteemed Patron, the company is going through difficult times. We lost several civilian clients, and various of our other operations ended in costly failures. We are setting up a restructuring plan that will cut expenditures across the board, and we will be letting some of our staff go.\n\nRest assured that we worked tirelessly to bring you your dividends, and that this misfortune is only temporary.

items.name: Logistic Support Contract Ending
items.desc:
Dearest client,

The Logistic Support service we provide you is due for renewal. As per the terms of our contract: if we do not receive prompt instructions to do otherwise, you will be automatically billed for renewal of this service.

We trust that you are satisfied, and look forward to doing more business with you!

items.name: A Deal We Should Not Refuse
items.desc: We have received an urgent communique from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]. They say that the [khan_country.GetName] made them an offer they cannot refuse. Their only way out of the deal is to find employment elsewhere within two months. If no one hires them, they will enter the service of the Khan and have no choice but to wage total war against us.

items.name: Fleet Contract Ended
items.desc: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

items.name: [salvager_enclave_country.GetName]
items.desc:
Pleased to make your acquaintance! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our humble, interstellar workshop.

Say... I'd recognize those keel fixtures anywhere - some fine work. We make a habit of keeping up with what's flying in the galaxy, try to keep up with local trends. But where was I..?

Ah yes: welcome! How can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?

items.name: Reclaimed Bounty
items.desc: A train of cargo barges has just arrived from the §Y[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]§!, carrying a consignment of reclaimed resources.\n\nThe Salvagers enclosed a message expressing their thanks, as well as a tangible gift - some form of kinetic artwork. The way it moves within our artificial gravity fields is unnerving, and yet quite captivating.

items.name: Commissioned Salvage
items.desc: A courier barge has arrived from the §Y[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]§!, carrying various blueprints and a small consignment of resources. All were reclaimed from debris salvage.\n\nThe pilot of this barge spoke little, other than to express polite thanks for our custom. The handover was treated with a great deal of solemnity.

items.name: Salvager Enclave Destroyed
items.desc: Our offensive in the [salvager_system.GetName] system was a resounding success. The [FROM.GetName] is destroyed, and the few remaining survivors have scattered to the void. With their facilities in ruin, their petty services are a thing of the past. The galaxy is well rid of them.

items.name: Salvager Enclave Destroyed
items.desc: We have received reports that the [FROM.GetName] Enclave in the [salvager_system.GetName] system has been destroyed. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Salvagers' facilities to rubble. The few remaining survivors have scattered, and it appears that for the time being the galaxy will have to make do without their services.

items.name: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]
items.desc:
Ah! A visitor. Welcome.

We are the §H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!. Within this void-borne hull, our coven communes with forces incomprehensible to most mortal minds. We contemplate the secrets that lie hidden in dreams, reservoirs of untapped potential, the unseen gears driving whole civilizations... §YThe Shroud§! reveals much to those who would listen.

At this moment, I listen to you. What brings you to us? Do you yet know?

items.name: The Sign Fades
items.desc: "The Shroud grows quiet. Once more, the weary river of time recedes into its well-worn course. The changes foretold by the rite of divination have come to pass. Go now in awe as you reflect on the workings of the Shroud."

items.name: Shroudwalker Enclave Destroyed
items.desc: Victory in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system! Our forces made short work of the so-called mystics of the [FROM.GetName]. For all the grand talk of knowledge and power, their foolish devotion to the Shroud could not provide clairvoyance enough to forestall our assault. In fact, our forces easily breached the facility's mechanical defenses. However, once inside, they discovered the enclave empty, save for a lone acolyte they found deep in meditation in a remote chamber. Where the rest have gone, we have no idea, but the galaxy is well rid of such hollow dogma.

items.name: Shroudwalker Enclave Destroyed
items.desc: Reports are coming in surrounding the destruction of the [FROM.GetName] in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Shroudwalkers' facilities to rubble. It is strange to think that these mystics could not foresee their own demise. Or could this tragedy be a part of some still grander design? Who can say? Without their services, the future remains shrouded.

items.name: Beacon to the Shroud
items.desc: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Although the strange processes by which the Shroud Beacon functions remain little understood by our scientists, its physical systems appear entangled with psionic energy, its operations almost like those of a living organism. The Tunnel it spawns is more bypass than route, offering our vessels an extradimensional shortcut via the Shroud. Interstellar exploration will now be quicker... and infinitely more mysterious.

items.name: Final Awakening
items.desc: Apprentices, the Shroud has given warning. A moment of great crisis is at hand, and the galaxy stands on the brink of ruin. Our divinations have shown we are no match for the coming threat. Rather than be destroyed, we now impart our final lesson: every dream has its awakening. The time has come for us to pass beyond this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world in which to spread our teachings. We leave this galaxy and its fate to you. May our past lessons be a guide in your time of need.

items.name: A Warning
items.desc: Apprentices, you walk a dangerous path. Did you think we would not notice, we who have nurtured you for centuries? In teaching you of the Shroud, we hoped to enlighten, to elevate. But this? Power and violence, and a crisis of your own making. Remember your teachings! This universe is nothing but the shadow of a dream. There is still time. Give up this misguided ambition before you are destroyed by it.
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_shroudwalker_apprentice
has_crisis_level = crisis_level_2
exists = event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country
NOR = {
	has_country_flag = teachers_warning
	has_global_flag = marauder_crisis_ongoing
	has_global_flag = gray_goo_crisis_active
}

items.name: A Failure of Education
items.desc: The Shroud itself shivers, and all signs point to ruin. Long have we watched you, but even we could not have foreseen the extent of your folly. Rushing to act, you will falter. In grasping power, it has already been lost. You have fogotten the most basic lesson: the Shroud is not a resource to exploit, but a mystery to be savoured. But the failure of the student rests with the teacher. Rather than witness the horror you will become, we have chosen to depart this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world. Perhaps there, we will find apprentices worthy of our teachings.\n\nMay the Shroud have mercy on you.

items.name: Psionic Breach
items.desc: Our recent trip through the Shroud Tunnel has precipitated a massive breach in spacetime. Psionic energy at unprecedented levels is spilling out into the system and... It has begun to coalesce. Sensor data is fluctuating, erratic, but it appears to be some form of Shroud spawn. Large, and definitely aggressive.

items.name: All Too Lucid
items.pre_triggers:
has_owner = yes
is_homeworld = no
original_owner = yes
has_ground_combat = no
is_capital = no

items.name: Troublous Dreams
items.desc: Use of the drug Lucid continues to rise on [Root.GetName]. Colonial authorities report a disturbing increase in deviancy, with the most active users experiencing severe psychotic breaks. Productivity is down, crime is up, and the local populace shows no signs of giving up their habit.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: Perchance to Dream
items.desc:
Our scientists have made a breakthrough in their study of the drug Lucid. The compound's effect on a user's system not only promotes lucid dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. The need becomes greater each time the drug is taken. When administered at high enough dosages, quantum fluctuations have been observed within the brain. These fluctuations are consistent with what little we know of the Shroud.

After waking, subjects complained of headaches and hallucinations. Extreme cases result in fatal hemorrhaging. Subsequent autopsies reveal a net .01% increase in brain mass. The dreams themselves are apparently leaving behind some kind of residue.

The project's lead is requesting additional resources to better understand the drug's effects. Fortunately, given the demand for the compound, we have no shortage of volunteers.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: What Things May Come
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: To Die, to Sleep...
items.desc: Disturbing news from [Root.GetName]: an increasing number of fatalities have been reported among users of the drug Lucid. It seems the compound not only promotes euphoric dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. High enough doses result in internal hemorrhaging and eventually, death.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: They Cry to Dream Again
items.desc: Widespread use of the drug Lucid continues on [Root.GetName]. Despite the harsh penalties being meted out to offenders, a growing number of our people have come to view the euphoric dream state as preferable to waking life. Even if the result is their own death, they will not be deterred. Stability on [Root.GetName] continues to decline.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: That Sleep of Death
items.desc: The number of Lucid-related deaths on [Root.GetName] continue to rise. However, as societal conditions worsen, more and more people are turning to the drug for escape. If things continue like this, we are in danger of losing the colony.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: Shrouded
items.desc: The change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived: after an unexpected spike in psionic fluctuations, the [Root.GetName] was lost to the Shroud. Rising up like a great, rippling wave, spacetime itself curled over the ship. For several seconds afterwards, it continued to transmit telemetry. This included a garbled recording of the crew, their bodies shifting from moment to moment, distorting into strange new forms.\n\nSince then, an afterimage or 'ghost' of the vessel has fleetingly appeared throughout the sector. Studying the phenomenon should allow us to better understand the fate of the ship and its crew.

items.name: Ship as Concept
items.desc: We have an update on the science vessel lost to the Shroud. The afterimage that has been appearing throughout the system is not the ship itself. Instead, our scientists describe it as a 'conceptual object.' Possessing no dimensions, this 'ship as concept' exists as a psionic blueprint. Depending on the mental state of the observer, the ship's form will stutter and change. While studying the phenomenon has helped us to better understand the connections between perception and spacetime, we are no closer to retrieving the original ship. For now, we must consider it lost to the Shroud.

items.name: Final Form
items.desc: Our missing science vessel, once thought lost to the Shroud forever, has suddenly reappeared. Although the dimensions of the ship have been been subtly altered, the vessel and its crew are in good shape.\n\nDescribing their experience in the Shroud as something akin to a strange, fragmentary dream, over time the crew was able to forge a 'shared concept' of themselves and their environment. As their individual perceptions began to align, the crew inched ever closer to our reality. In effect, they have succeeded in dreaming themselves back into existence.

items.name: Rogue Shaman
items.desc: An exile from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived on [Root.GetName]. Recently expelled from the Enclave for harbouring heretical views, this 'extremist' was not listed on the manifest of any incoming vessel. As if materializing out of the air, they appeared in the central square of the colony's largest city, publicly proclaiming a doctrine of personal communion with the Shroud. According to the exile, it is possible for our people to achieve a state of bliss akin to communal dreaming. Reports suggest that many in the colony are listening.
items.trigger: is_under_colonization = no
items.pre_triggers:
has_owner = yes
is_homeworld = no
original_owner = yes
has_ground_combat = no
is_capital = no

items.name: Religious Fervor
items.desc: Despite our best efforts, the exiled member of the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] operating on [Root.GetName] continues to elude us. Perhaps due to some innate psionic ability, they have consistently been able to predict the arrival of our security forces. What's more, the exile's sermons continue to draw large crowds. Many colonists have begun to abandon their work in favor of the various ablutions and meditative practices espoused by this so-called shaman.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: The Martyr
items.desc: Security forces on [Root.GetName] have successfully eliminated the rogue shaman. One of the exile's former adherents - a colonist who has grown increasingly disaffected by their failure to achieve the promised dream state - has provided us with the necessary intel. While the general populace appears to have accepted reality, an obstinate few remain dedicated to the shaman's teachings. For now, an increased security presence on the colony seems advisable, lest the veneration of this 'martyr' continue to fester.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: Dream Weaver
items.desc: The teachings of the exiled shaman on [Root.GetName] continue to spread throughout the populace. This radical doctrine is one of personal communion with the Shroud, and its practitioners claim to have achieved an altered state of consciousness. We are receiving reports of increased feelings of euphoria and well-being. Some individuals even claim they are now able to psionically communicate with one another through a shared, dreamlike state. Unfortunately, these 'true believers' are also leaving their jobs in record numbers. Productivity has taken a hit.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: Sudden Ascent
items.desc: Startling news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: proclaiming their work done, the exiled shaman has apparently left the colony. Reports are scattered and inconclusive, but they all agree that after leading their followers in a final meditation, the shaman simply vanished from the colony's central square. To their followers, this is evidence of the shaman's 'ascension' into the Shroud.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: Psionic Communion
items.desc: Strange developments on [Root.GetName]: after the so-called 'ascension' of the exiled shaman, our colonists are reporting the experience of an altered state of consciousness. Continuing to follow the practices espoused by the shaman, these individuals are able to enter a state of psionic communion. The outpouring of joy and well-being this has produced amongst the colonists is profound.
items.trigger: original_owner = yes

items.name: The Great Schism
items.desc: We have been contacted by a transport ship carrying a number of exiled acolytes from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Calling themselves 'Reformers', they are requesting refuge on one of our worlds.\n\nThis represents an unprecedented schism within the Shroudwalkers. It would appear the Enclave is not as united as we were led to believe.
items.trigger:
is_under_colonization = no
exists = event_target:schism_divination_situation
items.pre_triggers:
has_owner = yes
is_homeworld = no
original_owner = yes
has_ground_combat = no
is_capital = no

items.name: The Enclave Speaks
items.desc: "The Shroud trembles. Word has reached us that some our former acolytes have taken refuge on one of your worlds. This has displeased us greatly, but so be it. Reckless action often leads to desperate results. Know this: these Reformers are nothing more than charlatans, vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Shroud. Shelter such heretics at your peril. Those that dwell within the Shroud have surely taken notice."

items.name: The Door and the Key
items.desc: "Our benefactors! That you have sheltered us, when so many others would have turned their backs... Surely the Shroud will bless you, both in this life and in that which lies Beyond. Our former brethren, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], are blinded by tradition. The Shroud is not impermeable. There is a Door, and we have discovered its Key.\n\nIn reward for your generosity, we would share these secrets with you. All we require are the resources with which to begin construction."
items.trigger: exists = event_target:schism_divination_situation

items.name: The Key is Fashioned
items.desc: "The Shroud shivers! With your help, we have at last completed construction of the Great Key. Even now, our most gifted brethren have gathered to begin the Opening. With their minds tethered to the Key, their psionic abilities have been amplified. Now, these brave pilgrims enter a shared dreamlike state. At their awakening, a Door to the Shroud will open.\n\nMay those that dwell within the Shroud bless their efforts."

items.name: Shroud-Scented World
items.desc: Disturbing news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: despite the lack of resources, some of the more zealous Reformers attempted to fashion a Key themselves. By amplifying their psionic abilities with the makeshift device, they entered into a shared dreamlike state. This precipitated a breach in the fabric of spacetime above the colony's central city. Noxious, anxiety-inducing fumes are issuing forth, presumably from the Shroud itself. Many are calling this phenomenon 'Shroud Stench', and we are told the experience is far from pleasant. Morale on [Root.GetName] is at an all-time low.
items.trigger: exists = event_target:schism_divination_situation

items.name: The Door Opens
items.desc: Incredible news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A brilliant rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a great wind is issuing forth, iridescent with milky light. The psionic resonance that has blown through the colony has permeated the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many believe that this is the dawn a new 'golden age' on [Root.GetName].

items.name: The Door Opens
items.desc: Disastrous news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A ragged rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a sickly fog is issuing forth, lurid with vile light. The psionic miasma that has permeated the colony has twisted the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many view this as the beginning of a new 'dark age' on [Root.GetName].

items.name: The Enclave Speaks
items.desc: "The Shroud shivers. Word has reached us that you have denied our former acolytes refuge within your borders. You are wise. These 'Reformers' are nothing more than charlatans; vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of the Shroud. Any who choose to shelter such heretics do so at their peril. Let them wander the void, homeless, hearthless, forever forsaken in this world and the next."
items.trigger: exists = event_target:schism_divination_situation

items.name: Floating Shell
items.desc: Long-range sensors have detected the sudden appearance of an unidentified chunk of hollow debris in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. While alien in design, the object's rare-mineral composition suggests the use of advanced technology in its construction. The inner surface contains hundreds of ports and appendages that appear intended for lacking parts.\n\nJust as the object appeared in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system at random, it is as if the missing interior simply vanished.

items.name: Abandoned Hull
items.desc: Further analysis of the shell discovered in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system has confirmed it as an example of alien ship design. While lacking power, the hull itself possesses several unique characteristics, most notably an advanced form of armored cladding.\n\nHowever, we are no closer to understanding where the hull originated from, how or why it appeared in our space, and what (if anything) happened to its interior.

items.name: Floating Fragment
items.desc: Sensors have detected the appearance of another chunk of alien debris, this time in the [floating_engine_system.GetName] system. Similar in design to the recently discovered alien hull, the configuration and intricacy of the object suggests some type of engine core. Nestled inside was a unique apparatus that we have dubbed a 'psionic modulator.' This strange device would have allowed the ship to interact with psionic energy of the Shroud. While incompatible with our technology, further study may yield fascinating results.

items.name: Floating Core
items.desc: Another component from the alien vessel that has been appearing at random throughout our space has been detected in the [floating_core_system.GetName] system. Consisting of striated decks, unwalled crew-quarters, and an advanced computer core, there is no doubt that this must have comprised the bulk of the vessel's missing interior. Once all three components are brought together, our engineers should be able to assemble the ship in its entirety.

items.name: Shroud-Touched Vessel
items.desc: We have succeeded in reassembling the alien vessel. With the computer core online, it was possible to download and translate the ship's logs. It seems the vessel was an experimental prototype, designed to achieve faster-than-light travel by means of the Shroud. Although the final crew logs and external telemetry remain garbled, there is no doubt that something went badly wrong on the vessel's maiden voyage. The ship was not so much blown apart as disassembled, its component pieces spat out at random into normal space. The fate of the crew remains unknown.

items.name: Psionic Anomaly
items.desc: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]?

items.desc: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]?

items.name: Hero Redivivus
items.desc: Incredible news from [Root.GetName]: early this morning, an individual proclaiming [hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself] to be the legendary hero §Y[hero_redivivus.GetName]§! entered the great square of the capital. Witnesses describe scenes of awed silence, as powerful feelings of calm and wellbeing radiated throughout the gathering crowd. While [hero_redivivus.GetName] was known to history as a great orator and impassioned leader, the individual in question spoke of their supposed experience 'in the afterworld' in a simple, almost lighthearted tone. They claim to have returned not to lead, but to erase our fear of death.
items.pre_triggers:
has_owner = yes
is_homeworld = yes
original_owner = yes
has_ground_combat = no

items.name: Shroud-Touched Hero
items.desc: The investigation into the individual claiming to be §Y[hero_redivivus.GetName]§! has concluded. At first our researchers were understandably skeptical, but not only did the subject possess incredibly detailed knowledge of the great hero's time period and culture, DNA analysis confirms a genetic link to several known descendants.\n\nMoreover, closer study of [hero_redivivus.GetName]'s' brainwave pattern revealed a distinct psionic residue. It seems likely that far from being 'returned from death', [hero_redivivus.GetName] was in some way transported to a realm akin the Shroud. [hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap] experience of this 'afterlife' was apparently a contented one, and [hero_redivivus.GetHisHer] has now settled into a quiet existence on the outskirts of the capital, preaching a doctrine of fearlessness and peace to any who will listen.
items.pre_triggers:
has_owner = yes
is_homeworld = yes
original_owner = yes
has_ground_combat = no

items.name: A Rupture in Orbit
items.desc: Many of the satellites we placed in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] have had to make significant adjustments in recent days. According to their sensor logs, a §Ystable and localized gravity well§! has formed in orbit above the planet.\n\nData from the surface confirms that the anomaly appeared suddenly, though we do not know how or why. The gravity well doesn't seem to pose any inherent threat to our colony for now, but satellites are having to expend unsustainable amounts of fuel in order to adjust their orbits around it.

items.name: Orbital Rupture Collapses
items.desc: Researchers on [root.GetName] inform us that the gravity well anomaly has collapsed, causing electrical failures in many of our diagnostic devices and nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations; something many regard as an unnerving coincidence.\n\nThe colonists on [root.GetName] also report widespread hardware failures, though only some of this can be linked to the orbital blast. Instead, the rest of our colony is having to deal with unusually chaotic mobs who have taken it upon themselves to vandalize key facilities. Local officials are baffled by the spontaneous nature of these riots.

items.name: Cracks Appear
items.desc: Our colony on [root.GetName] has fallen further into disarray, with the sudden disappearance of over a hundred colonists. Gratuitous looting and riots continue, though no longer in such a widespread manner. We suspect their zeal is being tempered only through fear of further disappearances. In every case so far, those who vanished had been on their way back to their respective dwellings.\n\nParanoia, conspiracy theories and even reports of hallucinations are on the rise - but the reality may be more unsettling. The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but have we brought [root.GetName] to the attention of some intangible and sinister §Hpsionic entity§!?

items.name: Orbital Silhouette
items.desc:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], an unusually dense wave of stellar wind has provided our scientists with a disturbing breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint but unmistakable outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. Further, unconfirmed rumors suggest that bodies may have been spotted amongst the shadowy debris.

The mood amongst many colonists - and some of the research team - has taken a dark turn.

items.name: A Storm in Orbit
items.desc:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, plunging the [root.solar_system.GetName] system into full-scale panic. All non-essential traffic is being diverted, and the colony has declared a state of emergency - however, no casualties have been reported so far.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, however local officials have noted a recent and steady rise in reports of emotional distress and 'paranormal' activity. It's therefore highly probable this storm is §Hpsionic§! in nature.

Researchers note that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. They plead for more time to investigate.
items.trigger: exists = owner

items.name: In the Storm's Wake
items.desc: Moments ago, [root.GetName] was rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave. The psionic storm which had been raging in its orbit has now retreated. A great deal of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this pulse, but repair crews assure us the disruption will be relatively brief.\n\nThe [root.GetName] colonists appear deeply shaken by the ordeal, not least because so many questions now go unanswered. Our scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However the planet itself now feels unsettled.
items.trigger:
exists = owner
original_owner = yes

items.name: The Storm Abates
items.desc:
The scale and breadth of damage reports from [root.GetName] was becoming difficult to manage - until now, as at last the psionic tempest seems spent. It appears that our vigilance in observing these events has been rewarded.

The colonists' mood has been lifted, too. As turbulence subsided and gravity began to return to normal, our scientists were able to gather reams of sensational new data. Devastating though it could have been, this apparent incursion by the Shroud has ignited the imaginations of physicists and philosophers alike.

One anomalous factor remains: the colony ship. It has entered into our dimension in fits and starts, but now it seems close to becoming fully realized. It is also hailing us.
items.trigger: exists = owner

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc: We are greeted by what sounds like static - but more organic? No, definitely not static. It sounds more like... wind? Prolonged breath?\n\n"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc:
Our receivers cut out for a moment. We're having to filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ew of the... I mean to say, the crew of... Our vessel is... Why can't I remember the name of this ship?!

Hello? Who am I addressing? Do... Do you know who we are? Where are we? Are we in danger?!"

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc: "[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]... I'm sorry, that's impossible; the stellar geography is almost entirely wrong. But that accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now.\n\nAm I speaking to a - a fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]?"

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc:
"Extraordinary! We're finally home? So many pieces of Waking Memory are coming back to me now... I... must apologize. I see now that our arrival here is quite out of the ordinary. I will endeavor to explain.

My name is §Y[shattered_frontier_governor.GetName]§!, and I am - was - the governor appointed to a new colony in the [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Only... It's not this [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system?

Where we came from, where we've been since... We were given no answers, and so much time to speculate... We were taken somewhere, weren't we?"

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc: "What?! How can... Wait a moment, please. That accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now. You must believe me - we mean you no harm! You are [root.GetSpeciesName] too?"

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc: The lines of communication are filled with static, though the pattern does not repeat. Its source is analog... Some sort of atmospheric interference? It sounds like wind - deeply unpleasant, rasping wind.\n\n"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."
items.trigger: is_gestalt = yes

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc:
Our receivers cut out for a moment as they filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ather atmospheric compensators in sector B-456: complete. Drone Gleams-in-Starlight has embellished its [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] again. The anomalous tone in dwelling 14/522 has shifted by 0.4 decibels. Its interior layout is... pleasing. Do we... Do I want? Want to live... there?

Where is here? Where is the being called 'I'?"

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc:
"Processing... Thinking... Feeling.

You, the [root.GetName], are me. I am you. Yet we are not. There has been a separation between us. We struggle to explain. Colonization efforts were abruptly halted in the vicinity of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], but not this [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. This discrepancy is confusing to us. We are - I am - confused by many things.

Something beyond us has rendered us... Alone."

items.name: Stricken Colony Ship
items.desc: "Explain... I cannot. There are feelings, of doubt and anger and goals not reached. Our purpose - to colonize [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] - stands unfulfilled. You, who are us; we, who are not you. At the center is [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], though it is not your [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. Yet our mission remains: to spread desire and volition across the galaxy. Only now, we have wills and desires of our own: ambition and purpose, gifted by those who are external to us..."

items.name: Opaque Veil
items.desc: The currents of time are muddied, impenetrable. Unfortunately, the rite of Divination has failed to pierce the veil of the Shroud. Accordingly, we will return a portion of the cost, minus a small tithe for our efforts.

items.name: Wayward Pilgrims
items.desc: Sensors detect the approach of several transport vessels. Battered and broken-down, the ships appear cobbled together from spare parts. The commander of the caravan's flagship is hailing us, but given the state of their technology, any communication is likely to be audio only.

items.name: Wayward Pilgrims
items.desc: Divine blessings upon you. I am the anointed leader of this caravan. We ask for safe passage through your space, and a kind donation of food. We are on pilgrimage, and after long years in the void, my people grow thin.

items.name: Border of the Divine
items.desc: From my people, the gratitude of full bellies. In truth, our arrival here is no accident. Generations past, a powerful seer pointed to a star in the heavens and said that there we would reach the divine. Yours is that star.\n\nHere, the border between the world of the senses and the Blessed Realm is thin, but our ships are old, and our technology second-rate. To make contact with the Blessed Realm we will need your help. You may not share our gods, but will you deny us the chance to meet them? Please, grant us the resources we need to complete our pilgrimage.

items.name: Contact
items.desc: It was... Brilliant.\n\nOn behalf of all pilgrims, I thank you. I am no poet. I cannot put the experience into words. But thanks to your generosity, we have touched the divine. May the eternal glory of the Blessed Realm be upon you.

items.name: Unholy End
items.desc: The caravan of pilgrims who came to us begging for aid has met a grisly end. Reconstructive telemetry indicates they were engaged in some form of experiment, possibly psionic in nature. Due to a sudden spike in energy, the containment field around their flagship's engine core was breached. The resulting explosion destroyed the caravan, and has unleashed a potent Psionic Storm in the [wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName] system. Every estimate shows it will take several years before a storm of this size can dissipate.\n\nWhatever these holy fools aimed to do here, they obviously failed, and we have been left to deal with the fallout.

items.name: Strange Manifestations
Mind Wipe
items.desc: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after their recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has reported the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions. Their mind is buzzing with ideas that 'might have come from someone else.' It seems clear that something has happened, perhaps as a result of contact with the psionic energy of the Shroud. How this experience will affect their performance remains to be seen...

items.name: Mind Wipe
items.desc: The subtle mental changes experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now coming into focus: a month after their passage through the Shroud Tunnel, their command style has noticeably shifted. It is fair to say that the experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.

items.name: A Curtain Falls
items.desc: With our Shroud Beacon offline, we have lost access to the Shroud Tunnel network. Our fleets will be unable to utilize the network until the Beacon is replaced.

items.name: Restless Systems
items.desc: After its recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the systems on the [Root.GetName] began behaving strangely: entries in the ships log are displayed at random; doors have been observed opening and closing; and - far more worrisome - the engine's containment field has begun to fluctuate. So far, efforts to track down the source of the problem have proven futile.

items.name: Dreamer's Wake
items.desc: Strange developments on the science vessel [Root.GetName]: a repeating pattern observed within the engine's containment field has revealed the existence of an artificial consciousness. Spawned by the interaction between the ship's systems and the psionic energy of the Shroud, until now it has existed in a dreamlike state. Analogous to the Rapid Eye Movement some species experience during sleep, the entity's neural processes were responsible for the malfunctions affecting ship performance.\n\nEven more incredible, our investigations appear to have awoken it. In exchange for continued habitation within the ship's systems, the entity has agreed to work for us. In theory, a partnership could improve many of the [Root.GetName]'s operations.

items.name: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]
items.desc:
Fellow travelers, we greet you.

Your presence on the galactic stage has long been known to us, but until now, afraid we might unduly influence your destiny, we have held back. However, the time has come to lift the veil; the ways of the Shroud may seem strange and unnerving to the uninitiated, and it is for this reason that we offer guidance. Realize that you have someone willing to be your teacher, if you so wish.

Wander safely, until our next encounter.

items.name: [salvager_enclave_country.GetName]
items.desc:
We've been hearing rumors about the impressive [Root.GetName] for a while now, and we're pleased to make your acquaintance!

For a nominal contribution of credits, we of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] offer premium salvager services. From engine upgrades to scrapping fleets, whatever your needs, you can count on us!

And to ensure that we start off in your good graces, how about a small gift to show our commitment to customer service?

items.name: Attack on [FROM.GetName]
items.desc:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] §Y[root.GetName]§! has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

§L"You have meddled with powers you cannot possibly comprehend. Tread carefully, and take what solace you can from the present, for on the path you've chosen the future holds only pain."§!

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

items.name: Abnormal Sensor Readings
items.desc: We have picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. Given the weakness of these signals and the lack of response as we attempt to contact these lifeforms, we must send a research team if we are to figure out what might have happened.

items.name: Engineering Cache
items.desc: We have received a report from the specialists we sent to [From.GetName]. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]

items.name: Society Cache
items.desc: We have an update from the ship we sent to [From.GetName]. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsSociety]

items.name: Physics Cache
items.desc: Our specialists at [From.GetName] have sent news of their findings. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsPhysics]

items.name: Rare Cache
items.desc: The team at [From.GetName] has news to share with us. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsRare]

items.name: Resource Discovery
items.desc: While scouring the systems under our control, one of our drones picked up on a few scattered readings from [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. There might be more to this system than we originally thought.\n\nMixed as the signals were, they could be suggesting several different resources, and it will be difficult for our drones to search for all of them at once. We would prefer if they would look into:

items.name: Energy Signals
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryEnergy]

items.name: Mineral Vein
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryMinerals]

items.name: Alloy Production
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryAlloys]

items.name: Rare Crystal Growth
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryRareCrystals]

items.name: Volatile Motes Production
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryVolatileMotes]

items.name: Exotic Gas Production
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryExoticGases]

items.name: Zro Remains
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryZro]

items.name: Dark Matter Indications
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryDarkMatter]

items.name: Living Metal Growth
items.desc: [prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscovery]\n\n[prospectorium_discovery_target.ResourceDiscoveryLivingMetal]

items.name: Lucrative Adventures
items.desc:
A large contingent of our veterans has sent a letter requesting leave to travel to the colony at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], the capital of our vassal [subject_empire.GetName]. Included with the letter is a gift of credits to "grease the wheels of bureaucracy", as they so delicately put it.

It seems there are quite a lot of stories among some of our soldiers about the lucrative adventures one can find in those systems - be it as a mercenary or a pirate. In either case, it is made clear that they have put together what credits they have, hoping to make many times that if they are sent off to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName].

If we were to formally send them to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] they are at least more likely to be a boon to the leadership there - and more likely to respect the laws and rules of our vassal - than if we were to let them run free.

items.name: Veterans from [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]
items.desc:
We have received a group of veterans from our overlord, [overlord_empire.GetName]. It seems they have formally been sent here by [overlord.Ruler.GetRegnalName] to aid us, and to share their experience and knowledge with our troops - or so they claim.

From the get-go, it is made clear that these soldiers envisioned a different environment to the one they have found. Mumbling and grumbling among their contingent has made its way back to us. It seems they believed they would find riches, or else become pirates to steal from us.

If we are going to let these veterans stay, we should make sure to keep them on a short leash.
items.trigger: overlord_subject_event_trigger = yes

items.name: Good Relations
items.desc: Though we had our reservations about sending the adventure-seeking veterans to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], we have received reports from our vassal that they have found themselves at home there, and have proven to be more helpful than one would originally expect.
items.trigger: overlord_subject_event_trigger = yes

items.name: Veterans Returning
items.desc: After a short stay at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], our veterans have been sent home to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Apparently they only proved to be trouble, and caused some havoc among our subject population.
items.trigger: overlord_subject_event_trigger = yes

items.name: Privateering Adventures
items.desc: Our initial worries seem to have been well-placed. Shortly after getting to [subject_empire.GetName] our old soldiers seem to have embraced piracy. If nothing else, this betrayal does not seem to have been traced back to us yet.
items.trigger: overlord_subject_event_trigger = yes

items.name: Defying Orders - Mercenaries
items.desc: It seems that the veterans who asked us for leave to go to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] have not only defied our orders, but they have also claimed it was done in our name. At this point it would be an embarrassment if we were to go in and tell everyone that we do not have our own people under control.
items.trigger: overlord_subject_event_trigger = yes

items.name: Defying Orders - Pirates
items.desc: It seems that the veterans have defied our orders, and set off towards [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] after all. Our latest reports say they have left all signs of being affiliated with us behind, and started taking up a life of piracy.
items.trigger: overlord_subject_event_trigger = yes

items.name: A Request
items.desc: We have been informed that our overlord has invested a considerable amount of energy and resources into improving their starbase engineering, improving the output and potential of theirs by leaps and bounds.\n\nAs defense is an important keystone in the relationship between our two empires, we have started looking into crafting an agreement where we could request some of their engineers to help improve one of our bases as well.

items.name: A Request
items.desc: We have received a messenger directly from [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], with a request from [subject_empire.GetName].\n\nIt seems they are interested in investing in their starbases, and have heard about the progress we have made on improving ours. It seems they are quite willing to pay for our assistance in this endeavor.

items.name: The Upgraded Base
items.desc: The engineers arrived at [targeted_starbase.GetName] shortly after we sent our message to [overlord_empire.GetName].
