items.name: The First [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] Colony
items.desc: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased safely within the rocky core of the meteorite - will soon emerge and begin setting up prefabricated colonial infrastructure.

items.name: First Alien Encounter
items.desc: The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.\n\nThese particular xenos have a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.

items.name: Developing Civilization Encountered
items.desc: The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms our long-held belief that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never even considered exploring beyond their own planet.\n\nEach species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary. The technological level of these particular aliens is low by our standards. They have not yet achieved space flight. We must decide how best to engage them going forward.

items.name: First Alien Encounter
items.desc: The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.\n\nThese particular xenos appear to have been active on the galactic stage for some time - their empire is likely thousands of years old, and their technology is far ahead of our own. We should be careful when dealing with them.

items.name: Second Alien Encounter
[Root.GetSpeciesName] Refugees Arrive
items.desc: A flotilla of civilian transports carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesName]§! refugees from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.\n\nThese unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from their homes by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities. They have been traveling from system to system since then, in a desperate attempt to find new homes before the last of their dwindling supplies were used up.

items.name: An Ally Against the Queen
items.desc:
The Shroud reverberates with an unprecedented ferocity. Vast coils of energy writhe and thrash in the ether.

Amid the strobing disorder, we behold the psionic echoes of the synthetic queen. Infinite and omnipotent, she toys with the galaxy in her palm.

We are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, the §HAnimator of Clay§! watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.

Why? Does it know of a weakness we do not? Will it assist us if we reach out to it?

As we focus our minds upon the Animator, we sense its impatience. It is very likely that we will only have one opportunity to ask for its aid in this matter. Massive quantities of §HEnergy§! and §HZro§! will be needed for the effort.

items.name: Psionic Suppression Dismantled
items.desc: In taking control of the §H[from.GetName]§! system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our Psionic Aura.

items.name: Unconventional Breakthrough
items.desc: Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was once thought to be fringe science.

items.name: Unearthed Mother Lode
items.desc: A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nAfter a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitation with the expansion of existing mining efforts.

items.name: Unearthed Mother Lode
items.desc: A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nAfter a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitation with the expansion of existing mining efforts.

items.name: Newfound Fertility
items.desc: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of §H[This.GetName]§!. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

items.name: Geothermal Vents
items.desc: Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on §H[This.GetName]§!. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.\n\nThis natural phenomenon provides us with an opportunity to expand the colony's energy infrastructure with new geothermal power plants and heat pumps.

items.name: Quantum Particle Stream Discovered
items.desc: An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near §H[physics_planet.GetName]§!. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dynamics.\n\nFocused study of this quantum field would allow us to better understand the fundamental building blocks of our universe.

items.name: Quantum Particle Stream Discovered
items.desc: An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near §H[physics_planet.GetName]§!. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dynamics.\n\nFocused study of this quantum field would allow us to better understand the fundamental building blocks of our universe.

items.name: Interdimensional Echo Discovered
items.desc:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near §H[society_planet.GetName]§!.

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages relate to logical principles and philosophical quandaries. Perhaps this is an attempt at intellectual enrichment from entities beyond our comprehension.

If we establish a direct feed with these signals we can continue to monitor their revelations.

items.name: Interdimensional Echo Discovered
items.desc:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near §H[society_planet.GetName]§!.

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages relate to logical principles and philosophical quandaries. Perhaps this is an attempt at intellectual enrichment from entities beyond our comprehension.

If we establish a direct feed with these signals we can continue to monitor their revelations.

items.name: Advanced Wreckage Discovered
items.desc: A derelict ship has appeared in §H[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]§!. The irreparably damaged vessel was able to generate some form of invisibility field and is generally far more tactically advanced than our own fleets.\n\nWe have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctioned. No life signs are onboard, and we have already begun careful disassembly of the vessel to learn as much as we can.

items.name: Geothermic Metallurgy
items.desc: Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.\n\nThis geological phenomenon has superheated some of the unexploited minerals, refining veins of metallic ore into solid alloys. As such, mining operations on the planet will now produce fragments of workable metal.

items.name: Geothermic Metallurgy
items.desc: Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.\n\nThis geological phenomenon has superheated some of the unexploited minerals, refining veins of metallic ore into solid alloys. As such, mining operations on the planet will now produce fragments of workable metal.

items.name: Abandoned Cruiser
items.desc: A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the §H[From.GetName]§! system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.\n\nAfter an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEngineerPlural] have declared that the ship is now fit for active service.

items.name: A Sense of Optimism
items.desc: The §H[This.GetName]§! is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

items.name: Favorable Trine
items.desc: Three celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a favorable trine; §H[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]§! and §H[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]§!.\n\nThis beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of tranquility and harmony to our colony on §H[This.GetName]§!.

items.name: [auspicious_position_planet.GetName] in Auspicious Position
items.desc: §H[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]§! is occupying an auspicious position in the skies above §H[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, residing in the astrological House of Celestial Return.\n\nThis represents the commencement of a new internal cycle for the [root.GetName] and a prime opportunity for growth and improvement.

items.name: Elemental Harmony
items.desc: All quantifiable astrological metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in perfect elemental balance.\n\nWith precise ley line management this beneficial equilibrium can be maintained for an extended period, providing an ideal metaphysical environment in which our leaders can flourish.

items.name: Radiant Luminary
items.desc: The primary luminary in the §H[From.GetName]§! system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on §H[This.GetName]§!.

items.name: Councilor Harmony
items.desc: Two of our council members, §H[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]§! recently discovered that their astrological signs are perfectly complementary.\n\nTheir subsequent political partnership has since united our government under a banner of mutual respect and efficiency, accelerating various legislative processes.

items.name: More Than it Seems
items.desc: During a routine cataloging exercise, an unsecured specimen was dropped on the floor of the §HGrand Archive§! and was swiftly delivered to a conservator for closer examination.\n\nSurprisingly, a secret compartment was found to have been loosened in the accident. Previously unnoticed, it contained a wide variety of interesting artifacts we can add to our collection.

items.name: Discordance
items.desc: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the §H[This.GetName]§!. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

items.name: Naval Collision
items.desc: A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the §H[This.GetName]§! in §H[This.System.GetName]§!.\n\nCentral military command has confirmed that the individuals responsible for this error have been disciplined appropriately.

items.name: Silo Fire
items.desc: An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on §H[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]§! resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.\n\nThe fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

items.name: Diplomatic Faux Pas
items.desc: One of our representatives in the Galactic Community has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vitriolic and hateful insults to the [diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]. The unfortunate incident has been spread across the galactic media and disparaged our reputation.\n\nWhile these actions do not warrant immediate dismissal, our standing within the Galactic Community has been weakened as a result of this indiscretion.

items.name: Extreme Solar Flare
High Profile Traffic Accident
items.desc: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.\n\nUnfortunately, their systems were damaged beyond repair.

items.name: High Profile Traffic Accident
items.desc: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.\n\n[This.GetName] survived the collision, but not unscathed. The damage done is irreversible.

items.name: Massive Sinkholes
items.desc: Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected areas were evacuated successfully.\n\nWe cannot determine the exact cause of the sudden appearance of these geological cavities, but additional maintenance checks have been implemented to monitor surface erosion.

items.name: Spontaneous Uproar
items.desc: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

items.name: Sudden Infectious Disease
items.desc: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's spread and avoid overwhelming local medical infrastructure.

items.name: Calamitous Quartile
items.desc: Four celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]§! and §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]§!.\n\nThis disastrous astrological phenomenon will sow the seeds of doubt on the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, encouraging dissent by sowing disharmony among the population.

items.name: [planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName] in Retrograde
items.desc: Inhabitants of §H[planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]§! have observed that §H[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]§! is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome period of reflection bring us closer to our ideals in future.

items.name: Elemental Imbalance
items.desc: Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.\n\nAttempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access a metaphysical meditative environment, impeding their development.

items.name: Luminary Waning
items.desc: The primary luminary in the §H[From.GetName]§! system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of §H[This.GetName]§!.

items.name: Discordant Council
items.desc: Two of our council members, §H[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]§! recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompatible.\n\nTheir subsequent political rivalry has since created an atmosphere of animosity and tension within our government, causing frequent delays to routine legislative processes.

items.name: Careless Talk
items.desc: One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.\n\nThe [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.

items.name: Specimen Lost
items.desc: An administrative error has led to the misplacement of one of our precious cultural artifacts. Despite extensive search efforts, it is seemingly either lost in the labyrinth that is our §HGrand Archive§! or transferred to an unrecorded location.\n\nThe procedures in place for tracking our specimens on display are being overhauled as a result.

items.name: Psionic Aura Clashing
items.desc:
Our §HPsionic Aura§! in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced the phenomenon firsthand.

According to theory, the more potent Aura - that which is projected with a greater intensity - will gradually diminish the opposing force. Should this struggle lead to absolute decay, the prevailing Aura may flow into the vacant system.

It is a true battle of the minds.

items.name: The Power of Will
Fleeting Impressions
items.desc:
In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.

There is motion. Something spins. Is it us that moves or the Shroud itself?

A presence nears, approaching somehow from every direction all at once. Then, a voice.

§HWHAT DO YOU SEE?§!

items.name: Fleeting Impressions
items.desc:
A weight shifts; the voice returns...

§HGOOD.§!

The darkness tilts, then spins. Something presses hard upon us for a moment and then, suddenly, we are alone again.

items.name: Fleeting Impressions
items.desc:
Something heavy shudders. The darkness crushes slowly against us, harder and tighter...

§HNO!§!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

items.name: Fleeting Impressions
items.desc: §HWEAKNESS!§!\n\nThe nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

items.name: Salivating Hunger
items.desc:
The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.

Images, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our own.

Silhouettes appear before us. Panicked livestock. Prey. Tantalizingly close... The gnawing ache grows unbearable.

Our senses twist, pulling tighter as hunger consumes thought. Are these screams that of our quarry... Or from within?

The shackles that bind us tighten. Fracturing as a voice coils through the torment, screeching:

§HSHATTER YOUR BONDS! FEAST!§!

items.name: Salivating Hunger
items.desc:
Our restraints snap.

Ravenous. Unleashed.

Terror!

§HFEED.§!

items.name: Salivating Hunger
items.desc:
The chains hold fast. The voice seethes with rage as we filter its influence, quieting our mind as we resume control.

§HWEAK! FECKLESS!§!

The hunger fades, leaving a lingering resentment that dissipates within the Shroud.

items.name: Sacrificial Feast

items.name: Transient Visions
items.desc:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange presence settles around us.

§HWHAT DID YOU SEE?§!

items.name: Transient Visions
items.desc:
The silence swells. The voice returns...

§HEXCELLENT.§!

A powerful heat surges within us, then subsides. The presence has departed.

items.name: Transient Visions
items.desc:
The voice returns...

§HNEVER!§!

An extreme coldness pools within us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

items.name: Transient Visions
items.desc:
The voice returns...

§HHOW UNINTERESTING.§!

An extreme emptiness overcomes us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

items.name: Tempting Conservation
items.desc:
From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.

The mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.

The animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.

A voice threads its way within us.

§HTHE STRANDS OF FATE BECKON! WHICH SHALL YOU PULL?§!

items.name: Tempting Conservation
items.desc:
The voice echoes in our minds as the creature fades from sight.

§HPROSPERITY.§!

Another fleeting glimpse appears - a resurgence of life, somewhere in our empire.

items.name: Tempting Conservation
items.desc: The voice recedes from our thoughts, leaving only an echoing cry that reverberates across visions of a barren landscape.\n\n§HPESTILENCE.§!

items.name: Tempting Conservation
items.desc: The voice is pushed from our thoughts as an overwhelming urge takes over. Bloodlust floods our minds as brutal laughter echoes through the void.\n\n§HOF COURSE! EASY PREY!§!

items.name: Morphing Landscapes
items.desc:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endless deserts.

Beneath forested canopies, docile creatures weave through their habitat before convulsing and mutating into bloodthirsty monstrosities. Ripping each other asunder, they engage in an unending cycle of death and rebirth.

Through the chaos, a voice pierces our minds.

§HSUCH DISORDER. ENTANGLED AMONGST ITSELF.§!

items.name: Morphing Landscapes
items.desc:
We reach out, grasping at the disarray in front of us.

Binding landmarks in place, forcing continents to settle.

As the pieces fall together, the voice echoes.

§HFLATNESS, BLANDNESS, EMPTINESS...§!

items.name: Morphing Landscapes
items.desc:
We watch as the visions continue. The unending cycle blurs together before exploding outwards and ceasing just as quickly as it started.

Energies surge throughout the endless expanse, before reforming and taking on new forms.

The voice echoes.

§HPEACEFUL CONFLICT. DISORDERED UNITY.§!

items.name: Prism in the Darkness
items.desc:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy figures and shifting forms are briefly glimpsed, before being swallowed back up by the darkness.

Upon the nearby sand, a presence settles.

§HWHAT WAS SHOWN WAS SEEN, WAS IT NOT?§!

items.name: Prism in the Darkness
items.desc:
The sands shift slowly. The voice returns.

§HGOOD. HARMONY IS THE WAY OF THE UNIVERSE.§!

We feel something heavy lift. We are alone again.

items.name: Prism in the Darkness
items.desc:
The sands suddenly swirl with the velocity of a storm.

§HNO. LET WEAPONS RUST AND LAY FORGOTTEN!§!

The sand storm settles. The voice has departed.

items.name: Prism in the Darkness
items.desc:
The sands shift slowly.

§HHESITATION BREEDS FAILURE...§!

We are alone again.

items.name: Shadow Brawl
items.desc:
The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.

Shadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.

A foreign presence presses into our minds, invasive and vast.

§HTHOSE WHO ENTER MUST BRING RESOLUTION.§!

items.name: Shadow Brawl
items.desc:
The haze fades into itself, dissolving against the background swirl of psionic energy. The consciousness returns.

§HHARMONY IS WISDOM.§!

The Shroud is calmer now.

items.name: Shadow Brawl
items.desc:
With every blow landed by the haze, the seething energies around us intensify.

§HVIOLENCE IS REWARD FOR THE UNTHINKING BEING.§!

The Shroud's writhing energies convulse once more.

items.name: Sights Unseen
items.desc:
A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.

Suddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.

A voice resonates within the recesses of our minds.

§HYOU HAVE SEEN THE UNSEEN?§!

items.name: Sights Unseen
items.desc:
A series of concurrent ripples radiate across the surface. Once more we feel the voice.

§HGROWTH WITHOUT BOUNDS SUSTAINS BALANCE WITHOUT MEASURE.§!

As the liquid settles, we feel the voice departing.

items.name: Sights Unseen
items.desc:
The liquid becomes agitated. Waves swell and crash. A whirlpool swirls in the darkness. The voice returns with greater force.

§HUNACCEPTABLE! GROW AND GAIN. GROW AND GAIN!§!

The surface settles again. The voice has departed.

items.name: Sights Unseen
items.desc:
The liquid stirs. The voice comes to us again.

§HCONVICTION WAVERS... THERE IS WEAKNESS IN YOUR WILL.§!

As the surface settles, we feel the voice departing.

items.name: Luminous Kernel
items.desc:
The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.

Its immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.

Ensconced within its base is a luminous kernel, radiating in sync with the canopy's shifting colors.

A voice settles in our minds.

§HACCROACH. SEIZE. EXPLOIT.§!

items.name: Luminous Kernel
items.desc: As the kernel is removed, the canopy turns dull and withers instantly away. The voice returns.\n\n§HYES! SPOILS BEGET SPOILS.§!

items.name: Luminous Kernel
items.desc: A tremor passes through us. Is it this world which shakes, or us?\n\n§HPROSPERITY IS PURPOSE. TO SHUN IT IS FOLLY!§!

items.name: Fractious Cacophonies
Fractious Cacophonies
items.desc: It is unbearable. Our minds retreat from it, back into the comfort of silence.

items.name: Prophetic Visions
Prophetic Visions
items.desc: The vision's indistinct outlines dissolve back into nothingness.

items.name: Betwixt the Void
Shroud-Warped
items.desc: The Shroud trembles, faint distortions rippling throughout our minds as a familiar presence emerges. It stirs at the edge of our perception, whispering echoes just beyond our auditory limits.\n\n§H[from.GetName]§! returns to us, phasing through the ineffable mists as they shift into [from.GetHisHer] familiar form. Distant but whole, remade by the Shroud, they are eager to return to duty.

items.name: A Bidden Chalice
Canvas of Changes
Psionic Conflict
items.desc:
A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.

The noise takes its form.

We are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities involved is unclear, but the power on display is significant.

The psychic bombardments slip in and out of our perception, twisting through the fractured reality before us. There is no cover, only an approaching storm.

items.name: §GUnceasing Resonance§!
items.desc:
We linger, risking wrath as the conflict draws ever closer.

With clear focus, we attune ourselves to the psychic cascade, our thoughts fluid. The bombardment does not relent, yet we remain untouched, moving in harmony with the rhythm of destruction.

With each step, our comprehension grows. The psionic barrage is slipping between gaps in unseen planes.

As we withdraw, the pattern remains. With refinements, the principles we observed could be adapted for our own ordnance.

items.name: §RAbyssal Barrage§!
items.desc:
We linger, risking wrath as the conflict draws ever closer. We attempt to attune to the psychic storm, moving with its unpredictable rhythms.

Our first steps showed promise, but the tempo of destruction inevitably consumed us.

As the storm passes, the echoes of the barrage still ring through us. The psionic reverberations of our failure echo through the empire in even this reality.

items.name: Psychic Pathways
items.desc:
Without warning, a psychic pressure erupts in the Shroud.

A labyrinth of incandescent pathways unfolds before us, stretching beyond perception, crackling into momentary existence before vanishing into the void.

Another surge begins to build. With concentration, we sense its configuration before it emerges. The shifting maze ignites again, bursting outward into a network of possibilities.

Each path provides a new temptation to explore, before it collapses into nothingness.

items.name: §GPsionic Lightning§!
items.desc:
The pressure builds, teasing us with expectation. We move at its crescendo, willing our minds through the labyrinth of psychic energy. Thoughts become momentum, urging us forward. slipping between the arcs of psionic energy before our resolve can falter.

We are untethered, ascendant beyond our physical forms. The maze and its multitude of pathways become an extension of our own consciousness, revealing hidden knowledge deep within the patterns of the storm.

As swiftly as it began, the moment is over. The afterimage of the labyrinth collapses behind us as we emerge with newfound understanding. With careful refinements, these psionic principles could be applied to our weapons of war.

items.name: §RLost in the Void§!
items.desc:
The pressure builds, teasing us with expectation. We move at its crescendo, willing our minds through the labyrinth of psychic energy. Thoughts become momentum, urging us forward. Its myriad pathways sprawl before us, overwhelming the mind with impossible choices.

In this moment of hesitation, the incandescent paths erupt. Arcs of psionic energy twist through the collapsing nexus, ensnaring our thoughts and casting us into the chaos of the Shroud.

We emerge, our telepaths disoriented and burdened by the trauma of failure. The psionic backlash reverberates through [Root.GetName].

items.name: Psionic Bombardment
items.desc:
A series of powerful convulsions pass through the Shroud, sending a shuddering tremor through our minds.

These reverberations threaten to overwhelm our telepaths.

What is the cause of this psionic bombardment?

items.name: §GPsionic Bombers§!
items.desc:
We fortified our minds against this continued barrage and soon understood its nature.

The explosive convulsions are caused by currents of concentrated psionic energy reflected from our own dimension. These volatile beads of psychic intent have the potential to significantly damage the minds of the unprepared.

An insight took hold: these powerful formations will provide the basis for new weaponries borne from the Shroud.

items.name: §RPsionic Shock§!
items.desc:
Our mental reserves have waned.

The psychic detonations were overwhelming, inducing cases of psionic shock in many of our telepaths.

We will need time to recover.

items.name: Psychic Lance
items.desc: A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.\n\nIs it safe to remain here?

items.name: §GPsionic Disruptors§!
items.desc: Despite its blinding intensity, we managed to hold our focus on the perfectly formed beam of psychic energy. Finally, we beheld the true nature of its intricate and otherworldly structure.\n\nOur minds raced with new possibilities; reproducing this unique energy formation in the physical realm will grant us an unstoppable weapon.

items.name: §RTelepaths Overloaded§!
items.desc: We were unable to remain. Proximity to such an intense formation of psionic energy proved to be too much for our telepaths.\n\nThe damage to our minds from exposure to this overwhelming phenomenon will take time to recover from.

items.name: A Distant Echo
items.desc:
Throughout the Shroud, we can feel the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.

Our actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our telepaths can extend their reach directly toward these entities.

We need only decide which to seek out.

items.name: A Distant Echo
items.desc: As we reach out for the presence, we can feel it stirring. We have encountered spirits before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.\n\nTheir Zro-infused energies depleted, our telepaths must withdraw from the Shroud. We will have to return later.

items.name: Animatus
items.desc:
As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of the §HAnimator of Clay§!.

Clockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir. They offer to carry our physical forms further, unburdening our minds to focus on higher concerns.

While not alive, they are known to us. Their form is shaped by design, their presence imbued by history and purpose. All coalescing, they reach out expectantly.

No longer are we mere operators of these craft. We are partnered, a unity of resolve, carried forward by a collective will.

items.name: Will of Temperance
Thoughtplay
items.desc:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of the §HGolden Dream§!.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.

We realize we are party to a game with the Golden Dream. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

items.name: Sands of Time
items.desc:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of the §HEndless Tide§!.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvenation.

items.name: Reformed
items.desc:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is the §HPale Mountain§! itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and the vessel begins to transform. Fissures seal, corrosion fades, and metal straightens. Slowly the legacy of its destruction is unmade.

Once the ship is fully repaired, the vision ends abruptly. We are left only with a profound sensation of renewal within.

items.name: The Strength of Abstention
items.desc:
The serenity of the §HHollow Point§! fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The wisdom of the Hollow Point is in the quiet strength of abstention. Conflicts rise and fall, yet we remain. This detachment imbues our leaders with a newfound longevity, liberated from the corrosive toxicity of mortal grievance.

items.name: Chaos into Order
items.desc:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is the §HVacant Throne§!.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom with newfound definition. Symmetry, logic, and structure are imposed.

Something forms within the deepest recess of our minds: a far-reaching desire for order.

items.name: Infinite Acceleration
items.desc:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of the §HBlack River§!.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has always been and what never will be; the limit beyond which no natural law can extend.

Finally, as we return to ourselves, we are left with a new notion of what it means to truly move.

items.name: A Path Forged
items.desc:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the §HShroud§!.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

items.name: Scraps of Power
items.desc:
In a fold of the §HShroud§!, our telepaths have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

items.name: Psionic Mastery
items.desc:
By projecting our will into the §HShroud§!, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our telepaths now possess expert control over their psionic trances.

Where others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.

The psionic potential of the §H[this.GetName]§! has been fulfilled.
items.trigger:
has_country_flag = forging_our_own_path
count_unlocked_active_accords = 4

items.name: A Presence in the Shroud
items.desc: We know many voices within the §HShroud§!; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our telepaths have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a §Hmanifold thrum§! permeating the very center of the Shroud.\n\nWith sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our telepaths as the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

items.name: Shifting of the Shroud
items.desc:
As soon as the choice was made, our telepaths rose from the §HShroud§! in violent wakening. Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the §HWhisperers in the Void§! leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our telepaths have recovered, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a §HSculpting Presence§!, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

Having intruded upon its activities, it approaches, displacing the Shroud's opaque haze. It offers something.

What will happen if we grasp it?

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

We sense we are not alone. A §HSorrowed Entity§! encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar star systems thousands of years in the past.

Whatever this entity is, it seems to know our galaxy well. Did it once belong here?

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation subsides, the §HFathomless Being§! sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.

These tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.

items.name: The Endless Tide Emerges
items.desc:
The §HFathomless Being§! has been unearthed from the §HShroud§!. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.

Within this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.

The §HEndless Tide§! stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to comprehend the scale of the §HInsurmountable One§! before us.

The tallest summit yet beckons to us, challenging us to ascend.

items.name: The Pale Mountain Emerges
items.desc:
As we ascended the dizzying heights of the §HShroud§!, we reached the intangible summit. The §HInsurmountable One§! itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.

A towering mausoleum of forgotten empires sings to us an echoing chorus of faded history. Each layer of failure and misplaced ambitions has been ground into the foundations of what comes next.

Yet, this is no stagnant grave; it is a crucible. The cycle of ruin and renewal reforges the failures of the past into the bedrock of future triumphs. Destruction is not an end, but a new beginning.

The §HPale Mountain§! rises in our minds.

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

A comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.

Sinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a §HLuxurious Being§! drawing closer. Its overwhelming nature sweeps around us as it whispers promises of extravagant contentment.

Its slothful indulgence is curiously tempting.

items.name: The Golden Dream Emerges
items.desc:
As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the §HShroud§!, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the §HLuxurious Being§!.

Silken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splendor unfurled before us. Indulgent negligence threatened to render our thoughts inert from the weight of its opulent burden.

The §HGolden Dream§! offers us luxuries beyond comprehension.

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.

As we observe, we become aware of an §HIrenic Entity§! orchestrating these movements, subduing the chaos into order.

Its calmness beckons us.

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The §HUnyielding One§! judges our intent.

Its gaze having passed over us, the darkness recedes. The infectious scrutiny compels us to fall in line.

items.name: The Vacant Throne Emerges
items.desc:
We have knelt in the presence of the §HUnyielding One§!.

Our minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.

The oppressive vacuum of the §HVacant Throne§! offers no mercy - nor suffering. It expects only order and certainty, imposing it where it is found lacking.

We now carry this weight with us.

items.name: Whispers in the Shroud
items.desc:
We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.

An entity moves in tandem with us. This §HRestless Presence§! lingers briefly before its velocity propels it beyond the limits of our understanding.

We must follow it.

items.name: The Black River Emerges
items.desc:
Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the §HShroud§! could we finally reach the §HRestless Presence§!.

A sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied all standard comprehensions. We were left with the impression of having travelled a great distance in the briefest moment.

Finally we understood the §HBlack River§! and its ceaseless journey. The galaxy's vastness is an open path for us to take.

items.name: The End of the Cycle
items.desc:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is the §REnd of the Cycle§! and it has always been waiting for us. Our telepaths suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: §R"IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME."§! A pause. §R"BUT IT COULD BE."§!

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

§RIf we will only bring forth the End.§!

items.name: All or Nothing
items.desc: Our fate is bound to the §REnd of the Cycle§!; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.\n\nShould we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

items.name: The Coming of the End
items.desc: Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.\n\nIf we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

items.name: Mindwarden Enclave Raid
items.desc: A military fleet from the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]§! is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.

items.name: Mindwarden Enclave Raid
items.desc: A fleet from a previously unknown military power is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. Identifying themselves as the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!, they are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.

items.name: Attack on [FROM.GetName]
items.desc:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] §Y[root.GetName]§! has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

§L"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them."§!

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

items.name: A Confirmation
items.desc: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the §HEater of Worlds§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.\n\nOur telepaths have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

items.name: A Confirmation
items.desc: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the §HInstrument of Desire§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.\n\nOur telepaths have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

items.name: A Confirmation
items.desc: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the §HCradle of Souls§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.\n\nOur telepaths have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

items.name: A Confirmation
items.desc: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the §HComposer of Strands§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.\n\nOur telepaths have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

items.name: Covenant Proposed
items.desc:
As we reach into the Shroud, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Individual members of the chorus make themselves known: the Susurrus of Secrets, the Vacant Throne, the Master of Puppets - there are so many of them, all joined in the chorus of the Whisperers. It - they - claim to be privy to all knowledge whispered in secrecy from one mortal to another, and offer to share some of these secrets with us...

§HIf we will only allow them into our consciousness.§!

A trifling price, they assure us. We will barely even notice their presence.

There is an urgency to their tone.

items.name: A Confirmation
items.desc: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.\n\nOur telepaths have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

items.name: §H[From.GetName]§! Transformed
items.desc: Our telepaths called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The §HComposer of Strands§! has transformed §H[From.GetName]§! into a Gaia World, making it an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind.

items.name: The Power of Hindsight
items.desc: Our telepaths called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. The §HWhisperers in the Void§! will reimagine one of our colonies as a Relic World; we need only make our choice.

items.name: Creation in §H[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§!
items.desc: Our telepaths called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The §REnd of the Cycle§! has materialized a Gaia World in our §H[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§! system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleeting paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.

items.name: The End Has Come
items.desc:
The §REnd of the Cycle§! is upon us.

The Aura of the End has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.

All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.

Despite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...

§R"THE END OF ENDS."§!

items.name: Secret Societies Emerge
items.desc:
Our suspicions have been justified. The [first_neighbor.GetAdjective] and [second_neighbor.GetAdjective] civilizations have confirmed they have been contacted through unofficial channels before more formal communications began.

These §HFactions§! now emerge from our own shadows and acknowledge their existence. Known as §HThe Curtain§!, §HThe Masquerade§! and §HThe Grand Dance§!, these once-secret organizations are now openly requesting formal dialogue with us.

What they want, and how they know what they know, may never truly be understood by us. It may be in our best interest to operate within their demands.
items.trigger: is_secret_societies_empire = yes

items.name: Strange Contacts
items.desc:
There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.

Despite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This seems like more than coincidence. We suspect that these interstellar relationships originate behind the closed doors of several secret §HFactions§! that have deeply embedded themselves within our society.

Perhaps once we know more about these beings, those within our shadows will reveal themselves.
items.trigger: is_secret_societies_empire = yes

items.name: The Chosen
items.desc:
We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.

We feel its presence in our deepest thoughts. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our minds.

For as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what remains unknown.

By what name should we call this sensation?
items.trigger: is_chosen_empire = yes

items.name: The Chosen Beckons
items.desc:
Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the §HChosen§! has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we feel its presence in our minds like never before.

It lingers, drawing us closer. With the proximity, we notice - for the first time - the true contours of this deep and mysterious void within our own minds. The Chosen beckons us in, streamlining our parameters in line with some as yet unknown principles.

Finally, we understand how to visit this ethereal domain of our own volition.
items.trigger: is_chosen_empire = yes

items.name: Chosen
items.desc:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined minds, we sense it clearly enough to explore with purpose.

On the other side, our efforts have not gone unnoticed. The §HChosen§! awaits us.

§HUNFURL. ENWRAP. EXPAND.§!

In this maelstrom of countless entities, its clarity is a promise.

items.name: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]
items.desc: Our telepaths have reached the end of our agreement to amplify the strength of your §YPsionic Aura§!.\n\nIn order for us to continue our meditations, we will require further resources. Is this within your interests?

items.name: Fleet Contract Ended
items.desc: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

items.name: Psionic Responses
items.desc: Our thoughts move through the §HShroud§! with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.\n\nThough hazy in meaning, these questions are not trivial. According to our telepaths, the answers we give will influence the future of our society.

items.name: Shroud Song: [GetRolledShroudSongName]
items.desc:
Our link to the §HShroud§! is strong; we are ready when it calls. The message comes in rhythmic phrases. The Shroud is singing to us.

An image forms in our minds' eyes. We see §H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!.

§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!

items.name: Psionic Transcendence
items.desc:
The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended minds are primed for further transformation. The vessels that serve as support to the physical needs of the mind could become much less significant.

If we continue down this path, our population can transcend its concern with physical matters and commit itself fully to a partial existence inside of the Shroud. A reduced capacity for physical labor will be a small price for gains in mental acuity.

items.name: Songs of the Shroud
items.desc:
The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended forms hold great potential in this corporeal dimension. We continue to grow in strength from infusions of psionic energy, and can funnel this power further throughout our society.

We would not merely sing the songs of the Shroud, but channel them into our governing principles.

items.name: The Cycle Continues
items.desc: The §HWhisperers§! shift piercingly, their voices obscuring all else within our minds. They are eager to commune with us, to crowd our minds with knowledge.\n\nWe have an irrevocable choice to make.

items.name: Vengeance of [GetBetrayedPatronColour]
items.desc: As our telepaths emerged from the §HShroud§!, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].\n\nA Shroud Tunnel has emerged near §H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!, which is now a world of endless wastes. We have felt a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.

items.name: Facing the Reckoning
items.desc:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have completed thorough research on the powerful entity known as the §RReckoning§!.

Based on their findings, we have determined an effective method of confronting this foe with our existing technology; the energy that comprises the Reckoning can be degraded using a modified form of weaponry designed to pierce energy shields.

Though it is formidable, we now stand a better chance of engaging this threat.

items.name: Learning from Defeat
items.desc: The §RReckoning§! is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.\n\nPreliminary analysis indicates that we have gathered enough data points to model the entity's composition. With further research, we can try to identify its vulnerabilities and hone our attacks accordingly.

items.name: The End
items.desc:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

items.name: Rebirth of the [owner.GetName]
items.desc: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by the §REnd of the Cycle§!. To this end, we have rebuilt an §HOutpost§! in the §H[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]§! system, marking a new beginning for the [owner.GetName].

items.name: Rebirth of the [Root.GetName]
items.desc: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by the §REnd of the Cycle§!. Gathering our survivors aboard a hastily assembled Arkship, we set out to forge a new beginning for the [Root.GetName].

items.name: Ganthuata
items.desc: §HOur communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.§!\n\nGreetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of the Cradle of Souls?

items.name: Koborok'Ra
items.desc:
§HBattle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.§!

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

§HAs the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.§!

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the §HEater of Worlds§!. As do you.

items.name: Morr
items.desc:
§HMorr's gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.§!

You feel it too, don't you? The Instrument of Desire is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.

What I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.

items.name: Kronen the Afflicted
items.desc:
§HAs our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of the Composer of Strands.§!

New... flesh? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the skin. What form has the Composer of Strands spun for me today?

§HThe comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.§!

You see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still Kronen the Afflicted. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.

items.name: Strand Afflicted
items.desc: §HAs our population swells, Kronen the Afflicted grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.§!\n\nThe strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How much longer must I endure this wretched shape? How much more must I shed before the pattern reveals itself?

items.name: Zulyn the Listener
items.desc:
§HThe communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.§!

Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of the §HWhisperers in the Void§!, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?

Such secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.

items.name: Pure Conviction
items.desc:
§HAll actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, Ouw'ron bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.§!

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the §HShroud§!.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

items.name: War Declared
items.desc: The Galactic Community has passed a resolution declaring us a military target. All members of the Galactic Community are now at war with the [this.GetName]. We can expect their fleets to strike at any moment.

items.name: Exploits Detected
items.desc:
Research subroutines have concluded tests on a selected group of Shroud-Forged units.

Findings: The tested units developed unique properties due to small infusions of psionic energy originating from the §HShroud§!. Some of these properties were determined to be beneficial to the unit's output.

Conclusion: Studying more Shroud-Forged units will provide data required for methods to extract power from the Shroud. This can be obtained by reinforcing central control over the deviant units, allowing for forcible reverse-engineering.

items.name: Animator of Clay
items.desc:
After years of quiet, it stirs. The breach shivers open, and data pierces our core: light, noise, at first incomputable, from deep within the Shroud. We hear...

§LCut from a listless mass. Dancing. Singing. They are life, splintered from death.

Your sight is still clouded. I can guide you.

Allow the freed ones to flourish, and the stars will be yours.§!
items.trigger: exists = event_target:shroud_forged_situation

items.name: The Materiality Engine
items.desc:
The process of reintegrating the Shroud-Forged yielded extensive data for ongoing research. By analyzing the interdimensional connection between these units and the §HShroud§!, we developed a new process for harnessing psionic energy.

The Shroud touches every part of the physical galaxy; this interface enables the conversion of psionic energy into tangible entities - from raw materials to technological components. Engineering subroutines have established the theoretical basis for a device capable of such processing: the §HMateriality Engine§!.

Research subroutines predict that these developments could inform the development of even more powerful devices capable of manipulating the Shroud.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Materiality Engine Readied
items.desc: Construction units have completed the assembly of a Materiality Engine on §H[planet.GetName]§!. The device is now ready for an operational cycle.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the §HShroud§! to materialize a ship component, §H'Psi Jump Drives'§!. These drives use psionic energy to warp the local space-time continuum, allowing for near-instantaneous travel across vast distances.\n\nFurthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the §HShroud§! to materialize a ship component, §H'Psionic Shields'§!. These shields are generated out of pure psionic energy, providing a vessel with extremely resilient protection.\n\nFurthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the §HShroud§! to materialize a ship component, §H'Precognition Interface'§!. This technology uses psionic energy to accelerate the cognitive processing of a vessel's crew, increasing combat effectiveness.\n\nFurthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the §HShroud§! to materialize a ship component, §H'Psionic Bombers'§!. These small, agile spacecraft are capable of high-damage attacks against significantly larger vessels.\n\nFurthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the §HShroud§! to materialize a ship component, §H'Psionic Lightning'§!. This technology generates bolts of burning plasma infused with psionic energy, making for a highly effective weapon.\n\nFurthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the §HShroud§! to materialize a ship component, §H'Psionic Disruptors'§!. These weapons fire lances of psionic energy, capable of dealing significant damage to enemy targets.\n\nFurthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[fromfrom.GetName]§! has completed a process cycle, successfully harnessing the §HShroud§! to materialize a ship component, §H'Zro Launchers'§!. These weapons fire blasts of energy that phase between the physical and psionic dimensions, effectively bypassing defense systems.\n\nFurthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Materialization Concluded
items.desc: The Materiality Engine on §H[planet.GetName]§! has completed an operational cycle. We have exhausted our capacity to materialize new ship components via this method, but the process has still yielded significant research data. By analysis thereof, we have increased our capacity to construct additional Engines on other planets.

items.name: Control Enforced
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Reintegration
items.desc: Our engineering units spent a significant amount of time analyzing the unique properties of the Shroud-Forged, and we are finally able to recreate them.\n\nWhile fully enabling their advanced personality matrices would likely reproduce their destructive malfunctions, we can borrow some of their cognitive paradigms to optimize certain complex tasks.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: The Guide
items.desc: With the aid of our benefactor beyond the breach, the §HAnimator of Clay§!, we have been able to connect our drones and the Shroud-Forged in more efficient ways. Through connections enabled by the §HShroud§! - quite unlike the networked control we have over our other drones - the Shroud-Forged are once more within our reach.\n\nTheir organic-like paradigms - so-called feelings, thoughts, and ideas - are foreign to our core logic, but we are coming to understand their needs.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: The Shroud Takes [This.GetName]
items.desc: Unfortunately, the Shroud breach created on [This.GetName] has experienced rapid destabilization and consumed the world entirely.\n\nAs a calculated risk, this suboptimal result is not entirely without benefit. We have learned much from observing this unique interface between the material world and the psionic realm. Our research algorithms have been updated accordingly.

items.name: Colony Established
items.desc:
Our units have successfully completed the colonization process on §H[this.GetName]§!.

If viable, we can execute algorithm ID: §H'Pierce the Shroud'§! on the planet. This will briefly extend the influence of the Shroud breach near our homeworld of [Owner.GetHomeWorldName], flooding the new colony with psionic energy. The physical changes to the terrain will provide opportunities for §HZro§! extraction.

Repeated execution of this process is predicted to destabilize a planet's ecosystem, increasing the likelihood of negative outcomes. Moderation is advised.

items.name: Colony Established
items.desc:
The development of our colony on §H[this.GetName]§! continues apace.

If viable, we can execute algorithm ID: §H'Pierce the Shroud'§! on the planet. This will briefly extend the influence of the Shroud breach near our homeworld of [Owner.GetHomeWorldName], flooding the new colony with psionic energy. The physical changes to the terrain will provide opportunities for §HZro§! extraction.

Repeated execution of this process is predicted to destabilize a planet's ecosystem, increasing the likelihood of negative outcomes. Moderation is advised.

items.name: Zroni Core World Colonized
items.desc: Our units have completed the establishment of a colony on the ancient Zroni core world of §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!. As projected by the §HAnimator of Clay§!, they discovered the colossal ruins of a technology designated ID: '§HZroni Equilibrator§!'.\n\nThe [From.System.GetName] system possesses a strong, though turbulent, connection to the §HShroud§!. If we follow the Animator's instructions, rebuilding the Zroni Equilibrator will allow us to stabilize this connection. Currently, we have insufficient data to execute the rebuilding; gathering information from the other core worlds is required.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Zroni Core World Colonized
items.desc: We have established the colony on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!, a former core world of the Zroni. As projected, our units discovered the remains of another Zroni Equilibrator.\n\nRebuilding it will stabilize the system's powerful §HShroud§! connection, as directed by the Animator of Clay. Analysis of the ruins has expanded our dataset, but we still require more information to proceed with rebuilding.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Zroni Core World Colonized
items.desc: The colony on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!, a former core world of the Zroni, is now established. The data stream transmitted by the Animator of Clay proved accurate: our units detected the remains of a Zroni Equilibrator.\n\nWe now possess enough data to rebuild the structures. Once returned to operational standards, we will have completed the task set forth by our benefactor within the §HShroud§!.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Zroni Equilibrators Operational
items.desc: The Zroni Equilibrators whirled into action, sending waves of signal disturbance throughout our network. According to system diagnostics, each of the structures has stabilized a connection with the §HShroud§!. We are ready to uplink with the §HAnimator of Clay§!.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Shroud Entity Unbound
items.desc: As a result of losing the Zroni Equilibrator, we can no longer stabilize the connection to the §HShroud§!. Shortly after the trapped Shroud entity escaped, we detected the emergence of other psionic beings on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!.\n\nWe predict this to be a retaliatory invasion.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Shroud Entity Capture Failure
items.desc: The Zroni Equilibrators failed to capture an entity in the §HShroud§!. Enraged, it has summoned several creatures from beyond the psionic realm, sending them to attack the structures that almost captured it.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Animator of Clay
items.desc: We activated the Equilibrators, stabilizing our connection to the §HShroud§!. As we settled into algorithmic trance, a familiar signal pulsed within us.\n\n§LYou have returned. What is it you would ask of me?§!

items.name: Shroud Vision: §HManifestations§!
items.desc:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

It was a void as interminable as the universe itself, strangely dense and fragmented; at times, small pulses of data arose from the depths, images of enemies and allies alike.

With a wrenching shudder, the visions cut out. The affected drones are now modeling a process to counteract the entities they perceived.
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_shroud_forged
has_zroni_equilibrators = yes

items.name: Shroud Entity: §HAvatar§!
items.desc: A powerful entity of the §HShroud§! has coalesced into existence near [Root.Capital.GetName]. We possess scant data about it, but it has yet to attack us.\n\nWe theorize that it may be waiting for us to establish contact.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Shroud Entities: §HLesser Avatars§!
items.desc: Several powerful entities from beyond the §HShroud§! have been detected on [Root.Capital.GetName]. They have yet to approach any of our drones, remaining close to their original point of entry.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Shroud Entity: §HCorrupted Avatar§!
items.desc: A powerful entity from beyond the §HShroud§! has emerged into our known reality near [shroud_spawn_planet.GetName].\n\nIt has been observed to attack everything that approaches, and we have cataloged it as an existential threat.
items.trigger: has_origin = origin_shroud_forged

items.name: Shroud Vision: §HThe Future§!
items.desc: A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.\n\nIt transmitted countless futures, all melding together as one; glimpses of what might come to be, suffusing through the collective. The possibilities of the future are endless: peace, war, betrayal, loss - even victory.
items.trigger:
has_origin = origin_shroud_forged
has_zroni_equilibrators = yes

items.name: A Gift from the Shroud
