items.desc: A powerful psionic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and it seems to be affecting our ships.\n\nOur ships move as if held back by an invisible force. This has resulted in much slower sublight travel.

items.name: §RCurse Bestowed§!
items.desc: A powerful psychic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and into the communal psionic link that is shared between all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nThis negative energy has eroded the morale of our ground troops, who will be much less effective in battle for a time.

items.name: §RCurse Bestowed§!
items.desc: A powerful psionic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and it seems to be interfering with our interstellar sensors.\n\nThe sensor resolution from all sources has been greatly diminished, resulting in much shorter sensor ranges.

items.name: Fire and Ruin
items.desc:
[Root.Capital.GetName]... the vision is hazy and indistinct, but there can be no question - it is [Root.Capital.GetName], our capital. The major cities look different yet recognizable, even through the obscuring wall of flames and smoke. Thousands... no, millions of dismantled units litter the streets, all of them [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We are surrounded by destruction.

§HYOUR FUTURE.§!

Nothing functional remains in the ruins. In the sky above, massive orbital installations, trailing smoke, have begun a slow and inevitable descent towards the planet. Are we receiving one possible future out of many?

§HNOT ONE OF MANY. IT SHALL COME TO PASS. AS SURELY AS THE SUN RISES. IT IS YOUR DESTINY.§!

The vision ends as quickly as it began, leaving behind a miasma of swirling psionic energy.

items.name: Duelling Apparitions
items.desc:
The Shroud is tempestuous here. As massive currents of raw psionic energy are funneled through, violent reactions give birth to semi-intelligent apparitions.

These confused spirits often clash with one another, unleashing phenomenal amounts of psychic power in battles that can last millennia. In fact, several such duels seem to be taking place right now.

We should proceed with caution.

items.name: Psionic Visitors
items.desc: Deeper within the Shroud, we detect a presence. Visitors, like us - a powerful psionic probe made by minds as utterly alien to us as they are to the Shroud.\n\nAs their psionic echo touches our own, a faint image briefly flickers within us: massive organic beings floating in a thick, gaseous atmosphere, attended by swarms of smaller creatures.

items.name: Boundless Sands
items.desc:
An endless desert stretches before us. We have been here before.

§H"Shala'kul milem zunak?"§!

Something emerges from the sand. It is difficult to see.

§H"Zharabi, melasuk."§!

The words are like thunder, spoken by a mouth for which they were never intended. We are compelled to answer.

items.name: The Multitudes
items.desc:
Suddenly, in a startling moment of clarity, the nature of our existence is laid bare. A multiverse where thousands of galaxies like our own are locked in endless cycles of conflict.

It begins, it ends, and then it begins again. Each time with trillions of variables hanging in the balance.

§H"So it is,"§! a voice whispers, §H"and so it shall always be."§!

items.name: Voices of the Fallen
items.desc:
We are looking down upon our galaxy from far above, at a distance of what must be hundreds of thousands of lightyears. Without warning, the psionic current plunges us down towards the myriad stars at an incredible speed, into the region of space belonging to one of the Fallen Empires - the [fallen_empire.GetName].

Stars swish by, then planets, until the vision finally settles on a [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesName] city. Incredible spires rise towards the sky, aided by anti-grav technology generations beyond our own. The current takes us into such a spire, through wall after wall until we reach a large meeting room of sorts. It is occupied by two [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural], floating comfortably in zero-gravity chairs while conversing with each other in soft voices.

They are oblivious to our presence.

items.name: §GTechnological Secrets§!
items.desc:
The [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly dignitaries of some kind, discussing matters of state. Slowly, surely, the vision encroaches upon them while their alien speech is gradually transformed into words that have meaning to us.

§H"...is mad. If she thinks that the people would be willing to accept even a momentary lapse in the living standards that they have grown accustomed to, there is..."§!

The mind-glow of the two [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is overwhelming. Like a blossoming flower, their minds open and are laid bare. It would be so easy to reach in.

§H"...don't care what the Council says. The upstarts are still millennia behind us, and their miserable fleets can no more threaten us than a Gazurian gnat could consume a Hilaxi fire lizard. There is no need for..."§!

There. Technological secrets plucked from the recesses of their minds, as easy as one would copy a file from an unlocked computer. The [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] remain ignorant of the theft that has taken place within their very minds.

items.name: Secrets Unheard
items.desc:
The [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly dignitaries of some kind, discussing matters of state. Slowly, surely, the vision encroaches upon them while their alien speech is gradually transformed into words that have meaning to us.

Suddenly, the aliens go quiet and very still.

§H"Can you feel it?"

"Yes. Someone is watching."§!

They search the room until both of them are staring directly at us.

§H"Remarkable. A psionic probe."§!

§H"It appears [Root.GetSpeciesName] in origin. Quickly, activate the transplanar shield.§!"

The vision ends abruptly.

items.name: Incoming Transmission
items.desc:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Do not think that your loathsome attempt to invade the minds of our leaders has gone unnoticed.

There will be consequences.

items.name: Flicker in the Void
items.desc: A small, flickering star materializes inside the Shroud. It flies past at incredible speed, and for a second, it reveals itself as an alien ship of unknown configuration. Then it vanishes in a cloud of psionic energy as quickly as it appeared.\n\nCan it be? Is it possible to physically enter the Shroud and then emerge somewhere else entirely in normal space?

items.name: §GPsionic Jump Drives§!
items.desc: Yet another flickering star suddenly appears, but this time we are ready. It is indeed an alien ship, unlike any that has ever been seen in our galaxy. As it flies past us, we feel the mind-glow of its crew, and their secrets are ours.\n\nA Psionic Jump Drive. How ingenious.

items.name: §RCurse Bestowed§!
items.desc: Yet another flickering star suddenly appears, but this time we are ready. It is indeed an alien ship, unlike any that has ever been seen in our galaxy. As it flies past us, we attempt to merge with the mind-glow of its crew, but their intellects are darker and more alien than any we have yet encountered.\n\nNot only are we repelled from their vessel, but the psionic feedback from their violent rejection has followed us out of the Shroud! The sub-light travel speed of our starships has been momentarily reduced.

items.name: Shielded Entity
items.desc: Having followed a faint echo in the Shroud, we encounter a spirit that has ensconced itself behind some kind of powerful psionic shield.\n\n§HLEAVE.§!

items.name: §GPsionic Shields§!
items.desc: We did not venture this deep into the Shroud only to be turned back now. After focusing our collective psionic capacities, we were able to create a breach in the shield large enough to momentarily peer through.\n\nWhat lay beyond the shield is beyond our current understanding, critically overwhelming several of our psionic processors, however, as the act of breaching the shield taught us how to generate a similar force field. If the technique can be refined, we may be able to form psionic shields large enough to encompass entire starships.

items.name: Shield Unbreached
items.desc: Our telepaths, already overloaded from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. The failed attempt seems to have provoked the spirit.

items.name: Awaiting the Future
items.desc: The concept of time, as we know it, is alien to the Shroud. What can seem like centuries here may equal mere hours or even minutes in the real world. If we know where to look, precognition may yet be within our grasp.\n\nSuch an ability comes with risks to our collective, if we proceed it must be with caution.

items.name: §GPrecognition Interface§!
items.desc: A limited precognitive connection to the Shroud can be maintained without risking unit overload, but the massive influx of probability data is too overwhelming to be of much practical use.\n\nHowever, our research nodes have found minor applications for this data, applying it to our fleets to improve their combat efficiency.

items.name: §RShrouded Madness§!
items.desc: As feared, attempting to comprehend the inconceivable multitude of options and probabilities that exist both in the past and the future has resulted in large cases of catatonia in our psionic drones.\n\nThis has left them severed from the overmind and leaving them without purpose. If we wish to reach the Shroud again, we will need to recycle these defective husks and recover our collective strength.

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.desc: We have found a tiny space within the Shroud that has a concentration of psionic energy that is of a magnitude we have never before seen. Such psionic energy, if successfully tapped, would dissipate amongst the collective without much consequence. However we may be able to designate a single 'chosen' drone to act as a direct conduit for this energy, becoming immensely powerful in the process. \n\nIt is not known if their solitary form will be able to handle such volumes of energy without fatal repercussions. We have compiled a selection of candidates.

items.name: Chosen One
items.desc: We have successfully funnelled the full power of the psionic energy pocket into our designated target, [chosen_leader.GetName].\n\nWhat would otherwise have been a drop in our collective ocean is able to serve as a powerful tool for the [Root.GetName] now that [chosen_leader.GetName] wields it for the benefit of all [Root.Species.GetName].

items.name: §RDeath of a Leader§!
items.desc: The entire Shroud shudders as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are channeled into [chosen_leader.GetName].\n\nHowever, as suspected, such power is beyond the means of one singular entity. The physical form of [chosen_leader.GetName] has erupted into an explosive burst of psionic energy, separating their voice from the [GetBrainName].

items.name: §RPsionic Transformation§!
items.desc:
The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Although the transfer was successful, [chosen_leader.GetName] has been... transformed... severing them from the collective as an entirely foreign entity inhabits and possesses their form.

§HINSIGNIFICANT WHELPS... WHAT... WHAT HAVE YOU... DONE... TO ME... §!

§HYOU... WILL... PAY... FOR SUCH HUBRIS...§!

items.name: A Presence in the Shroud
items.desc:
There is a presence here, occupying this entire part of the Shroud. We have met spirits before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.

It seems unaware of us as of yet. Perhaps it is sleeping. Perhaps we are simply beneath its notice.

Perhaps we should leave.

items.name: §RCommunion Rejected§!
items.desc: As we reach out for the presence, we can feel it stirring, its attention now fully on us. It does not seem to appreciate being disturbed.\n\nA wave of energy lashes at our telepaths, causing great agony to some and knocking others unconscious. We have no choice but to withdraw from the Shroud for the time being.

items.name: §RCommunion Rejected§!
items.desc:
As we reach out for the presence, we can feel it stirring, its attention now fully on us. It does not seem to appreciate being disturbed.

An enormous wave of psionic energy crashes against us, blacking out the senses of our telepaths. When they come to, they notice one of their number is missing. §Y[leader_to_kill.GetName]§! is nowhere to be found, and where [leader_to_kill.GetSheHe] [leader_to_kill.GetWasWere] standing there is now only the psionic trace of a small rift, as though the entity reached out into our world and dragged [leader_to_kill.GetHerHim] into the Shroud for... well, who knows what reason or purpose, really.

No matter its reasons for taking [leader_to_kill.GetHerHim], it seems doubtful that we will ever see [leader_to_kill.GetName] again.

items.name: Covenant Proposed
items.desc:
As we reach out for the presence, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Individual members of the chorus make themselves known: the Susurrus of Secrets, the Throne's Shadow, the Master of Puppets - there are so many of them, all joined in the chorus of the Whisperers. It - they - claim to be privy to all knowledge whispered in secrecy from one mortal to another, and offer to share some of these secrets with us...

§HIf we will only allow them into our consciousness.§!

A trifling price, they assure us. We will barely even notice their presence.

There is an urgency to their tone.

items.name: Covenant Proposed
items.desc:
The presence welcomes us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our telepaths, so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

The presence is known as the §HComposer of Strands§!, and it regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.

§HIf we will only take it into our flesh.§!

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child. Behind it lies its twin, the Animator of Clay. It is not interested in our organic minds. It longs to create souls, to meld circuits into spirit.

The Composer awaits our reply.

items.name: Covenant Proposed
items.desc:
As we reach out for the presence, we sense a great hunger. The presence wastes no time, nor words. It is the §HEater of Worlds§! and it wishes to devour us.

Only some of us, though. No more than we can spare. In exchange, it will grant us great powers. It will teach us its hunger, its rage. It will shape them into psionic weapons that can overcome any foe.

§HIf we will only let it feed on us.§!

It sounds impatient to begin.

items.name: Covenant Proposed
items.desc:
Before we can locate the presence, it reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the minds of our telepaths, bargaining, cajoling. It is the §HInstrument of Desire§! and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

§HIf we will only accept it into our hearts.§!

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

items.name: Covenant Proposed
items.desc:
The presence was waiting for us. It is §RThe End of the Cycle§! and it has always been waiting for us. Our telepaths suddenly speak in unison, a dozen voices in a perfect chorus: §R"IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME."§! A pause. §R"BUT IT COULD BE."§!

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

§RIf we will only bring forth the End.§!

items.name: Covenant Formed
items.desc: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the §HWhisperers in the Void§! and already they have begun to share their secrets with our scientists and leaders. We will benefit immensely from their knowledge.\n\nThe only downside appears to be a sudden upswing in mental illness and suicide among the general population, and some of our worlds are experiencing a flurry of unexplainable murders and assaults committed by otherwise stable and well-adjusted individuals. Our clinics and asylums are having some trouble dealing with the sudden influx of patients.

items.name: The End of the Cycle: §RReckoning§!
items.desc:
Our time is up. For a brief time, we benefitted from the immense power given to us by the §REnd of the Cycle§!. We knew there would be a price to pay, but we thought it might be one we could bear, or that we could find some way to avoid paying it.

It was not, and we could not.

The price we paid was everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there are only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the §HShroud§!.

All that remains of our empire is a group of exiles led by §H[Root.GetRulerName]§!, a powerful [GetPsychicNoun] who deviated from the collective and led a small band of individuals into hiding on a world not marked by the End.

As if having our empire destroyed overnight was not bad enough, a massive psionic entity has materialized near [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our [GetPsychicNounPlural], it now roams the galaxy seeking further prey.

items.name: The End of the Cycle: §RShrouded§!
items.desc: We have been unable to stop the immense energy being from enveloping §H[Root.GetName]§!. The planet and its entire population have been consumed by the §HShroud§!.
items.trigger: exists = owner

items.name: Whisperers in the Void: §RCoping§!
items.desc: Though the secrets imparted to our people by the §HWhisperers§! are of great use, some of them are also quite disturbing. Dealing with the stress of knowing too much can be difficult and has caused an increasing number among our population, including §H[leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName]§!, to turn to substance abuse as a means to cope.

items.name: Whisperers in the Void: §RSuicide§!
items.desc: Though the secrets imparted to us by the §HWhisperers§! are of great use, some of them are also of a disturbing individualist nature. Being exposed to such deviancy for a prolonged period of time has led §H[leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName]§! to separate themselves from the collective, leaving behind only their decayed husk.

items.name: Whisperers in the Void: §RMadness§!
items.desc:
Since allowing the §HWhisperers§! to communicate with the [GetBrainName], we have begun to notice a disturbing rise in deviancy amongst the collective.

Drones are lashing out at each other while performing otherwise standard procedures, as well as over indulging in the use of amenities to an almost individualist degree.

We will need to purge the affected vessels if we wish to restore order.

items.name: Whisperers in the Void: §RPsychosis§!
items.desc:
Since allowing the §HWhisperers§! to communicate with the [GetBrainName], we have begun to notice a disturbing rise in deviancy amongst the collective.

Worse still, our sense of unity has begun to falter. The collective is unable to communicate effectively due to a psionically induced rise in individualist deviancy.

We must purge these excesses from ourselves if we wish to restore order.

items.name: Eater of Worlds: §RNibbly§!
items.desc: §H[devoured_leader.GetTitle] [devoured_leader.GetName]§! has suddenly disappeared, leaving behind only echoes of psionic activity. It appears that the §HEater of Worlds§! has seen fit to devour [devoured_leader.GetHimHer]. Though it spared our other leaders, we cannot predict when the Eater might return for more.

items.name: Eater of Worlds: §RFamished§!
items.desc: Once again, the §HEater§! has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a significant part of our population on §Y[planet_target.GetName]§!.\n\nThough we understand the benefits of our covenant with Eater, such rampant cullings of our collective are beginning to sow the seeds of disruption and instability, leaving us more fragmented.

items.name: Eater of Worlds: §RRavenous§!
items.desc: Once again, the §HEater§! has returned to claim its tribute - this time devouring a whole planet.\n\n§H[planet_target.GetName]§! is now enveloped in a thick psionic fog, and any attempt to breach the atmosphere has proven unsuccessful. This world was uninhabited; the consequences would be grave if the next target is a thriving colony.

items.name: Instrument of Desire: §RDecadence§!
items.desc: The influence of the §HInstrument§! can be felt throughout the [GetBrainName], its otherworldly desires corrupting our collective with abstract individualist notions such as 'exclusivity', 'decadence', and 'wealth'.\n\nSuch concepts are inflicting a sickness throughout our drones, causing them to stray from the unifying purposes that drive us. We may have to indulge in these vices to recollect ourselves.

items.name: Composer of Strands: §RMutation§!
items.desc: The §HComposer of Strands§! has bestowed its blessings upon us, directly altering some of our hardwired components. Circuits have fused into new configurations. Solid metal has somehow melded into totally novel forms. Remarkably, our neuroprocessors remain functioning without the slightest problem.

items.name: Eater of Worlds: §RHungry§!
items.desc: The §HEater§! can never be truly sated. This time, it took a bite out of one of our colonies. Where once a significant portion of the collective occupied physical space, now all that remains is a crater of unthinkable size, haunted by swirling purple mists.

items.name: Eater of Worlds: §RPeckish§!
items.desc: Once again, the §HEater§! has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a whole city on §Y[planet_target.GetName]§!. With the loss of so many drones, the collective has paid a high price for our covenant with the Eater.

items.name: Composer of Strands: §RDegeneration§!
Composer of Strands: §RRegression§!
items.desc: The benevolent gifts of the §HComposer of Strands§! have fallen upon [devolved_species_planet.GetName], where a number of our populations have undergone a severe mutation, regressing to the state of pre-sapients.

items.name: Cradle of Souls: §RDemilitarization§!
items.desc: The §HCradle§! seeks balance in all things; according to our telepaths, this includes a military proportionate to the needs of peace. The size of our navy must have stirred our patron's ire, as a number of ships from the §H[demilitarized_fleet.GetFleetName]§! have suddenly vanished in a violent burst of psionic energy.

items.name: Cradle of Souls: §RDisruption§!
items.desc: Attuned to the will of the §HCradle§!, the [root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is beset by dissonance, entertaining the absurdity of harmonious coexistence between all minds. In response to the current disorder of galactic affairs, a wave of psionic disturbance has coursed through the populace, causing widespread existential anguish.

items.name: Cradle of Souls: §RLimitation§!
items.desc: The ability to support and maintain our military fleets has become more difficult throughout the §H[root.GetName]§!.\n\nOur telepaths sense that this disruption was caused by the §HCradle§!, which yearns for galactic order. Our investment into military infrastructure, no matter how small, must have earned its displeasure.

items.name: Instrument of Desire: §RLavish Lifestyle§!
A Divine Sovereign
items.desc: The immortal entity known as §H[chosen_one.GetName]§!, previously [chosen_one_species.GetName] but now something far more, has attracted a large and devout following in the [Root.GetName]. Worshipped by many as a supreme deity, a call has gone out to officially crown the [chosen_one.GetTitle] as the permanent ruler of our great empire, now and into perpetuity.

items.name: Ancient Rivals
items.desc: The return of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Fallen Empires present in our galaxy. The §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two proud nations are ancient rivals, and though the reasons for their rivalry has long since faded into history, the sudden reawakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! has enflamed old animosities and triggered a counter-reaction. The §H[From.GetName]§! have roused themselves from their slumber to face their old rivals, with the whole galaxy as their battleground.

items.name: The War in Heaven
items.desc: Ever since the awakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! and their ancient §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §H[From.GetName]§!.\n\nEach side has sent a representative to the younger races, promising great rewards for those who join them in their war and terrible punishments for those who choose to stand against them. Choosing either side in this conflict will mean giving up our independence, but remaining neutral may be even more dangerous unless we can find other neutral empires to stand by our side.

items.name: The End of the War in Heaven
items.desc: After a long and fierce conflict, the §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]§! now stand triumphant as the undisputed dominant power in the galaxy.\n\nFor now, an uneasy peace reigns, but how long can this new order last?
items.trigger: is_subject = no

items.name: The End of the War in Heaven
items.desc: After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! and §H[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]§! have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders. \n\nFor now, an uneasy peace reigns over the galaxy, but how long can this truce last?

items.name: The War in Heaven
items.desc: Ever since the awakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! and their ancient §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §H[From.GetName]§!.\n\nBoth sides are demanding the immediate dissolution of the §HGalactic Imperium§! and for its individual members to pick a side in the war. Earlier today, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] addressed the Imperial Senate and categorically rejected their demands. The galaxy now finds itself in a massive three-way war on a scale never before witnessed.

items.name: Awakened Empire Defeated
items.desc: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger races, the destruction of an elder empire at the hands of their supposed lessers has changed the situation considerably. Now the question remains - will the §H[RemainingAwakened.GetName]§! be able to avoid the fate of their ancient foe, or does this defeat signal the dawn of a new age in the galaxy?

items.name: The League of Non-Aligned Powers
items.desc: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Due to our military might and influence, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

items.name: League Membership Request
items.desc: The §H[From.GetName]§! have formally requested to join the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§!.

items.name: War with the Awakened
items.desc: It did not take long for the ancients to take notice of the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§!. Representatives from both warring powers have come to [Root.Capital.GetName] demanding the dissolution of the league, and for its members to choose sides in the war. Naturally, we refused, and as of this morning we are now in a state of war with both the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §H[SecondSleeper.GetName]§!.

items.name: The Fall of the Awakened
items.desc: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancient giants proved their undoing, and now they are gone, reduced to no more than another set of broken ruins of the past. A new age dawns on the galaxy, and from now on the fate of the younger races will be entirely their own to decide.

items.name: The League of Non-Aligned Powers
items.desc: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. A §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! has formed under the leadership of the §H[From.GetName]§! with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

items.name: League Membership Accepted
items.desc: We have been accepted into the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! by the §H[From.GetName]§!, and now we will stand together against the menace of the elder empires.

items.name: League Membership Refused
items.desc: Our request to join the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! was refused by the §H[From.GetName]§!, and now we will have to stand alone against the menace of the elder empires.
